fields.title: Omwesigwa mu Bintu Ebitono
fields.subtitle: Ensimbi, amagezi, n’obugagga obutaggwaawo
fields.description: Ekitabo ekimpi era ekyangu okusoma ku nsimbi, eri abantu abaagala okugoberera Yesu n’obulamu bwabwe bwonna. Essuula amakumi abiri zitambula mu Bayibuli yonna nga zeesigama ku nnyiriri amakumi asatu enkulu: Katonda ye nnannyini byonna, omutima oguli emabega w’ensawo, okukola mu bwesimbu, okuteekateeka, amabanja, okugaba n’omutima omugabi, abaavu, n’obugagga obutaggwaawo, nga mulimu n’amaloboozi ga Wesley, Müller, Spurgeon ne Tozer. Buli ssuula ekomekkerezebwa n’ekintu eky’okugezaako okukola n’ebibuuzo eby’ebibinja ebitono.
fields.about_html:
Yesu yayogera ku nsimbi okusinga bwe yayogera ku ggulu oba ku ggeyeena, kubanga yali amanyi nti obugagga bwaffe gye bugenda, n’emitima gyaffe gye gigoberera. Omwesigwa mu Bintu Ebitono kitabo kya Ochorus ekipya, eri buli muntu ayagala okumugoberera mu kitundu ky’obulamu ekisasula ebisale. Tekijja kukusuubiza nti Katonda ajja kukugaggawaza, era tekijja kukuswaza olw’okuba n’ensimbi. Ekigendererwa kyakyo kwe kukufuula ow’eddembe.

Ekitabo kirina ebitundu bitaano. “Bya Ani?” kissaawo omusingi: Katonda ye nnannyini buli kintu, ffe tukiddukanya ku lulwe. “Omutima Oguli Emabega w’Ensawo” kitunuulira omululu, okweraliikirira, okumalibwa, n’akabi k’obugagga. “Amagezi ku Nsimbi eza Buli Lunaku” kikwata ku kukola mu bwesimbu, okuteekateeka, amabanja, n’okulabirira amaka. “Abagabi nga Katonda” kyogera ku bibala ebibereberye, okugaba n’essanyu, abaavu, n’okugaba kyonna kye tusobola. “Obugagga Obutaggwaawo” kitunuulira eby’omu maaso: obwesigwa mu bintu ebitono, ensimbi n’omulimu gwa Katonda, okuyigiriza abaana baffe, n’olunaku lwe tuliwulira nti “Weebale.”

Buli ssuula etwala nga eddakiika kkumi okugisoma. Etandika n’emboozi, eteeka mu maaso olumu ku nnyiriri amakumi asatu enkulu okuva mu Bayibuli yonna, ejuliza eddoboozi okuva mu biseera eby’edda, nga John Wesley, George Müller, Charles Spurgeon, Hudson Taylor oba A. W. Tozer, era ekomekkereza n’ekintu kimu eky’okukola wiiki eno n’ebibuuzo eby’ekibinja ekitono. Emabega w’ekitabo waliwo enteekateeka y’okusoma ey’ennaku 30, enteekateeka y’ensimbi ku lupapula lumu, n’obulagirizi bw’ebibinja obwa wiiki kkumi. qa.question: Omwesigwa mu Bintu Ebitono kyogera ku ki?
qa.answer: Ku nsimbi n’obuyigirizwa. Kitambula mu ebyo Bayibuli yonna by’eyigiriza ku nsimbi mu ssuula amakumi abiri ennyimpi: nti Katonda ye nnannyini buli kintu, ensimbi kye zikola ku mutima, okukola mu bwesimbu, okuteekateeka, amabanja, okulabirira amaka, okugaba n’omutima omugabi, okulabirira abaavu, n’okwetereka obugagga obutaggwaawo.

qa.question: Kiyigiriza nti Katonda ajja kungaggawaza bwe nnaagaba?
qa.answer: Nedda. Kiraga nti Katonda awa omukisa abagabi, naye kitegeeza bulungi nti omukisa gwe si bulijjo nti ssente, era nti Yesu yennyini yali mwavu. Tugaba kubanga Kristo yafuuka omwavu atugaggawaze, so si ng’enkola ey’okusiga ensimbi okufuna amagoba.

qa.question: Abakristaayo bateekwa okuwaayo ekimu eky’ekkumi?
qa.answer: Abakristaayo abeesigwa tebakkiriziganya oba ekimu eky’ekkumi kikyetaagisa, era ekitabo kikyogera lwatu. Kitwala ekimu eky’ekkumi ng’omusingi omulungi okutandikirako so si ng’ekkomo, era kiteeka essira ku kusooka okugaba, bulijjo, n’essanyu, era ng’okusinziira ku ekyo Katonda ky’atuwadde.

qa.question: Nsobola okukikozesa mu kibinja ekitono?
qa.answer: Yee. Kyawandiikibwa ku lw’ebibinja. Buli ssuula ekomekkerezebwa n’ebibuuzo eby’okukubaganyaako ebirowoozo n’ekintu kimu eky’okukola mu wiiki eyo, era Ebyongerezeddwako 3 biraga enteekateeka ya wiiki kkumi, essuula bbiri buli wiiki, n’amagezi eri abakulembeze.

qa.question: Kijuliza bawandiisi ba dda ki?
qa.answer: John Wesley, Susanna Wesley, George Müller, Hudson Taylor, Charles Spurgeon, A. W. Tozer, Thomas Watson, Andrew Murray, E. M. Bounds, F. B. Meyer, Amy Carmichael, William Seymour, Martyn Lloyd-Jones, Thomas à Kempis n’abalala, buli omu ng’ajulizibwa butereevu okuva mu kitabo ky’osobola okusoma kyonna mu tterekero ly’ebitabo.

fields.title: Ennyanjula: Lwaki Yesu Yayogera ku Nsimbi
fields.body_html:
Abasinga obungi ku ffe twandyagadde okwogera ku kintu kyonna okuggyako ensimbi. Tubuulira mukwano gwaffe ku bulamu bwaffe, ku bufumbo bwaffe, wadde ku kubuusabuusa kwe tulina ku Katonda, naye ebbanga ddene nga tetunnamubuulira kye tufuna, amabanja ge tulina oba kye tugaba. Ensimbi ze kisenge ekisembayo eky’ekyama mu nnyumba. Oluggi lwakyo tulukuuma nga luggaddwa.

Naye Yesu yaluggulangawo buli kiseera.

Yagera olugero lw’omulimi eyazimba amaterekero amanene n’afa mu kiro ekyo kyennyini. Yalaba nnamwandu ng’ateeka obusente bubiri obutono mu ggwanika ly’omu yeekaalu, n’agamba nti yali agabye okusinga abalala bonna. Yatunuulira omuvubuka omugagga, n’amwagala, n’amugamba okutunda byonna by’alina. Yagamba nti kyangu eŋŋamira okuyita mu nnyindo y’empiso okusinga omugagga okuyingira mu bwakabaka. Yayogera ku nsimbi ezabula, obugagga obwakwekebwa, amabanja agatasasulwa, empeera y’olunaku, ttalanta za ffeeza, emisolo n’ekimu eky’ekkumi. Soma Enjiri ng’okutte penseeri, okole akabonero buli w’osanga ensimbi oba ebintu by’abantu nga byogerwako. Penseeri ejja kuggwaawo.

Lwaki? Yesu teyali mu bwetaavu bwa nsimbi, era teyali mu kawefube wa kusonda nsimbi za kuzimba. Teyalina wa kussa mutwe gwe. Yayogera ku nsimbi kubanga yali amanyi gye zitwala. Wakati mu Kubuulira kw’oku Lusozi, yakyogera mu sentensi emu:

“Obugagga bwo gye buli n’omutima gwo gye gunaabeeranga.” (Matayo 6:21)

Weetegereze ensengeka. Ffe tutera okulowooza nti kikontana: okusooka twagala ekintu, oluvannyuma ne tukissaako ensimbi zaffe. Yesu agamba nti ensimbi zikulembera, omutima ne gugoberera. Gye tuteeka obugagga bwaffe, emitima gyaffe gigenda gye buli. Ensimbi tezikoma ku kulaga kye twagala. Zitendeka ekyo kye twagala.

Eyo ye nsonga lwaki ensimbi si nsonga ya ku mabbali mu bulamu bw’Omukristaayo. Kye kimu ku bifo ebikulu we tufuukira abayigirizwa ba Yesu ddala, oba we tulemererwa. Oyinza okuyimba ku Ssande nti Yesu ye Mukama wa byonna, ate ku Mmande n’okwata akawunti yo mu bbanka ng’ekitundu ky’obulamu bwo kyokka ky’atalinaako kigambo. Abasinga ku ffe ekyo kyennyini twakikola. Ekitabo kino kikuyita okuggulawo oluggi olwo n’omuyingiza.

Ekitabo kino kye kitali

Si kisuubizo nti Katonda ajja kukufuula omugagga. Ababuulizi abamu bayigiriza nti bw’ogaba ekimala, oba bw’okkiriza ekimala, Katonda ateekwa okukusasula mu nsimbi enkalu, n’amagoba gaazo. Bayibuli egamba ddala nti Katonda awa omukisa abagabi, era ekyo ojja kukiraba emirundi mingi mu bupapula buno. Naye Yesu yali mwavu. Pawulo yamanya enjala. Ku bazira b’okukkiriza ab’omu Abaebbulaniya 11 kigambibwa nti: “Baatambulanga nga bambadde amaliba g’endiga n’ag’embuzi nga kumpi tebalina kantu, nga bali mu kwetaaga” (Abaebbulaniya 11:37). Enjiri yonna eyandiswazizza abatume si ye Njiri.

Era si kitabo ekikuswaza olw’okuba n’ensimbi. Ibulayimu yali mugagga. Bwe batyo ne Yobu, Yusufu ow’e Alimasaaya ne Ludiya, omukazi omusuubuzi eyaggulawo amaka ge e Firipi eri Pawulo n’abakkiriza abaasooka eyo. Bayibuli tegamba nti ensimbi mbi. Egamba nti “okululunkanira ensimbi y’ensibuko y’ebibi byonna” (1 Timoseewo 6:10). Ekizibu tekiri mu nsawo yo. Kiri mu mutima ogugikutte.

Era si kitabo kya kuyigiriza by’ensimbi mu ngeri ey’ekikugu. Ojja kusangamu amagezi ag’omugaso ku bajeti, ebbanja, okutereka n’emirimu, kubanga Bayibuli eyogera bingi ku byonna ebyo. Naye waliwo ebifo ebisinga obulungi okuyigira engeri pensoni gy’ekolamu. Ekitabo kino kyogera ku mutima oguli emabega w’ennamba.

Ekitabo kino kye kiri

Kye kitabo ekimpi ekikulungamya ku nsimbi, eri abantu abaagala okugoberera Yesu n’obulamu bwabwe bwonna, nga mw’otwalidde n’ekitundu ekisasula ebisale. Kitambula mu Bayibuli yonna, okuva mu lusuku Adeni okutuuka ku lunaku lwe tuliwa embalirira, era kikuŋŋaanya Katonda by’ayogera ku nsimbi nga kibisibira ku nnyiriri enkulu amakumi asatu.

Kirimu ebitundu bitaano:

  • Bya Ani? kissaawo omusingi. Katonda ye nnannyini byonna, era ffe tuli bawanika be.
  • Omutima Oguli Emabega w’Ensawo kitunuulira ensimbi kye zikola munda mu ffe: omululu, okweraliikirira, okumalibwa, n’obulabe bw’obugagga.
  • Amagezi ku Nsimbi eza Buli Lunaku kyogera ku mulimu omwesimbu, okuteekateeka, okutereka, ebbanja n’okulabirira amaka.
  • Abagabi nga Katonda kyogera ku bibala ebibereberye, okugaba n’essanyu, abaavu, n’okugaba kyonna ky’osobola.
  • Obugagga Obutaggwaawo kitunuulira eby’omu maaso: obwesigwa mu bintu ebitono, ensimbi n’omulimu gwa Katonda, okuyigiriza abaana baffe, n’olunaku lwe tuliwulira nti “Weebale.”

Amaloboozi okuva mu biseera eby’edda

Ekkubo lino tolitambula wekka. Mu lugendo ojja kusisinkana abasajja n’abakazi abaameggana n’ensonga y’ensimbi dda nnyo nga ffe tetunnabaawo, era ng’ebitabo byabwe osobola okubisoma byonna mu tterekero ly’ebitabo erya Ochorus. John Wesley, eyabuulira nti “Funa kyonna ky’osobola, tereka kyonna ky’osobola, gaba kyonna ky’osobola,” era n’abeera bw’atyo. George Müller, eyalabirira bamulekwa nkumi na nkumi mu Bristol nga tasabye muntu yenna nsimbi. Charles Spurgeon, ebigambo bye ebyangu eby’omulimi ebikyali ebisongovu leero nga bwe byali lwe yabiwandiika. Hudson Taylor n’akasente ke akasembayo akayitibwa half-crown. A. W. Tozer ku kye yayita “obukambwe bw’ebintu.” Thomas Watson, Omupuritaani eyali asobola okusattulula omululu ng’omukozi w’essaawa bw’asattulula essaawa. Ebigambo byabwe tubikyusizza nga tubeera beesigwa ku ebyo bye baawandiika, n’olwekyo ebimu biwulikika nga bya dda. Naye kisaana okufuba.

Engeri buli ssuula gy’etegekeddwamu

Waliwo essuula amakumi abiri, era buli emu ogisoma mu ddakiika nga kkumi. Buli ssuula erina enkula y’emu:

  • Emboozi egiggulawo, okuva mu Bayibuli, mu byafaayo oba mu bulamu obwa bulijjo.
  • Olunyiriri olukulu, lumu ku nnyiriri amakumi asatu.
  • Okuyigiriza, emirundi mingi nsonga bbiri oba ssatu ezitegeerekeka.
  • Eddoboozi okuva mu biseera eby’edda, ekijulizo ekimpi okuva ku omu ku bawandiisi ab’edda.
  • Ky’okukola wiiki eno, ekintu kimu ekitono era ekirambulukufu eky’okukola.
  • Ku lw’ebibinja, ebibuuzo bitono eby’okukubaganyaako ebirowoozo n’abalala.

Osobola okusoma ekitabo kino wekka, naye kyawandiikibwa nga balowooza ku bibinja ebitono. Essuula bbiri buli wiiki zijja kusobozesa ekibinja okukimaliriza mu wiiki kkumi. Ku nkomerero y’ekitabo ojja kusangayo enteekateeka y’okusoma ey’ennaku 30 ezimbiddwa ku nnyiriri enkulu amakumi asatu, enteekateeka y’ensimbi ey’olupapula lumu, n’obulagirizi eri abakulembeze b’ebibinja.

Nga tonnatandika

Tunuulira mu bwesimbu w’oli kati. Oyinza okuba ng’obuutikiddwa amabanja era ng’oswala olw’ago. Oyinza okuba ng’obeera bulungi, naye ng’otya mu kyama nti Yesu ayinza okukusaba okulekayo ekintu. Oyinza okuba ng’oli mugabi dda, era nga weebuuza engeri y’okukikolamu n’amagezi. Oyinza okuba ng’oli mwavu, era ng’okooye okubuulirwa ky’oteekwa okukola n’ensimbi z’otalina.

Wonna w’oli, ekigambo ekisooka eky’ekitabo kino si tteeka. Kye kisa. Nga Bayibuli tennatugamba kintu kyonna ku nsimbi zaffe, esooka kutubuulira ku bugagga bwa Katonda bw’atulaga:

“Kubanga mumanyi ekisa kya Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo nga bwe yafuka omwavu ku lwammwe, mwe mulyoke mugaggawale.” (2 Abakkolinso 8:9)

Byonna ebirala mu bupapula buno bimera okuva mu ekyo. Tetugaba okufuna okwagala kwa Katonda. Tugaba kubanga twaweebwa dda okusinga bye twandisobodde okusasula. Tetuddukanya bulungi nsimbi kusanyusa Katonda. Tuziddukanya bulungi kubanga za Katonda, era ye yazitukwasa.

Yesu yagamba nti, “Omuntu omwesigwa mu kintu ekitono, abeera mwesigwa ne mu kinene” (Lukka 16:10). Ensimbi kye kimu ku bintu ebisinga obutono. Lumu zonna ziriggwaawo. Naye engeri gye tuzikwatamu ebumba abantu be tufuuka, era abantu be tufuuka babeerawo emirembe gyonna.

Kale, ka tuggulewo oluggi.

study_questions.question: Lwaki Yesu yayogera nnyo bw’atyo ku nsimbi?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga yali amanyi gye zitwala. Nga bwe yagamba mu Matayo 6:21, “Obugagga bwo gye buli n’omutima gwo gye gunaabeeranga.” Ensimbi zikulembera, omutima ne gugoberera; n’olwekyo ensimbi tezikoma ku kulaga kye twagala, naye zitendeka ekyo kye twagala. Ekyo kizifuula ekimu ku bifo ebikulu we tufuukira abayigirizwa ddala, oba we tulemererwa.

study_questions.question: Bayibuli eyigiriza nti Katonda ajja kufuula Abakristaayo abagabi abagagga?
study_questions.answer: Nedda. Ekitabo kino kigaana okuyigiriza nti okugaba oba okukkiriza ekimala kiwaliriza Katonda okusasula mu nsimbi enkalu. Katonda awa ddala omukisa abagabi, naye Yesu yali mwavu, Pawulo yamanya enjala, n’abazira b’omu Abaebbulaniya 11 baatambulanga “nga kumpi tebalina kantu.” Ng’ennyanjula bw’egamba, “Enjiri yonna eyandiswazizza abatume si ye Njiri.”

study_questions.question: Bayibuli egamba nti ensimbi zennyini mbi?
study_questions.answer: Nedda. Ibulayimu, Yobu, Yusufu ow’e Alimasaaya ne Ludiya bonna baalina obugagga, era Bayibuli tegamba nti ensimbi mbi. Egamba nti “okululunkanira ensimbi y’ensibuko y’ebibi byonna” (1 Timoseewo 6:10). Ekizibu tekiri mu nsawo yo. Kiri mu mutima ogugikutte.

fields.title: Byonna bya Katonda
fields.body_html:
Kabaka Dawudi yali akaddiye. Obulamu bwe bwonna yali ayagala okuzimbira Katonda ennyumba, yeekaalu mu Yerusaalemi, naye Katonda n’amugaana. Mutabani we Sulemaani ye yandigizimbye. Kale Dawudi n’akola ekintu ekyali kisinga okumpi ku ekyo. Emyaka gye egisembayo yagimala ng’akuŋŋaanya ebikozesebwa: zaabu, effeeza, ekikomo, ekyuma, embaawo n’amayinja ag’omuwendo, mu bungi obuzibu okulowoozaako. Oluvannyuma n’ayongerako n’obugagga bwe yennyini. Abakulembeze ba Isirayiri bwe baalaba ekyo ne bamugoberera, ebirabo ne biyiika okutuusa amawanika lwe gajjula ne gabooga.

Singa waaliwo omuntu eyalina eddembe okwenyumiriza olw’obugabi bwe, ye Dawudi ku lunaku olwo. Naye mu kifo ky’ekyo, yayimirira mu maaso g’ekibiina kyonna n’asaba. Era wakati mu kiweebwayo ekisinga obunene mu bulamu bwe, yayogera ekintu ekyakifuula ekirala ddala.

“Obukulu, n’amaanyi, n’ekitiibwa, n’obuwanguzi, n’okugulumizibwa bibyo, Ayi Mukama Katonda, kubanga byonna ebiri mu ggulu ne mu nsi bibyo. Obwakabaka bubwo, Ayi Mukama Katonda, era ogulumizibwa okuba omukulu wa byonna. Obugagga n’ekitiibwa biva gy’oli, era ggwe ofuga ebintu byonna; omukono gwo gwa maanyi era gwa buyinza era gugulumiza ne guwa amaanyi bonna. Kale nno, Katonda waffe, tukwebaza era tutendereza erinnya lyo ery’ekitiibwa. “Naye nze ani n’abantu bange kye ki, ffe okusobola okuwaayo bwe tutyo nga ffe tweyagalidde? Byonna biva gy’oli, era tukuwadde ku bibyo.” (1 Ebyomumirembe 29:11-14)

Dawudi yali awaddeyo obugagga bungi nnyo, era yali amanyi nti teyali awadde Katonda kintu na kimu ekitaali kya Katonda dda.

Katonda ye nnannyini

Okuyigiriza kwa Bayibuli ku nsimbi kutandikira wano, era bwe tukifuna bubi, tewali kirala kijja kutuukirira bulungi. Byonna bya Katonda.

“Ensi ya Mukama n’ebigirimu byonna, n’ensi zonna n’abo abazibeeramu.” (Zabbuli 24:1)

Si kitundu kyakyo. Kyonna. Ettaka, ennyanja, ente, bbanka eri mu kibuga kyo n’ensimbi eziri omwo. Katonda ayogera ng’ayita mu nnabbi Kaggayi nti, “‘Effeeza yange, ne zaabu yange,’ bw’ayogera Mukama ow’eggye” (Kaggayi 2:8). Mu Zabbuli 50 asekerera mpola ekirowoozo nti yandyetaaze ekintu kyonna okuva gye tuli: “Singa nnumwa enjala sandikubuulidde: kubanga ensi n’ebigirimu byonna byange” (Zabbuli 50:12).

Katonda bwe yawa Isirayiri ensi ensuubize, yassaawo etteeka eryewuunyisa. Ettaka lyali lisobola okupangisibwa, naye nga teriyinza kutundibwa emirembe gyonna. “Ettaka teriitundibwenga kagenderere, kubanga ensi yange; mwe muli bayise era abasuze obusuze” (Ebyabaleevi 25:23). Abayisirayiri baabeeranga ku ttaka, ne balirima, ne baliraga abaana baabwe. Naye ekyapa kyalinga bulijjo mu linnya lya Katonda.

Ekyo kikyali kituufu. Ennyumba yo, emmotoka yo, ensimbi z’otereka, enfuna yo, obukugu bwo, obudde bwo: obikutte, naye si ggwe nnannyini byo. Oli mutuuze mu nsi ya Katonda, ng’obeezaawo ku ebyo by’akuwa.

Tuli bawanika

Katonda bw’aba nga ye nnannyini, ffe tuli ki? Ekigambo kya Bayibuli kiri omuwanika, ekigambo eky’edda ekitegeeza omuddukanya. Omuwanika yaddukanyanga amaka oba ebintu bya mukama we ku lulwe. Yusufu yali muwanika mu nnyumba ya Potifa. Yalina ebisumuluzo bya buli kintu n’obuyinza ku buli kintu, naye nga tewali na kimu kye yali nnannyini.

Ekyo kye kifo kyaffe. Pawulo agamba nti, “Ate era omuwanika kimugwanira okuba omuntu omwesigwa” (1 Abakkolinso 4:2). Peetero ayogera bw’atyo ku buli kirabo Katonda ky’atuwa: “Buli omu asaanidde okukozesa n’obwesigwa buli kirabo Katonda kye yamuwa olw’okugasa banne nabo balyoke bafune emikisa gya Katonda emingi gy’agaba” (1 Peetero 4:10).

Kino kikyusa ekibuuzo kye tubuuza ku nsimbi. Nnannyini abuuza nti, “Ensimbi zange njagala kuzikozesa ki?” Omuwanika abuuza nti, “Nnannyini ayagala ensimbi ze zikozesebwe ki?” Ebyo bibuuzo bibiri ebyawukana ennyo. Ekisooka kiteeka nze wakati. Eky’okubiri kiteeka Katonda awo.

Era kikyusa engeri gye tulowoozaamu ku kugaba. Abasinga obungi mu ffe tulowooza mu kasirise nti ebitundu kyenda ku kikumi bye tukuuma bibyaffe, ate ekimu eky’ekkumi kye tugaba kya Katonda. Naye obanga byonna bya Katonda, ekibuuzo si kye kino nti ensimbi zange mmeka ze nsaanidde okuwa Katonda. Kiri nti ensimbi za Katonda mmeka ze nsaanidde okwekuumira. Ebitundu kikumi ku kikumi byonna bibye, era byonna bisaanidde okukozesebwa mu ngeri emusanyusa: ensimbi z’ennyumba, emmere, n’olugendo olw’okuwummulamu, wamu n’ekiweebwayo.

Akabi k’okwerabira

Musa yalaba akabi nga kajja. Isirayiri yali emaze emyaka amakumi ana mu ddungu, ng’erya emmaanu olunaku ku lunaku, nga yeesigamye ku Katonda yekka. Kaakano baali banaatera okuyingira ensi engagga ey’eŋŋaano n’emizabbibu n’ebirombe eby’ekikomo. Musa n’abalabula nti obugagga bwandireese okukemebwa okw’engeri obuzibu gye bwali butaleetanga:

“Weekuumenga, olemenga okulowoozanga mu mutima gwo nti, ‘Obugagga buno bwonna mbufunye olw’obuyinza bwange n’amaanyi g’emikono gyange.’ Naye ojjukiranga Mukama Katonda wo, kubanga y’akuwa obuyinza okufuna obugagga, alyoke atuukirize endagaano ye gye yalayirira bajjajjaabo, nga bwe kiri leero.” (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 8:17-18)

Eyo ye ssaala y’omuntu eyeekoledde: “olw’obuyinza bwange n’amaanyi g’emikono gyange.” Kiwulikika ng’amagezi aga bulijjo. Twakola nnyo ddala. Twagezaako ne bwe kyali kya kabi. Naye ani yatuwa amaanyi okukola? Ani yatuwa amagezi agasobola okuyiga omulimu, omubiri ogusobola okugolokoka ku makya, eggwanga eririmu enguudo n’akatale, abazadde abaatuliisa? Pawulo akibuuza butereevu: “Era mulina kye mutaaweebwa? Kale obanga ddala mwaweebwa, kiki ate ekibenyumirizisa ng’abataakifuna?” (1 Abakkolinso 4:7).

Okwerabira Katonda tekitera kuba kusalawo kwa mangu. Kuba kuseeyeeya mpola okujjira awamu n’obulamu obunyuma. Gye tukoma okuba n’ebingi, gye kikoma okubeera ekyangu okulowooza nti ffe twakyekolera.

Eddembe mu kuba omuwanika

Kino kiyinza okuwulikika ng’amawulire amabi, ng’olinga Katonda atuggyako ekintu. Naye mu butuufu kituwa eddembe lingi nnyo.

Singa nze nnannyini buli kintu, buli kintu kinneesigamako. Nteekwa okukikuuma, okukyongera, n’okukyeraliikirira. Buli kufiirwa kuba kufiirwa kwange. Naye bwe mba omuwanika, obuzito buli ku bibegabega bya nnannyini. Omulimu gwange kwe kuba omwesigwa mu ebyo by’ampadde, n’okumwesiga ku ebisigaddewo. Akatale bwe kagwa, ensimbi ze zigudde. Ebbaluwa ey’ebbanja bw’ejja nga sisobola kusasula, nsobola okugitwala eri Oyo nnannyini nte eziri ku nsozi olukumi.

Yobu yali ategedde kino bwe yafiirwa byonna mu lunaku lumu: ebisibo bye, abaddu be n’abaana be. Yagwa wansi n’asinza:

“Nazaalibwa sirina kantu era bwe ntyo bwe ndiddayo. Mukama ye yawa era Mukama y’aggyeewo, erinnya lya Mukama Katonda lyebazibwe.” (Yobu 1:21)

Omuwanika yekka y’asobola okusaba bw’atyo. Nnannyini afiiriddwa byonna aba afiiriddwa byonna. Omuwanika afiiriddwa byonna akyalina Mukama we.

Eddoboozi okuva mu biseera eby’edda

George Müller teyasabako muntu yenna nsimbi. Yakkiriza nti amaka g’abaana abatalina bazadde ge yaddukanyanga mu Bristol gaali ga Katonda, era ne buli ssente eyayingiranga okuliisa abaana yali yiye. Eyawandiika ebyafaayo bye, Arthur Pierson, yafunza endowooza ya Müller ku kugaba bw’ati:

“Abakkiriza abamuliikirivu batunuulira ebintu byonna nga bya Katonda emirembe gyonna, ebitayinza kumuggyibwako, era ne bwe bakyusa ensimbi mu kweyagalira ne bazitwala mu makubo amatukuvu mu kifo ky’ag’okwefaako bokka, bakyajjukira nti bye bamuwa bibye ddala!”

Arthur T. Pierson, George Müller of Bristol

Ky’okukola wiiki eno

Wandiika olukalala olumpi olw’ebintu byonna by’oyita “byange”: ennyumba yo, emmotoka yo, essimu yo, ensimbi z’otereka, enfuna yo, obukugu bwo. Oluvannyuma waggulu ku lupapula wandiikako ebigambo bya Zabbuli 24:1. Twala eddakiika ntono otambule mu lukalala ng’osaba, ng’owaayo buli kintu eri Katonda ng’okiyita erinnya lyakyo. Oyinza okusaba bw’oti: “Mukama, kino kikyo. Weebale okukinkwasa. Ndaga engeri gy’oyagala kikozesebwe.”

Ku lw’ebibinja

  • Kintu ki ky’olina ky’osinga okukaluubirirwa okulowooza nti kya Katonda so si kikyo? Lwaki?
  • Ensaasaanya yo wiiki eno yandikyuse etya singa ddala okkiriza nti oddukanya ensimbi z’omuntu omulala?
  • Musome Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 8:17-18 wamu. Lwaki mulowooza nti obugagga butuleetera okwerabira Katonda mangu okusinga obuzibu?
  • Ekirowoozo eky’okuba omuwanika so si nnannyini kikuwummuza, oba mugugu gy’oli? Lwaki?

study_questions.question: Bayibuli egamba ki ku ani nnannyini nsimbi zaffe n’ebintu byaffe?
study_questions.answer: Byonna bya Katonda. “Ensi ya Mukama n’ebigirimu byonna” (Zabbuli 24:1), era “Effeeza yange, ne zaabu yange” (Kaggayi 2:8). Ne ettaka lya Isirayiri teryayinzanga kutundibwa emirembe gyonna, kubanga lyali lirye. Tukutte amaka gaffe, ensimbi ze tutereka, enfuna yaffe n’obukugu bwaffe, naye si ffe bannannyini byo.

study_questions.question: Kitegeeza ki Omukristaayo okuba omuwanika w’ensimbi?
study_questions.answer: Omuwanika ye muddukanya addukanya amaka ku lwa mukama we, nga Yusufu bwe yakola mu nnyumba ya Potifa, ng’alina ebisumuluzo bya buli kintu naye nga si nnannyini kintu na kimu. Kale ekibuuzo kikyuka okuva ku “Ensimbi zange njagala kuzikozesa ki?” ne kifuuka “Nnannyini ayagala ensimbi ze zikozesebwe ki?” Ebitundu kikumi ku kikumi byonna bibye, so si ekitundu kye tugaba kyokka.

study_questions.question: Lwaki Musa yalabula Isirayiri nti obugagga bwandibeerabizza Katonda?
study_questions.answer: Mu Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 8:17-18 Musa yalaba nti obulamu obunyuma buleeta okukemebwa obuzibu kwe bwali butaleetanga: okugamba nti, “Obugagga buno bwonna mbufunye olw’obuyinza bwange n’amaanyi g’emikono gyange.” Yabagamba okujjukira nti Katonda y’awa obuyinza okufuna obugagga. Okwerabira Katonda tekitera kuba kya mangu; kuba kuseeyeeya mpola okujjira awamu n’okuba n’ebingi.

fields.title: Twatondebwa Okukola, Twayitibwa Okukuuma
fields.body_html:
Omulimu ogwasooka mu Bayibuli gwali gwa kulima nnimiro.

Ekibi nga tekinnabaawo, ekikolimo nga tekinnabaawo, eriggwa limu nga terinnamera, Katonda yasimba ennimiro mu Adeni n’agiteekamu omuntu. Teyamuteekamu kwegalamirira na kuwummula bwereere. Yamuteekamu kukola.

“Mukama Katonda n’ateeka omuntu mu nnimiro Adeni agirimenga era agikuumenga.” (Olubereberye 2:15)

Emirimu ebiri: okugirima n’okugikuuma. Okugikulaakulanya n’okugitaasa. Okugibaza ebibala n’okugikuuma nga ntebenkevu. Okwo kwe kwali okuyitibwa kw’abantu okuva ku lubereberye, era kwaweebwa mu Lusuku lwa Katonda.

Omulimu si kikolimo

Abantu bangi balowooza nti omulimu kibonerezo, ekintu kye tulina okugumiikiriza okutuusa ku wiikendi oba ku kuwummula emirimu. Mu Bayibuli waliwo ekikolimo ku mulimu, naye kijja oluvannyuma, mu Olubereberye 3, ng’omuntu amaze okugwa mu kibi. Katonda yagamba Adamu nti, “Mu ntuuyo zo mw’onoofuniranga ekyokulya ennaku zonna ez’obulamu bwo. Ensi eneekumerezanga amaggwa n’amatovu” (Olubereberye 3:17-18). Okuva olwo omulimu gubadde muzibu. Gunyiiza, gukooya, era oluusi gulabika ng’ogutaliimu makulu.

Naye ekikolimo kyafuula omulimu ogw’obulumi. Tekyagufuula mubi. Omulimu gwennyini gwava eri Katonda, era gwali kitundu ku nsi gye yayita “nnungi nnyo.” Katonda bwe yasooka okuwa omusajja n’omukazi omukisa, yabawa omulimu ogw’okukola: “Mwale mujjuze ensi, mugifugenga. Mufugenga ebyennyanja ebiri mu nnyanja, n’ebinyonyi eby’omu bbanga na buli kiramu ekitambula ku nsi.” (Olubereberye 1:28). Abakugu mu by’eddiini bakiyita ekiragiro eky’okutonda. Kitegeeza nti emirimu egya bulijjo, okulima, okuzimba, okufumba, okusomesa, okuwandiika pulogulaamu za kompyuta, okwoza, okulabirira abaana, ngeri ya kutuukiriza kiragiro kya Katonda ekyasooka.

Katonda Yennyini mukozi. Yakola ennaku mukaaga ng’atonda ensi, era Yesu yagamba nti, “Kitange bulijjo akola, nange nteekwa okukola.” (Yokaana 5:17). Yesu yamala ebiseera bye ebisinga obungi mu dduuka ly’omubazzi. Bwe tukola, tuba tukola ekintu Katonda ky’akola.

Lwaki omulimu gukwatagana n’ensimbi

Ekitabo kino kyogera ku nsimbi, kale lwaki tutandika n’omulimu? Kubanga mu Bayibuli, engeri eya bulijjo Katonda gy’atuwaamu bye twetaaga eyita mu mulimu. Ensimbi tezaategekebwa kugwa okuva waggulu. Zaategekebwa kukolerwa.

Pawulo kino akyogera butereevu. Abakkiriza abamu mu Ssessaloniika baali balekedde awo okukola, oboolyawo kubanga baalowooza nti Yesu anaatera okukomawo essaawa yonna. Pawulo yawandiika nti:

“Era ne bwe twali gye muli eyo, twabakuutira nti omuntu yenna bw’agaananga okukola emirimu, n’okulya talyanga. Kyokka tuwulira nti mu mmwe mulimu abagayaavu abatayagala kukola, aboonoona ebiseera byabwe mu kusaasaanya eŋŋambo. Mu linnya lya Mukama waffe, tubeegayirira era tubakuutira abali bwe batyo, okukolanga emirimu n’obunyiikivu n’obuteefu balyoke balyenga ebyo bye bakoleredde.” (2 Abasessaloniika 3:10-12)

Ekyo si bukambwe eri abantu abatasobola kukola. Bayibuli y’emu eragira okulabirira n’omutima omugabi abalwadde, abakadde, bannamwandu ne bamulekwa. Kigambo eri abantu abasobola okukola naye ne basalawo obutakola. Omulimu kitundu ku kitiibwa kyaffe. Okukolera emmere yo kwe kuyimirira ku magulu go, n’otaba mugugu eri abalala. Pawulo yagamba Abasessaloniika nti, “Mubeerenga bakkakkamu, nga temweyingiza mu by’abalala, era mukolenga emirimu gyammwe nga bwe twabakuutira, mutambule nga mwegendereza eri abatakkiriza, mube nga mwemalirira mu buli nsonga.” (1 Abasessaloniika 4:11-12).

Engero zikyogera mu lunyiriri lumu: “Emikono emigayaavu gyavuwaza, naye emikono eminyiikivu gireeta obugagga.” (Engero 10:4). Ekyo si kisuubizo nti bwe kiri bulijjo. Abantu abamu bakola nnyo nnyo ne basigala nga baavu, era Bayibuli ekimanyi. Naye ng’etteeka erya bulijjo, obunyiikivu n’okufuna bye weetaaga bitambulira wamu.

Omulimu ng’okusinza

Kuno kwe kyama ekinene eky’omulimu gw’Omukristaayo. Pawulo yawandiikira abaddu, abantu abaalina emirimu egisinga obuzibu era egisasula ekitono mu nsi ya Rooma, n’abagamba nti omulimu gwabwe gusobola okuweebwayo eri Yesu:

“Buli kye mukola mukikole ng’abakolera Mukama waffe so si abantu, nga mumanyi nga mulifuna empeera yammwe ey’omugabo gwammwe okuva eri Mukama waffe.” (Abakkolosaayi 3:23-24)

Obanga ekyo kyali kituufu eri omuddu, kituufu ne gy’oli. Spreadsheet ku kompyuta, obudde bw’okukola ku kasiisi k’edduuka, enteekateeka y’essomo, okukyusa ekiwero ky’omwana, ekiro mu waadi y’eddwaliro: byonna bisobola okukolebwa “ng’abakolera Mukama waffe”. Omukulu wo ku mulimu ayinza obutakiraba n’akatono. Yesu ajja kukiraba.

Kino kitegeeza nti eri Omukristaayo tewali mulimu gwa nsi gwokka ogutakwatagana na Katonda. Waliwo emirimu gyokka egikolerwa Kristo n’egyo gye twekolera ffekka. Omukozi w’emidumu atereeza amazzi agakulukuta mu bwesimbu era obulungi, n’asaba ssente ez’obwenkanya, aba aweereza Katonda mu mazima ddala ng’omubuulizi ali ku kituuti.

Okukuuma wamu n’okukola

Jjukira ekitundu eky’okubiri ekya Olubereberye 2:15: “agirimenga era agikuumenga.” Adamu teyalina kukulaakulanya nnimiro kyokka. Yalina n’okugikuuma. Obuwanika buzingiramu byombi.

Mu by’ensimbi, okukola kwe kufuna, n’okukuuma kwe kuddukanya bye tufuna. Abantu abamu bakola nnyo, ate ne baleka byonna ne bibaggwaako olw’obulagajjavu. Abalala bakuumi beegendereza naye tebakola ddala. Enteekateeka ya Katonda byombi: okuvaamu ebibala n’okukuuma, okufuna n’okuddukanya.

Ekitundu ekyo eky’okubiri kye kitabo kino kye kisinga okwogerako. Naye kitandikira wano, ku kitiibwa ky’omulimu. Tosobola kuddukanya ky’otonnafuna, era tosobola kugaba ky’otalina. Pawulo yagamba nti emu ku nsonga ezisinga obulungi ez’okukola kwe kuba n’eky’okugabana n’abalala: “Abadde omubbi alekeraawo okubba, wabula anyiikirenga okukola eby’omugaso ng’akola n’emikono gye, alyoke afune ky’agabirako n’abo abeetaaga.” (Abaefeso 4:28).

Laba ekyo. Eyali omubbi takoma ku kulekera awo okubba. Atandika okukola, era akola alyoke agabe. Eyo ye ndowooza y’Ekikristaayo yonna ku nsimbi mu lunyiriri lumu.

Omulimu bwe gufuuka katonda

Wano waliwo n’okulabula. Omulimu mulungi, naye guyinza okufuuka katonda. Abamu ku ffe tukola nnyo okusukkiridde, si lwakuba Katonda yatuyita okukikola, wabula lwakuba tutya, oba tuluubirira okweyongerayo, oba tufuna omuwendo gwaffe okuva mu mulimu gwaffe. Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli agamba nti, “Oteganira bwereere bw’okeera mu makya n’okola, ate n’olwawo n’okwebaka ng’okolerera ekyokulya; kubanga Mukama abaagalwa be abawa otulo.” (Zabbuli 127:2).

Katonda yateeka olunaku olw’okuwummula mu wiiki okuva ku kutonda. Okuwummula kutujjukiza buli wiiki nti ensi teyesigama ku mulimu gwaffe. Tukola nnyo, ate ne tuyimirira, ne tukwasa Katonda bye tutamazizza.

Eddoboozi okuva mu biseera eby’edda

Omuwandiisi w’ekyasa ekkumi n’omunaana, William Law, yasaba abasomi be okwetegereza mu bwesimbu engeri gye bakozesaamu ensimbi zaabwe, mu ngeri ennyangu ng’omulimi bw’asobola okukubuulira ennimiro ze gye ziri:

“Buli muntu era asobola okutegeeza mu bwangu engeri gy’akozesaamu ensimbi ze, n’obanga alowooza ku ngeri y’okusanyusaamu Katonda mu kuzikozesa, nga bw’asobola okutegeeza ebintu bye gye biri, n’obanga biri mu nsimbi oba mu ttaka.”

William Law, A Serious Call to a Devout and Holy Life

Ky’okukola wiiki eno

Buli lunaku wiiki eno nga tonnatandika mulimu, k’abe mulimu ki gw’okola, gusabire ng’okozesa Abakkolosaayi 3:23: “Mukama wange, kino nkikola ku lulwo.” Wiiki bw’eneggwaako, weetegereze obanga kyakyusa engeri gy’okolamu, oba engeri gy’owuliramu ku mulimu gwo.

Ku lw’ebibinja

  • Wakula olowooza nti omulimu mukisa oba kikolimo? Endowooza eyo yava wa?
  • Kyandibadde kitya okukola omulimu gwo “ng’abakolera Mukama waffe” wiiki eno?
  • Soma Abaefeso 4:28. Kitubuulira ki ku kigendererwa ky’okufuna ensimbi?
  • Oli mwangu okufuula omulimu katonda, oba okugwewala? Okutebenkeza kwandirabise kutya gy’oli?

study_questions.question: Bayibuli egamba nti omulimu kikolimo?
study_questions.answer: Nedda. Katonda yawa Adamu omulimu mu Adeni ng’ekibi tekinnabaawo, “agirimenga era agikuumenga” (Olubereberye 2:15). Ekikolimo mu Olubereberye 3 kyafuula omulimu ogw’obulumi, naye tekyagufuula mubi. Omulimu gwava eri Katonda, Katonda Yennyini mukozi, era Yesu yamala ebiseera bye ebisinga obungi mu dduuka ly’omubazzi.

study_questions.question: Pawulo yali ategeeza ki bwe yagamba nti “omuntu yenna bw’agaananga okukola emirimu, n’okulya talyanga”?
study_questions.answer: Pawulo yali awandiikira abakkiriza mu Ssessaloniika abaali basobola okukola naye ne balekera awo, ne beemalira ku by’abalala. Si bukambwe eri abatasobola kukola, kubanga Bayibuli y’emu eragira okulabirira n’omutima omugabi abalwadde, abakadde, bannamwandu ne bamulekwa. Okukolera emmere yo kitundu ku kitiibwa kyo, era kikuziyiza okuba omugugu eri abalala.

study_questions.question: Omulimu ogwa bulijjo guyinza gutya okuba okusinza eri Omukristaayo?
study_questions.answer: Pawulo yagamba abaddu, abaalina emirimu egisinga obuzibu mu nsi ya Rooma, okukola “ng’abakolera Mukama waffe so si abantu” (Abakkolosaayi 3:23-24). Obanga ekyo kyali kituufu gye bali, kituufu ne ku spreadsheet, ku budde ku kasiisi k’edduuka oba ku kiro mu waadi y’eddwaliro. Eri Omukristaayo tewali mulimu gwa nsi gwokka; waliwo omulimu ogukolerwa Kristo oba ogwo gwe twekolera ffekka.

fields.title: Abakulu Babiri
fields.body_html:
Yesu teyagamba nti, “Tosaanidde kuweereza Katonda na mamona.” Yagamba nti, “Toyinza.”

“Tewali n’omu ayinza kuweereza bakulu babiri, kubanga alikyawako omu n’ayagala omulala oba aliwulirako omu n’anyooma omulala. Toyinza kuweereza Katonda na mamona.” (Matayo 6:24)

Lowooza ku makulu g’ekyo. Si tteeka. Kinnyonnyola ensonga bw’eri ddala, nga bw’oyinza okugamba nti toyinza kutambula mu bukiikakkono ne mu bukiikaddyo mu kiseera kye kimu. Ekiseera kijja kutuuka, mukama omu n’akulagira ekintu omulala ky’atandikulagidde, era nga kikwetaagisa okulonda. Ekiseera ekyo bwe kinaatuuka, ojja kuzuula ani gw’obadde oweereza ddala.

Ensimbi si kintu ekitaliiko ludda

Abantu abasinga obungi leero balowooza nti ensimbi kikozesebwa ekitaliiko ludda, nga ennyondo. Si nnungi era si mbi. Byonna bisinziira ku ngeri gy’ozikozesaamu. Mu ekyo mulimu amazima, era ne John Wesley yayogera ekintu ekifaanana bwe kityo, nga bwe tujja okulaba. Naye Yesu yayogera ekisingawo. Mu Matayo 6:24 tateeka Katonda ku ludda lumu n’ennyondo ku ludda olulala. Ateeka Katonda ku ludda lumu ne mukama ku ludda olulala.

Ekigambo ekiri mu nkyusa za Bayibuli ez’edda kye mamona, ekigambo eky’Oluarameeka ekitegeeza obugagga oba ebintu. Yesu akyogerako kumpi ng’omuntu, mukama omuvuganya ayagala obwesigwa bwo. Ensimbi si kikozesebwa kyokka. Zirina amaanyi ag’okusika. Zisuubiza. Ziwa obukuumi, ekitiibwa, obuweerero, eddembe n’obuyinza. Era zikusaba ozeesige.

Eyo y’ensonga lwaki Pawulo omululu aguyita “okusinza bakatonda abalala” (Abakkolosaayi 3:5), era lwaki alabula nti omuntu “eyeegomba, aba asinza bakatonda abalala, talina mugabo mu bwakabaka bwa Kristo ne Katonda” (Abaefeso 5:5). Ekifaananyi ekisinzibwa kye kintu kyonna kye tutunuulira okutuwa ekyo Katonda yekka ky’ayinza okuwa. Ensimbi ze katonda abantu ab’ekitiibwa gwe basinga okwagala, kubanga oyinza okuzisinza nga tolinnyeeko ku ssabo.

Nnyinza ntya okumanya gwe mpeereza?

Obanga ensimbi mukama asobola okwefunira obuyinza mu kasirise, nnyinza ntya okumanya obanga kino kimaze okubaawo? Bino bye bibuuzo eby’amazima by’oyinza okwebuuza.

Ebirowoozo byange bigenda wa nga siriiko kye nkola? Bw’oba ogalamidde ekiro nga otulo tekukwata, oba ng’ovuga, oba ng’olinze mu lunyiriri, olowooza ku ki? Bwe kiba nti okusinga olowooza ku nsimbi, okuzifuna, okuzisaasaanya, okuzeeraliikirira, ekyo kirina ky’ekikubuulira.

Kiki ekinneeraliikiriza? Tweraliikirira olw’ekyo kye twesiga. Bwe kiba nti okugwa kw’emiwendo mu katale k’emigabo oba ensimbi ennyingi z’olina okusasula bikuleetera okutya ennyo, kiyinza okuba nti obukuumi bwo bwe butudde awo.

Kiki kye sandirekedde? Yesu yagamba omufuzi omuvubuka omugagga atunde byonna by’alina amugoberere, omusajja n’agenda ng’anakuwadde, “kubanga yali mugagga nnyo” (Makko 10:22). Yesu tasaba buli muntu ekyo, naye yassa olunwe ku kintu ekimu omusajja oyo kye yali tayinza kuta. Kiki kye wandigaanye okulekayo singa Yesu akikusaba?

Engeri gye nsaasaanyaamu ensimbi eyogera ki? Ekiwandiiko kya bbanka kiringa ebyafaayo by’obulamu bwo. Kinyumya olugero lw’ebyo bye tutwala nga bya muwendo. Singa omuntu asoma ekikyo, yandigambye nti mukama wo y’ani?

Kiki kye nsooka okusalako? Mu bubaka bwe yabuulira ku lunyiriri luno lwennyini, omubuulizi Omuwelisi Martyn Lloyd-Jones yawa ekigezo ekizibu okwewogomako: “Ensimbi bwe zikaluba, ekintu kye tusooka okukendeeza kwe kuwaayo kwaffe eri omulimu gwa Katonda.” Ebiseera bwe bikaluba, kiki ekisooka okuvaawo?

Okukyawa omu n’okwagala omulala

Yesu agamba nti omuntu “alikyawako omu n’ayagala omulala.” Ekyo kiwulikika ng’ekigambo eky’amaanyi. Naye kirowoozeeko. Ensimbi bwe ziba mukama wo, ojja kunyiigiranga Katonda buli lw’akusaba okugaba, oba okumwesiga, oba okwogera amazima ng’obulimba bwandikuganyudde okusingawo. Oyinza obutakyogera mu lwatu, naye mu mutima mujja kubangamu okunyiiga okusirifu buli lwe bakuŋŋaanya ekiweebwayo, oba omuntu eyeetaaga obuyambi bw’ayita mu kkubo lyo.

Era Katonda bw’aba Mukama wo, ojja kutandika okulaba ensimbi nga bwe ziri ddala. Si katonda, wabula muddu. Si kintu kya kwagala, wabula kintu kya kukozesa ku lw’Oyo gw’oyagala ddala.

Kino tekitegeeza nti Abakristaayo basaanidde okunyooma ensimbi, nga tebazifaako oba nga tebeebaza olw’azo. Kitegeeza nti ensimbi ziggibwa ku ntebe ey’obwakabaka. Zizzibwa mu kifo kyazo, ne zibeera ekikozesebwa mu mukono gw’omuddu wa Katonda.

Okulonda mukama

Amawulire amalungi gali nti osobola okulonda. Yoswa yayimirira mu maaso ga Isirayiri n’abagamba nti “mulondeewo leero gwe munaaweerezanga” (Yoswa 24:15). Okulonda okwo kuli mu maaso ga buli Mukristaayo, era emirundi mingi tuteekwa okukukola okusingako omulundi gumu.

Bw’oti bw’okukola. Toyinza kugoba mukama omu ng’ofuba bufubi okusingawo. Weetaaga mukama omulungi okusingawo okudda mu kifo kye. Ensimbi mukama mukakanyavu. Bulijjo ayagala ebisingawo, era tagamba nti “Weebale.” Yesu mukama wa kisa. Agamba nti, “Ekikoligo kyange kyangu, n’omugugu gwange teguzitowa” (Matayo 11:30). Bwe tulaba obulungi bwe, ebisuubizo by’ensimbi bitandika okulabika ng’ebyereere.

Omuwandiisi w’Abaebbulaniya akyogera bulungi nnyo:

“Mwewalenga omululu, bye mulina bibamalenga. Kubanga Katonda yagamba nti, “Sirikuleka era sirikwabulira n’akatono.”” (Abaebbulaniya 13:5)

Lwaki tusobola okuba nga tetuli mu buddu bwa kwagala nsimbi? Kubanga Katonda yasuubiza obutatuleka n’akatono. Ensimbi zisuubiza obukuumi, naye ziyinza okuggwaawo mu lunaku lumu. Katonda ye bukuumi obwo ensimbi bwe zeefuula okuwa.

Eddoboozi okuva mu biseera eby’edda

A. W. Tozer yalaba nti emirundi mingi obuzibu tebweyoleka okutuusa ng’okulonda okwa nnamaddala kutuuse:

“Muwalirize okulonda wakati wa Katonda n’ensimbi, wakati wa Katonda n’abantu, wakati wa Katonda n’ebigendererwa bye ku bubwe, Katonda n’okwefaako yekka, Katonda n’okwagala kw’abantu, era Katonda ajja kuteekebwanga mu kifo eky’okubiri buli mulundi.”

A. W. Tozer, Okunoonya Katonda

Era Omupuliitaani Thomas Watson yateeka ensonga yonna mu sentensi emu:

“Bwe twesiga obugagga bwaffe, obugagga tubufuula katonda waffe.”

Thomas Watson, Amateeka Ekkumi

Ky’okukola wiiki eno

Ggyayo ekiwandiiko kya bbanka eky’omwezi oguwedde, oba ekiwandiiko ky’ebyo bye wasaasaanya. Kisome mpola, ng’ekiri eky’omuntu omulala. Weebuuze nti, “Omuntu ono ayagala ki? Omuntu ono yeesiga ki?” Oluvannyuma yogera ne Katonda mu bwesimbu ku ebyo by’olabye.

Ku lw’ebibinja

  • Lwaki mulowooza nti Yesu yagamba nti “toyinza” mu kifo kya “tosaanidde”?
  • Ku bibuuzo ebiri wansi wa “Nnyinza ntya okumanya gwe mpeereza?”, kiruwa ekyabakaluubirira okusinga okuddamu? Lwaki?
  • Musobola okujjukira ekiseera lwe mwali muteekwa okulonda wakati wa Katonda n’ensimbi? Kiki ekyaliwo?
  • Musome Abaebbulaniya 13:5. Ekisuubizo kya Katonda mu kitundu eky’okubiri eky’olunyiriri kifuula kitya ekiragiro ekiri mu kitundu ekisooka okusoboka?

study_questions.question: Lwaki Bayibuli eyita omululu okusinza bakatonda abalala?
study_questions.answer: Pawulo omululu aguyita “okusinza bakatonda abalala” (Abakkolosaayi 3:5) kubanga ekifaananyi ekisinzibwa kye kintu kyonna kye tutunuulira okutuwa ekyo Katonda yekka ky’ayinza okuwa. Yesu ayogera ku mamona kumpi nga mukama omuvuganya: ensimbi ziwa obukuumi, ekitiibwa, obuweerero, eddembe n’obuyinza, era zisaba okwesigibwa. Ze katonda abantu ab’ekitiibwa gwe basinga okwagala, kubanga oyinza okuzisinza nga tolinnyeeko ku ssabo.

study_questions.question: Omukristaayo ayinza atya okumanya obanga ensimbi zifuuse mukama we?
study_questions.answer: Essuula eno ewa ebigezo eby’amazima: ebirowoozo byo gye bigenda nga toliiko ky’okola, ekikweraliikiriza, kye wandigaanye okulekayo singa Yesu akikusaba, ekiwandiiko kyo ekya bbanka ky’ekyogera ku ebyo by’otwala nga bya muwendo, n’ekisooka okusalibwako ng’ebiseera bikaluba. Martyn Lloyd-Jones yalaga nti ekisooka okukendeezebwa emirundi mingi kwe “kuwaayo kwaffe eri omulimu gwa Katonda.”

study_questions.question: Omukristaayo ayinza atya okusumululwa okuva mu kuweereza ensimbi?
study_questions.answer: Si lwa kufuba bufubi okusingawo, wabula lwa kuleka mukama omulungi okusingawo okudda mu kifo kyazo. Ensimbi mukama mukakanyavu, bulijjo ayagala ebisingawo era tagamba nti “Weebale,” so nga Yesu agamba nti, “Ekikoligo kyange kyangu, n’omugugu gwange teguzitowa.” Bwe tulaba obulungi bwe, ebisuubizo by’ensimbi bitandika okulabika ng’ebyereere.

fields.title: Obugagga bwa Kristo
fields.body_html:
Pawulo yalina obuzibu mu kukuŋŋaanya ensimbi. Ekkanisa y’e Yerusaalemi yali nnaavu era ng’ebonaabona, era Pawulo yali akuŋŋaanya ensimbi okuva mu makanisa g’Abaamawanga okugiyamba. Abakkolinso baali basuubizza okugaba omwaka gumu emabega, naye tebaatuukiriza kye baasuubiza. Kyeyava abawandiikira ku nsonga eyo.

Ekyewuunyisa ye ngeri gye yakikolamu. Teyabaleetera kuwulira musango. Teyabasuubiza nti Katonda ajja kubasasula emirundi ebiri. Teyabateerawo muwendo gwa kutuukako. Wabula yabalaga Yesu:

“Kubanga mumanyi ekisa kya Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo nga bwe yafuka omwavu ku lwammwe, mwe mulyoke mugaggawale.” (2 Abakkolinso 8:9)

Eyo y’ensonga esinga obuziba lwaki Omukristaayo agaba. Si lwakuba nti tuwalirizibwa, wabula olw’ebyo Yesu bye yakola.

Yali mugagga

Lowooza ku bugagga Yesu bwe yalina. Nga tannajja ku nsi, yagabananga ekitiibwa kya Kitaawe. Ye yakola emmunyeenye. Buli malayika yamusinzanga. Buli kintu mu ggulu ne ku nsi kyali kikye, kubanga kyatondebwa ku bubwe era ku lulwe. Tewabangawo bugagga bufaanana ng’obugagga bw’Omwana wa Katonda ow’emirembe n’emirembe.

Yafuuka mwavu

Naye byonna yabireka. Pawulo agamba mu Abafiripi nti “yeewaayo n’afuuka ng’omuddu” (Abafiripi 2:7). Teyazaalibwa mu lubiri wabula mu kiraalo eky’okwazika, eri abazadde abaali basobola okuwaayo ekiweebwayo ky’abaavu kyokka, ebinyonyi bibiri, bwe baamwanjula mu yeekaalu. Yakulira mu kabuga akatono akaali n’erinnya ebbi. Yakolanga n’emikono gye. Mu kiseera ky’obuweereza bwe yagamba nti, “Ebibe birina obunnya mwe bisula, n’ennyonyi ez’omu bbanga zirina ebisu, naye Omwana w’Omuntu talina kifo kya kuwumulizaamu mutwe gwe.” (Matayo 8:20). Yaziikibwa mu ntaana ey’okwazika.

Naye obwavu bwe bwali bwa wala nnyo okusinga ensimbi. Ku musaalaba yafuuka mwavu mu ngeri gye tutasobola kutegeera bulungi. Yafiirwa okuwulira ng’ali ne Kitaawe. Yaggibwako engoye ze, mikwano gye, ekitiibwa kye, era ku nkomerero n’obulamu bwe. Yakaaba nti, “Katonda wange, Katonda wange, lwaki onjabulidde?” (Matayo 27:46). Yafuuka mwavu okutuuka ku kigero ekisingayo.

Tulyoke tugaggawale

Lwaki? “Ku lwammwe, mwe mulyoke mugaggawale.” Si bugagga bwa nsimbi. Pawulo tasuubiza Bakkolinso kufuna nsimbi nnyingi. Ayogera ku bugagga obusingako ennyo: okusonyiyibwa, okufuulibwa abaana mu maka ga Katonda, Omwoyo Omutukuvu abeera mu ffe, obulamu obutaggwaawo, n’omugabo mu busika bwa Kristo yennyini. Pawulo abuyita “emikisa egiri mu Kristo egitageraageraganyizika” (Abaefeso 3:8).

Buli kye twetaaga ennyo, Yesu yakitugulira ku muwendo gwa buli kye yalina. Twajja gy’ali nga twagwa mu bwavu obw’omwoyo, nga tetulina kye tuleese. Yasasula ebbanja lyaffe, n’oluvannyuma n’atufuula abasika be.

Lwaki kino kikyusa engeri gye tugabamu

Kino gwe musingi gwa buli kintu ekitabo kino kye kyogera ku kuba omugabi. Bw’okibuuka, okugaba kufuuka omulimu ogw’obuwaze, omusolo, engeri y’okwewulira obulungi, oba ekisinga obubi, engeri y’okugezaako okwefunira okusiimibwa Katonda. Ebyo byonna ku nkomerero bijja kukukooya.

Naye bw’olaba Yesu kye yakuwaayo, okugaba kufuuka okuddamu. Kubeera kujjula okuva mu mutima ogugaggawaziddwa, nga amazzi bwe gakulukuta. Pawulo agamba nti amakanisa g’e Makedoni, nago agaali amaavu ennyo, gaamwegayirira okugaweerako omukisa ogw’okugaba: “Mu kugezesebwa okw’okubonaabona, baagattika essanyu lyabwe ery’ekitalo n’obwavu bwabwe obungi, ne bafunamu okugaba okwewuunyizibwa ennyo.” (2 Abakkolinso 8:2). Kyabasobokera kitya? “Baasooka kwewaayo eri Mukama” (2 Abakkolinso 8:5). Omutima bwe guba gwa Yesu, ensawo y’ensimbi egoberera.

Ku nkomerero y’okwegayirira kwe okuwanvu, Pawulo tamaliriza na kiragiro. Amaliriza na kusinza:

“Katonda yeebazibwe olw’ekirabo ekitayogerekeka.” (2 Abakkolinso 9:15)

Buli kirabo kye tugaba kiba ng’eddoboozi ettono eriddamu ekirabo ekyo ekitayogerekeka.

Ekisa, so si kwewulira musango

Kino kitegeeza nti ekitabo kino kyonna kyogera ku kisa. Bw’oba ng’osoma essuula zino n’owulira ensonyi nga zeeyongera okukuzitoowerera, olw’amabanja ge weewola, olw’ensimbi ze wazannyirira, oba olw’ekitono ky’ogabye, komawo ku lunyiriri luno. Amawulire amalungi si “Fuba nnyo n’ensimbi zo.” Amawulire amalungi ge gano: Yesu yafuuka omwavu ggwe olyoke ogaggawale. Okulemererwa kwo mu nsimbi kuli mu bibi bye yeetikka. Omuwendo gwo eri Katonda tegulinnya era tegukka okusinziira ku nsimbi z’olina mu bbanka oba ku ngeri gy’obadde ogaba.

Tandikira awo. Sooka ofune obugagga bwe. Olwo, ng’omwana wa Katonda asonyiyiddwa era omugagga, tandika okuyiga engeri y’okukwatamu obugagga obutono bw’akuteeka mu mikono.

Omugagga eri Katonda

Waliwo ekintu ekirala kimu. Lumu Yesu yagera olugero lw’omulimi omugagga eyakungula amakungula mangi nnyo, n’asalawo okuzimba amaterekero amanene n’awummula mu ssanyu. Ekiro ekyo Katonda n’amugamba nti, “Musirusiru ggwe! Ekiro kino emmeeme yo eneekuggibwako.” Yesu n’ayongerako nti: “Bwe kityo bwe kiriba eri buli muntu eyeeterekera, so nga mwavu eri Katonda.” (Lukka 12:20-21).

Waliwo engeri bbiri ez’okuba omugagga. Oyinza okuba omugagga ku lulwo, oba oyinza okuba omugagga eri Katonda. Omulimi yalina amaterekero agajjudde naye ng’emmeeme ye njereere. Omukristaayo ayinza okuba n’amaterekero amatono, oba nga talina n’erimu, naye n’abeera omugagga ekitagambika, kubanga obugagga bwe buli mu Kristo.

Eddoboozi okuva mu biseera eby’edda

Charles Spurgeon, bwe yali afumiitiriza ku kwagala kwa Kristo, yeewuunya obungi bw’ebyo bye yagaba:

“Newaakubadde ng’ekimu eky’ekkumi eky’ebintu bye kyandigaggawazizza bamalayika bonna mu bwengula okusukka byonna omuntu by’ayinza okulowooza, kyokka teyamatira okutuusa lwe yatuwa byonna bye yalina.”

Charles H. Spurgeon, Morning by Morning

Ky’okukola wiiki eno

Wiiki eno, buli lunaku soma Abafiripi 2:5-11 mpola mpola. Buli lw’osoma, wandiika ekintu kimu Yesu kye yalekawo ku lulwo, n’ekintu kimu ky’akuwadde. Ku nkomerero ya wiiki, gaba ekirabo, eky’ensimbi, eky’obudde oba eky’obuyambi, ng’engeri ennyangu ey’okumwebaza olw’ekirabo kye.

Ku lw’ebibinja

  • Lwaki mulowooza Pawulo yalaga Abakkolinso Yesu mu kifo ky’okubagamba obugambi okutuukiriza ekisuubizo kyabwe?
  • Njawulo ki eriwo wakati w’okugaba olw’okuwulira omusango n’okugaba olw’okwebaza? Mwali muyiseemu byombi?
  • Musome 2 Abakkolinso 8:1-5. Kiki ekisinga okubewuunyisa ku b’e Makedoni?
  • Okuba “omugagga eri Katonda” kitegeeza ki gye muli mu bulamu obwa bulijjo?

study_questions.question: 2 Abakkolinso 8:9 kitegeeza ki bwe kigamba nti Yesu yafuuka mwavu tulyoke tugaggawale?
study_questions.answer: Yesu yagabananga ekitiibwa kya Kitaawe era ye yakola emmunyeenye, naye yeewaayo, n’azaalibwa eri abazadde abaavu, teyalina kifo kya kuwumulizaamu mutwe gwe, era ku musaalaba yafiirwa n’okuwulira ng’ali ne Kitaawe. Obugagga bw’atuwa si nsimbi wabula okusonyiyibwa, okufuulibwa abaana ba Katonda, Omwoyo Omutukuvu n’obulamu obutaggwaawo, “emikisa egiri mu Kristo.”

study_questions.question: Nsonga ki esinga obuziba lwaki Omukristaayo agaba ensimbi?
study_questions.answer: Si lwakuba nti tuwalirizibwa, wabula olw’ebyo Yesu bye yakola. Awatali musingi ogwo, okugaba kufuuka omulimu ogw’obuwaze, omusolo, engeri y’okwewulira obulungi, oba okugezaako okwefunira okusiimibwa Katonda, era kutukooya. Bwe tulaba Yesu kye yatuwaayo, okugaba kufuuka okuddamu, okujjula okuva mu mutima ogugaggawaziddwa.

study_questions.question: Abakristaayo basaanidde okukwatibwa ensonyi olw’okulemererwa kwabwe mu nsimbi okw’edda?
study_questions.answer: Amawulire amalungi si “Fuba nnyo n’ensimbi zo,” wabula nti Yesu yafuuka omwavu ggwe olyoke ogaggawale. Okulemererwa kwo mu nsimbi kuli mu bibi bye yeetikka, era omuwendo gwo eri Katonda tegulinnya era tegukka okusinziira ku nsimbi z’olina mu bbanka oba ku ngeri gy’obadde ogaba. Sooka ofune obugagga bwe, olwo oyige okukwata obugagga obutono bw’akuwadde.

fields.title: Omululu, Ekibi Abantu Kye Batanenya
fields.body_html:
Isirayiri bwe yasomoka Yoludaani, bbugwe wa Yeriko n’agwa, Katonda n’awa ekiragiro ekitegeerekeka. Effeeza ne zaabu by’ekibuga byali bya Katonda yekka. Tewali n’omu yali wa kutwalako wadde ekintu kimu.

Naye Akani yabitwalako. Oluvannyuma, bwe yazuulibwa, yannyonnyola bulungi engeri byonna gye byabaawo:

“Bwe nalaba nga mu munyago mulimu ekyambalo ekirungi ekyava e Sinaali n’ensimbi, n’effeeza ne zaabu ne mbyegomba, bwe ntyo ne mbitwala ne mbisimira mu ttaka mu weema yange.” (Yoswa 7:21)

Nalaba. Ne nneegomba. Ne ntwala. Ne nkweka. Eyo y’engeri ebibi bingi nnyo gye bizimbibwamu. Naye weetegereze we bitandikira. Tebitandikira ku kutwala, wabula ku kwegomba.

Etteeka ery’ekkumi

Mu Mateeka Ekkumi, mwenda gakwata nnyo ku bye tukola oba bye twogera. Ery’ekkumi ligenda butereevu mu mutima:

“Teweegombanga nnyumba ya muliraanwa wo. Teweegombanga mukazi wa muliraanwa wo, newaakubadde omuweereza we omusajja, newaakubadde omuweereza we omukazi, wadde ente ye, oba endogoyi ye, oba ekintu kyonna ekya muntu munno.” (Okuva 20:17)

Okwegomba kwe kwagala ekintu ekitali kikyo nnyo okutuusa nga kikukutte. Si kye kimu n’okwagala obwagazi ebintu. Oyinza okwagala ekkooti empya kubanga enkadde eyabika, era ekyo tekiriimu kabi. Omululu kwe kwagala okufuuse ekikunyweza, “singa nnina” ekitakkiriza kuwummula era ekirya okumalibwa. Gutunuulira ennyumba y’omulala, omulimu gwe, emmotoka ye, oluwummula lwe oba obulamu bwe ne gugamba nti, “Nze ekyo kinsaanira okusinga ye.”

Ekifuula omululu ogw’akabi ennyo kwe kuba nti tewali agulaba. Oyinza okukwatibwa olw’obubbi. Naye tolikwatibwa n’akatono olw’omululu. Gubeera mu mutima mu kasirise, era abantu tebaguvumirira n’akamu. Mu butuufu, ebirango bingi eby’omulembe guno bibaawo okugusiikuula. Tubeera mu kyuma ekyakolebwa okutufuula abatamalibwa.

Okusinga ebimala

Omusumba omukulu Omupulitaani Thomas Watson, bwe yali awandiika ku tteeka ery’ekkumi, yawa amakulu g’omululu agazibu okulongoosaako. Yagaggya ku Augustine, eyayita omululu Plus velle quam sat est. Mu bigambo bya Watson, ekyo kitegeeza “okwegomba okusinga ebimala.”

Okusinga ebimala. Ogwo gwe mutima gw’ensonga. Omululu tegukwata ku kuba na bingi oba bitono. Gukwata ku kulemwa okugamba nti “kimala.” Omwavu ayinza okuliibwa omululu. Omugagga ayinza okuba nga taguliiko. Kiri mu mbeera y’omutima, so si mu akawunti ya bbanka.

Sulemaani kino yali akimanyi okuva munda. Ye yali omusajja asinga obugagga mu mulembe gwe, era yawandiika nti:

“Oyo alulunkanira ensimbi, tasobola kuba na nsimbi zimumala; wadde oyo alulunkanira obugagga n’amagoba: na kino nakyo butaliimu.” (Omubuulizi 5:10)

Ekigambo ekivvuunuddwa wano “butaliimu” kye kigambo ekimanyiddwa ennyo eky’omu Mubuulizi. Mu Lwebbulaniya kitegeeza “omukka”: ekintu ekibula ng’omukka gw’omu kamwa ku makya ag’empewo. Okwagala ensimbi njala egeyongera gy’okoma okugiriisa. Bernard ow’e Clairvaux yalaba ekintu kye kimu emyaka 900 egiyise: “ka abe n’obugagga bwonna bw’alina, obutonde bwe bwegomba okufuna ebisingawo.”

Obulamu si bintu

Lumu omusajja omu mu kibiina yakoowoola Yesu nti, “Omuyigiriza, gamba muganda wange angabanyize ku by’obusika bwaffe.” (Lukka 12:13). Kyali kusaba kwa nsonga. Oboolyawo muganda we yali tamuyisa bwenkanya. Naye Yesu yagaana okweyingiza mu nsonga eyo. Wabula yakyukira ekibiina:

N’abagamba nti, “Mwekuume! Temululunkananga. Kubanga obulamu bw’omuntu tebugererwa ku bugagga bw’abeera nabwo.” (Lukka 12:15)

Yesu yalaba ekintu omusajja kye yali talaba. Wansi w’okwemulugunya okw’amateeka waaliwo obuzibu bw’omutima. Omusajja yalowooza nti bw’anaafuna omugabo gwe, obulamu bwe bunaalongooka. Yesu yagamba nti obulamu tebutambula bwe butyo. Obulamu bwo tebuzimbibwa ku by’olina.

Obwo bwe bulimba obunene omululu bwe gwogera: nti ekintu ekiddako kye kijja okukumala. Okukuzibwa okuddako, ennyumba eddako, ekipya ekiddako. Era bwe kijja, tekikumala. Bwe tutyo ne tunoonya ekiddako oluvannyuma lw’ekyo.

Lwaki omululu kya maanyi nnyo

Thomas Watson yalaga nti omululu gumenya buli limu ku Mateeka Ekkumi. Gumenya erisooka, kubanga “omusajja ow’omululu alina bakatonda abasukka mu omu; Mammona ye katonda we.” Gumenya ery’omunaana, kubanga gwe “kikolo ky’obubbi.” Gwamenya ery’omukaaga Kabaka Akabu bwe yeegomba ennimiro y’emizabbibu eya Nabosi ennyo n’aleka mukazi we okutta Nabosi alyoke agifune. Gumenya ery’omwenda buli muntu lw’alimba alyoke yeesonge mu maaso.

Okulabula kwa Bayibuli okusinga obukulu ku nsimbi kuva eri Pawulo:

“Weewaawo okutya Katonda kulimu amagoba mangi, omuntu bw’amalibwa mu ekyo ky’alina. Kubanga tetulina kye twajja nakyo mu nsi, era tetuliiko kye tuliggyamu nga tuvaamu. Naye bwe tuba n’emmere, n’ebyokwambala ebyo bitumalenga. Abo abaagala okugaggawala bagwa mu kukemebwa ne mu katego ak’okwegomba okw’obusirusiru era okw’akabi, okunnyika abantu mu kubula ne mu kuzikirira. Kubanga okululunkanira ensimbi y’ensibuko y’ebibi byonna, era olw’okululunkana okwo abamu bawabye, ne bava mu kukkiriza, ne beereetera obulumi bungi mu mitima gyabwe.” (1 Timoseewo 6:6-10)

Weetegereze ekifaananyi ekiri ku nkomerero: abantu abamu “bawabye, ne bava mu kukkiriza, ne beereetera obulumi bungi mu mitima gyabwe.” Omululu tegulumya balala bokka. Gufumita oyo yennyini ow’omululu. Gumuggyako otulo, enkolagana, emirembe, era oluusi n’okukkiriza kwennyini.

Engeri y’okulwanyisaamu omululu

Tosobola kulwanyisa mululu ng’ogezaako bugezi obutayagala bintu. Omutima tegusobola kusigala nga gwereere. Gusobola kujjuzibwamu kintu kisingako obulungi kyokka. Bino bye byokulwanyisa bina Bayibuli by’etuwa.

Okwebaza. Omululu gutunuulira bye tutalina. Okwebaza kutunuulira bye tulina. Kizibu nnyo okwebaza n’okwegomba omulundi gumu. Kufuule omuze okubala n’okwatula bye Katonda akuwadde.

Obugabi. Okugaba kwe kukontana butereevu n’okwefunyiriza. Buli lw’oyanjuluza omukono gwo okugaba, osumulula ensimbi ze zinywezezza omutima gwo. Eyo y’emu ku nsonga lwaki Pawulo agamba Timoseewo okulagira abagagga babeere “bagabi, era abaagala okugabana n’abalala” (1 Timoseewo 6:18).

Okukuuma amaaso go. Ekibi kya Akani kyatandika ne “nalaba.” Kiki ky’otunuulira? Amadirisa g’amaduuka, katalogi, ebiri ku mikutu gy’empuliziganya, ebirango by’amayumba, byonna biyinza okusiikuula okwegomba. Oluusi ekisinga amagezi kwe kulekera awo okutunula.

Okutwala Katonda ng’obugagga bwo. Ku nkomerero, omululu buzibu bwa kusinza. Omutima gwatondebwa okusanyukira mu Katonda, era bwe gutakikola, gugolola omukono eri ebintu ebirala. Noonya Ye okusingawo, era ojja kukizuula nti weetaaga bitono ku birala byonna.

Eddoboozi okuva mu biseera eby’edda

Thomas Watson yalina ekirabo eky’okwogera mu bifaananyi. Kino kye kimu ku bisinga obulungi:

“Ng’omusaabaza w’eryato bw’ayingiza abasaabaze bangi ennyo okwongera ku nsimbi z’afuna, n’abbiza eryato lye; bw’atyo omusajja ow’omululu ayingiza zaabu nnyingi nnyo okwongera ku bugagga bwe, ne yeebbiza mu kuzikirira.”

Thomas Watson, Amateeka Ekkumi

Ky’okukola wiiki eno

Okumala wiiki emu, weetegereze buli lw’owulira “singa nnina” ow’omululu: bw’olaba ennyumba y’omulala, emmotoka ye, oluwummula lwe, essimu ye oba omusaala gwe n’owulira ng’ekikufumita. Buli lwe kibaawo, yimirira, oyatule ekintu kimu ekyenkukunala Katonda ky’akuwadde dda, era omwebaze olw’ekyo. Edduuka, omukutu oba app bwe bikusiikuula obutamalibwa buli kiseera, biwummuleko okumala wiiki eyo.

Ku lw’ebibinja

  • Njawulo ki eriwo wakati w’okwagala ekintu n’okukyegomba?
  • Watson annyonnyola omululu nti “okwegomba okusinga ebimala.” “Ebimala” gy’oli bifaanana bitya?
  • Musome Lukka 12:13-15. Lwaki mulowooza nti Yesu yagaana okusala enkaayana z’obusika?
  • Ku byokulwanyisa ebina ebirwanyisa omululu, kiruwa ky’osinga okwetaaga kati?

study_questions.question: Etteeka ery’ekkumi litegeeza ki ku kwegomba?
study_questions.answer: Okwegomba kwe kwagala ekintu ekitali kikyo nnyo okutuusa nga kikukutte: “singa nnina” ekitakkiriza kuwummula, ekitunuulira ennyumba y’omulala, omulimu gwe oba obulamu bwe ne kigamba nti, “Nze ekyo kinsaanira okusinga ye.” Okwatula kwa Akani kulaga ekkubo lyakwo: nalaba, ne nneegomba, ne ntwala, ne nkweka. Tekutandikira ku kutwala, wabula ku kwegomba.

study_questions.question: Thomas Watson yannyonnyola atya omululu?
study_questions.answer: Ng’aggya ku Augustine, Watson yayita omululu Plus velle quam sat est, “okwegomba okusinga ebimala.” Tegukwata ku kuba na bingi oba bitono, wabula ku kulemwa okugamba nti “kimala”; n’olwekyo omwavu ayinza okuliibwa omululu ate omugagga n’aba nga taguliiko. Kiri mu mbeera y’omutima, so si mu akawunti ya bbanka.

study_questions.question: Omukristaayo ayinza atya okulwanyisa omululu?
study_questions.answer: Omutima tegusobola bugezi kusigala nga gwereere; guteekwa okujjuzibwamu ekintu ekisingako obulungi. Essuula eno eyogera ku byokulwanyisa bina: okwebaza, okulaba bye tulina dda; obugabi, okusumulula ensimbi ze zinywezezza omutima; okukuuma amaaso go, kubanga ekibi kya Akani kyatandika ne “nalaba”; n’okutwala Katonda ng’obugagga bwo, kubanga omululu mu kikolo buzibu bwa kusinza.

fields.title: Ekyama Ekiyigibwa eky’Okumalibwa
fields.body_html:
Pawulo yawandiika emu ku bbaluwa ezisinga essanyu mu Bayibuli ng’ali mu kkomera. Yali mu njegere, ng’alindirira okuwulira oba bagenda kumutta oba nedda. Mikwano gye ab’e Firipi baali bamuweerezza ekirabo eky’ensimbi, n’abawandiikira okubeebaza. Wakati mu bbaluwa eyo ey’okwebaza, n’ayogera ekintu ekyewuunyisa:

“Soogera kino olwokubanga Ndiko kye nneetaaga, kubanga mu buli mbeera gye mbaamu nayiga okumalibwanga. Mmanyi okubeera nga sirina kantu, era mmanyi okuba nga nnina buli kimu. Mu buli ngeri ne mu bintu byonna nayiga ekyama ekiri mu kukkusibwa ne mu kuba omuyala, mu kuba n’ebingi ne mu bwetaavu. Nnyinza okukola byonna mu oyo ampa amaanyi.” (Abafiripi 4:11-13)

Emirundi ebiri Pawulo akozesa ebigambo eby’okuyiga. “Nayiga okumalibwanga.” “Nayiga ekyama.” Okumalibwa si kintu Pawulo kye yazaalibwa nakyo. Tekyali mpisa ye ey’obuzaaliranwa. Kyali kumanya kwe yayiga, era yakuyigira mu ssomero ezzibu.

Okumalibwa kye kitali

Kirungi okutegeera bulungi okumalibwa kye kitali.

Si bugayaavu. Pawulo yakolanga nnyo, emirundi mingi ng’akola weema okutuusa obudde okukya, aleme kubeera mugugu ku makanisa. Omuntu amalibwa asobola okuba n’ebiruubirirwa n’abikolerera.

Si kwefuula. Pawulo teyeefuulanga nti talumwa njala nga alumwa. Enjala ye agyogerako lwatu. Okumalibwa si kwekaka kulabika ng’oli muzira.

Si kukkiriza butali bwenkanya. Bayibuli ejjudde okukaaba olw’obwenkanya eri abaavu. Omukristaayo amalibwa asobola okukola okukyusa enkola ezitali za bwenkanya, era asaanidde okukikola.

Era okumalibwa tekuli kwa biseera bizibu byokka. Weetegereze nti Pawulo agamba nti yayiga okumalibwa ng’alina bingi, nga bwe yayiga ng’ali mu bwetaavu. Ebingi birina okukemebwa kwabyo: amalala, okwesigama ku maanyi go, n’okwerabira Katonda. Okumalibwa ng’olina bingi kitegeeza obutafugibwa bye olina, n’obuteetaaga kwongerwako.

Okumalibwa kye ki

Kale kye ki? Okumalibwa mirembe egy’enkalakkalira mu Katonda egitasinziira ku mbeera. Kwe kusobola okugamba, ka akawunti yo ey’omu bbanka eyogere ki, nti, “Nnina ebimmala, kubanga nnina Katonda.”

Omuwandiisi w’Abaebbulaniya akugatta butereevu ku kubeerawo kwa Katonda: “Bye mulina bibamalenga. Kubanga Katonda yagamba nti, “Sirikuleka era sirikwabulira n’akatono.”” (Abaebbulaniya 13:5). Tusobola okumalibwa kubanga tetuli ffekka n’akatono. Kyonna kye tubulwa, tuli naye.

Mu Engero mulimu essaala ey’edda eyogera kino mu ngeri ennungi ennyo:

“Ebigambo eby’obutaliimu n’eby’obulimba binteeke wala, ate era tonjavuwazanga wadde okungaggawaza, naye ndiisanga emmere eya buli lunaku. Nneme okukkutanga ne nkwegaana ne njogera nti, “Mukama ye y’ani?” Era nnemenga okuba omwavu ne nziba, ne nvumisa erinnya lya Katonda wange.” (Engero 30:8-9)

Laba okusaba okwo: “Tonjavuwazanga wadde okungaggawaza.” Bameka abali basabye bwe batyo? Abasinga ku ffe tusaba okuwonyezebwa obwavu, naye twandyagadde nnyo okugezaako obugagga. Omuwandiisi alina amagezi okulaba nti byombi bya kabi. Ebingi ennyo, ayinza okwerabira Katonda. Ebitono ennyo, ayinza okukemebwa okubba. Kale asaba ebimumala byokka: “emmere eya buli lunaku.” Y’essaala y’emu Yesu gye yatuyigiriza: “Otuwenga emmere yaffe eya buli lunaku” (Matayo 6:11).

Pawulo bwe yakuyiga

Omuntu ayiga atya okumalibwa? Pawulo atubuulira ekyama mu sentensi eddako: “Nnyinza okukola byonna mu oyo ampa amaanyi.” Abantu batera okujuliza olunyiriri olwo ng’olwogera ku kuwangula empaka oba okuyita ebigezo. Naye bw’olusoma mu bigambo ebiruli okumpi, lwogera ku kumalibwa ng’olumwa enjala. Kristo y’awa amaanyi okubeera mu mirembe ng’olina bitono, n’amaanyi okusigala ng’oli muwombeefu ng’olina bingi.

Gano ge gamu ku masomo ag’omu ssomero eryo.

Jjukira nti byonna olibireka. “Kubanga tetulina kye twajja nakyo mu nsi, era tetuliiko kye tuliggyamu nga tuvaamu” (1 Timoseewo 6:7). Olugero olw’edda lugamba nti emmotoka etwala omufu tesika kigaali kya bintu emabega waayo. Bw’oba tosobola kukikuuma, tokikkiriza kukukuuma.

Weegeraageranye n’abali wansi wo, so si n’abali waggulu wo. Obutamalibwa bwaffe obusinga buva mu kwegeraageranya n’abantu abalina ebingi okutusinga. Abantu abasinga obungi mu nsi babeerako ku bitono nnyo okusinga abasinga obungi ku basoma ekitabo kino. Okwegeraageranya n’abo abalina ebitono kufuula obutamalibwa okwebaza.

Bala emikisa gyo, mu butuufu. Giwandiike. Okutuuma ebirabo bya Katonda amannya kwokka kuddamu okuteekateeka omutima.

Ebikweraliikiriza bifuule essaala. “Temweraliikiriranga kintu na kimu, wabula mu buli kintu mu kusabanga ne mu kwegayiriranga awamu n’okwebazanga, mutegeezenga Katonda bye mwetaaga. N’emirembe gya Katonda, egisukkiridde okutegeera kwammwe ginaabakuumanga amagezi gammwe n’emitima gyammwe mu Kristo Yesu” (Abafiripi 4:6-7). Weetegereze nti okumalibwa n’emirembe bijjira mu kusaba awamu n’okwebaza.

Obulamu bwo bufuule bwangu. Ebiseera ebimu ekkubo erituusa ku kumalibwa kwe kwetaaga ebitono. Buli kintu ky’olina kyetaaga okuterekebwa, okulongoosebwa, okuweebwa yinsuwa, okuddaabirizibwa, era ku nkomerero okusuulibwa. Ebintu ebitono biyinza okutegeeza eddembe erisingawo.

Okutya Katonda n’okumalibwa

Pawulo yagamba Timoseewo nti “Weewaawo okutya Katonda kulimu amagoba mangi, omuntu bw’amalibwa mu ekyo ky’alina” (1 Timoseewo 6:6). Waliwo eddiini ekozesebwa okugaggawala. Pawulo yali yaakalabula ku bantu “abalowooza ng’okufuna amagoba kwe kutya Katonda” (1 Timoseewo 6:5). Akikyusa. Okutya Katonda ddala kulimu amagoba mangi, naye si ga nsimbi. Amagoba ag’amazima bwe bulamu obw’okutya Katonda awamu n’omutima ogumalibwa. Obwo bwe bugagga obutayinza kukwatibwako kugwa kwa katale konna.

Zabbuli emanyiddwa ennyo ekyogera mu ngeri endala: “Ebitono omutuukirivu by’alina bisinga obugagga bw’ababi abangi” (Zabbuli 37:16). Ne Engero zigamba: “Okuba n’akatono ng’otya Mukama, kusinga okuba n’ebingi naye ng’oli mu mitawaana” (Engero 15:16).

Eddoboozi okuva mu biseera eby’edda

Mu Olugendo lw’Omutambuze, John Bunyan ayisa abatambuze be mu Kiwonvu ky’Okwetoowaza, ekifo eky’ekitoowaze abatambuze abasinga kye batya. Eyo basisinkana omulenzi omusumba ayambadde engoye embi, ng’amaaso ge gamasamasa era nga musanyufu, ng’ayimba yekka. Omukulembeze mu kitabo kya Bunyan agamba nti omulenzi oyo “ayambadde mu kifuba kye kingi ku kamera kali akayitibwa Emirembe-gy’Omutima” okusinga abantu abayambadde engoye ez’omuwendo omungi ennyo. Luno lwe luyimba lw’omulenzi:

“Mmatidde n’ebyo bye nnina, Bibe bitono oba bingi; Era, Mukama, nkyegomba okumatira, Kubanga abali bwe batyo ggwe obalokola.”

John Bunyan, Olugendo lw’Omutambuze

Ky’okukola wiiki eno

Twala Engero 30:8-9 ogisabe buli lunaku wiiki eno, mpola, ng’otegeeza buli ky’oyogera. Oluvannyuma, ku nkomerero ya buli lunaku, wandiika ebintu bisatu Katonda bye yakuwadde olunaku olwo by’otandyagadde kufiirwa. Wiiki bw’eneeggwaako, ojja kuba n’ebintu amakumi abiri mu kimu.

Ku lw’ebibinja

  • Pawulo agamba nti “yayiga” okumalibwa. Bintu ki ebikutuseeko mu bulamu bwo ebikuyigirizza okumalibwa, oba ebyalemwa okukuyigiriza?
  • Kiki ekikuzibuwalira okusinga: okumalibwa ng’olina bitono oba ng’olina bingi? Lwaki?
  • Soma Engero 30:8-9. Wandisobodde okusaba mu bwesimbu nti “Tonjavuwazanga wadde okungaggawaza”? Kiki ekikizibuwaza?
  • Kintu ki kimu ky’oyinza okwanguyiza mu bulamu bwo, osobole okwetaaga ebitono?

study_questions.question: Pawulo yali ategeeza ki bwe yagamba nti yayiga ekyama ky’okumalibwa?
study_questions.answer: Ng’awandiika ali mu kkomera, Pawulo yagamba nti “nayiga okumalibwanga” era nti “nayiga ekyama” eky’okubeera n’ebitono oba n’ebingi (Abafiripi 4:11-13). Okumalibwa tekwali mpisa ye, wabula kumanya kwe yayigira mu ssomero ezzibu: mirembe egy’enkalakkalira mu Katonda egigamba nti, ka akawunti y’omu bbanka eyogere ki, “Nnina ebimmala, kubanga nnina Katonda.”

study_questions.question: Abafiripi 4:13 eyogera ku kutuuka ku buwanguzi?
study_questions.answer: Nedda. Abantu bajuliza “Nnyinza okukola byonna mu oyo ampa amaanyi” ng’olunyiriri olwogera ku kuwangula empaka oba okuyita ebigezo. Naye mu bigambo ebiruli okumpi, lwogera ku kumalibwa ng’olumwa enjala. Kristo y’awa amaanyi okubeera mu mirembe ng’olina bitono, n’amaanyi okusigala ng’oli muwombeefu ng’olina bingi.

study_questions.question: Okumalibwa kw’Omukristaayo si kye kiruwa?
study_questions.answer: Si bugayaavu, kubanga Pawulo yakolanga weema okutuusa obudde okukya; si kwefuula, kubanga enjala ye yagyogerako lwatu; era si kukkiriza butali bwenkanya, kubanga Abakristaayo basaanidde okukola okukyusa enkola ezitali za bwenkanya. Era tekuli kwa biseera bizibu byokka, kubanga ebingi bireeta okukemebwa kwabyo: amalala, okwesigama ku maanyi go, n’okwerabira Katonda.

fields.title: Emmere ya Buli Lunaku, so si Kweraliikirira kwa Buli Lunaku
fields.body_html:
Okumala emyaka amakumi ana mu ddungu, Katonda yaliisa Isirayiri emmaanu. Buli ku makya yabanga ku ttaka ng’omusulo, era buli maka gaakuŋŋaanyanga bye gaali geetaaga ku lunaku olwo. Katonda yabawa etteeka ekkakali: temuterekanga ku yo okutuusa enkeera. Abantu abamu tebaamwesiga ne baterekayo endala. Enkeera yabanga ejjudde envunyu era nga ewunya.

Etteeka eryo lyalina ekigendererwa. Katonda yali ayigiriza abantu be okumwesiga lunaku ku lunaku. Era ekyamagero kyali nti bulijjo byatambulanga bulungi:

“Abaana ba Isirayiri ne bakola nga bwe baalagirwa; abamu ne bakuŋŋaanya nnyingi, n’abalala ntono. Bwe baagipimiranga mu kabakuli aka oma, ze lita ebbiri, oyo eyali akuŋŋaanyizza ennyingi teyasukkirizanga, n’oyo ow’entono nga teyeeseera. Buli muntu yakuŋŋaanyanga ng’okwetaaga kwe bwe kwabanga.” (Okuva 16:17-18)

Oluvannyuma lw’ebyasa bingi, Yesu yayigiriza abayigirizwa be okusaba nti, “Otuwenga emmere yaffe eya buli lunaku” (Matayo 6:11). Si mmere ya mwaka guno. Si mmere ya bulamu bwonna. Ya leero.

Yesu ku kweraliikirira

Mu Kubuulira ku Lusozi, amangu ddala ng’amaze okugamba nti “Toyinza kuweereza Katonda na mamona,” Yesu akyukira ekiwulira ekisinga okubeerawo ku nsimbi. Si mululu, wabula okweraliikirira.

“Noolwekyo mbagamba nti, Temweraliikiriranga bya bulamu bwammwe, bye munaalya oba bye munaanywa, wadde ebyokwambala. Kubanga obulamu businga ebyokulya, n’omubiri gusinga ebyambalo. Mulabire ku nnyonyi ez’omu bbanga! Tezisiga so tezikungula so tezikuŋŋaanyiza mmere mu tterekero, naye Kitammwe ali mu ggulu aziriisa. Naye mmwe temusinga nnyo ennyonyi ezo?” (Matayo 6:25-26)

Weetegereze ekigambo “Noolwekyo.” Okweraliikirira kukwatagana n’abakulu ababiri. Ensimbi bwe ziba mukama waffe, tezituleetera mululu kyokka. Zituleetera n’okweraliikirira. Ensimbi bwe ziba bwe bukuumi bwo, buli kabi akatiisa ensimbi zo kakutiisa ggwe. Era bulijjo wabaawo akabi.

Yesu awa ensonga eziwerako lwaki tetusaanidde kweraliikirira. Obulamu businga emmere. Kitaawo aliisa ennyonyi, era ggwe ozisinga nnyo. Okweraliikirira tekuyinza kwongera ku bulamu bwo wadde essaawa emu. Kitaawo amaze okumanya bye weetaaga. N’oluvannyuma akuwa ekkubo eddala ekkulu:

“Naye musooke munoonye obwakabaka bwa Katonda n’obutuukirivu bwe, ebyo byonna mulibyongerwako.” (Matayo 6:33)

Sooka Onoonye

Eno y’emu ku nnyiriri ezisinga obukulu mu kitabo kino. Yesu tagamba nti, “Tolowooza ku mmere na byakwambala.” Amanyi nti tubyetaaga. Agamba nti: kulembeza obwakabaka bwa Katonda, era weesige Kitaawo okukuwa bye weetaaga.

Kino si ndagaano ya kugula na kutunda, ng’olinga Katonda atubanja buli kye twagala kubanga twagenda mu kkanisa. Nsonga ya kukulembeza. Kiki ekifuna okufaayo kwo okusooka, amaanyi go agasinga obulungi, ensimbi zo ezisooka? Yesu agamba nti kisaanidde kubeera bwakabaka bwa Katonda: okufuga kwe mu bulamu bwo, ebigendererwa bye mu nsi, obutuukirivu bwe. Katonda bw’aba ow’olubereberye, ebirala byonna bigwa mu kifo kyabyo ekituufu, era Kitaffe yeetikka obuvunaanyizibwa ku bye twetaaga.

Era weetegereze nti kyogera ku bye twetaaga, so si bye twegomba. Katonda yasuubiza okutuwa bye twetaaga. Teyasuubiza kutuwa buli kye twegomba, era kitaffe omulungi teyandikikoze.

Okuteekateeka kwe kubulwa okukkiriza?

Omuntu ayinza okubuuza nti, “Kale Abakristaayo tebasaanidde kutereka, oba kuteekateeka, oba kugula yinsuwa? Ekyo si kubulwa kukkiriza?” Nedda. Bayibuli y’emu etugamba okuyigira ku binyomo, kubanga “byekuŋŋaanyiza emmere mu biseera eby’amakungula” (Engero 6:8), era Yesu yennyini yayogera ku kubalirira omuwendo ng’omuntu tannazimba mulungooti. Ekyo tujja kukyetegereza mu Kitundu eky’Okusatu.

Enjawulo eri wakati w’okuteekateeka n’okweraliikirira. Okuteekateeka kwe kuba n’obuvunaanyizibwa. Okweraliikirira kwe kwetikka omugugu Katonda yekka gw’asobola okusitula. Osobola okukola bajeti, n’oterekayo ensimbi, n’oluvannyuma ne weebaka mu mirembe, kubanga okoze ky’osobola n’olekera Katonda ebisigadde. Oba osobola okuba n’ensimbi nnyingi mu bbanka naye n’otasobola kwebaka olw’okutya. Si muwendo oguli ku akawunti yo ogusalawo. Kwe kwesiga.

Okwesiga ng’empisa ya buli lunaku

Tuva tutya mu kweraliikirira ne tutuuka ku kwesiga? Si mulundi gumu. Kiri ng’emmaanu: lunaku ku lunaku.

Fuula okweraliikirira kwo okusaba. Pawulo agamba nti, “Temweraliikiriranga kintu na kimu, wabula mu buli kintu mu kusabanga ne mu kwegayiriranga awamu n’okwebazanga, mutegeezenga Katonda bye mwetaaga” (Abafiripi 4:6). Buli ky’oweraliikirira kikuyita okusaba. Yatula erinnya ly’ebbaluwa y’okusasula, ery’ebbanja, ery’omulimu gw’otya okufiirwa, obikwase Kitaawo.

Jjukira by’akoze edda. Tunuulira emabega olabe Katonda bwe yakulabiriranga mu biseera ebyayita. Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli yawandiika nti, “Nnali muto kati nkaddiye, naye sirabanga batuukirivu nga balekeddwa ttayo, wadde abaana baabwe nga basabiriza ekyokulya” (Zabbuli 37:25).

Beera mu lunaku lwa leero. Yesu yagamba nti, “Noolwekyo temweraliikiriranga bya nkya. Kubanga olunaku olw’enkya lulyeraliikirira ebyalwo” (Matayo 6:34). Okweraliikirira kwaffe okusinga obungi ku nsimbi kukwata ku biseera eby’omu maaso: ebiyinza okubaawo. Katonda awa ekisa ku lwa leero, so si ku lw’enkya ez’okulowoozebwa obulowoozebwa ezitali za ddala.

Kola ekintu ekituufu ekiddako. Okwesiga tekitegeeza butakola kintu. Kitegeeza okukola ky’osobola n’olekera Katonda ebinaavaamu. Saba omulimu. Yogera ne bbanka. Sala ku nsaasaanya etali ya mugaso. Oluvannyuma wummula.

Olugero lw’okwesiga

George Müller yaddukanyanga amaka g’abaana bamulekwa mu Bristol mu kyasa ekya kkumi n’omwenda, ng’alabirira abaana enkumi n’enkumi okumala emyaka mingi. Yeeteerawo etteeka obutasaba muntu yenna nsimbi, wabula okutegeeza Katonda yekka bye yeetaaga. Emirundi mingi emmere teyabanga emala ku kijjulo ekiddako, era ye n’abakozi be ne basaba. Emirundi n’emirundi obuyambi bwajjanga, oluusi mu kaseera akasembayo. Ebitabo bye eby’olunaku ku lunaku bijjudde ebiwandiiko ebiraga ki ekyayingira era ddi.

Hudson Taylor, omuminsani e China, yayiga ekyo kyennyini ng’akyali muvubuka. Lumu yawaayo ssente ye esembayo, half-crown, eri amaka agaali gafa enjala. Enkeera ne wajja ebbaluwa nga temuli linnya wadde obubaka, wabula ggalavu ez’emikono ebbiri, nga munda mulimu half-sovereign, emirundi ena ku ekyo kye yali awaddeyo. Yawandiika nti “mu kaseera ako kennyini n’amalirira nti bbanka etayinza kugwa y’erina okukuuma bye nterese oba bye nfuna.”

Engero zino si nkola ya kugoberera buli kiseera. Katonda tayanukula bulijjo nga bwe yayanukula Müller ne Taylor, era bombi baayita mu biseera ebiwanvu eby’obwetaavu. Naye zitulaga Katonda ayinza okwesigibwa. Ye Kitaffe, era amanyi bye twetaaga.

Eddoboozi okuva mu biseera eby’edda

Charles Spurgeon, ng’awandiika ku bisuubizo bya Katonda, yateeka okulonda kuno mu sentensi emu:

“Okuyaayaana bwavu, n’okweraliikirira nnaku: okwesiga Katonda kye kyobugagga, n’okufaanana Katonda gwe musika ogw’omu ggulu.”

Charles H. Spurgeon, Ekitabo kya Cheeki eky’Ebbanka y’Okukkiriza

Ky’okukola wiiki eno

Wandiika ebintu bisatu ebisinga okukweraliikiriza ku nsimbi kaakano. Buli ku makya wiiki eno, sabira buli kimu ku byo, ng’okozesa Matayo 6:33 ne Abafiripi 4:6-7. Oluvannyuma ku buli kimu, wandiika ekintu kimu ekitono era ekisoboka ky’oyinza okukikolako, kikole, era ebisigadde obirekere Katonda.

Ku lw’ebibinja

  • Lwaki olowooza Yesu yateeka okuyigiriza ku kweraliikirira amangu ddala oluvannyuma lwa “Toyinza kuweereza Katonda na mamona”?
  • Njawulo ki eri wakati w’okuteekateeka n’okweraliikirira? Ggwe ensalo ogiteeka wa?
  • Osobola okutubuulira ku kiseera Katonda lwe yakulabirira mu ngeri gye watasuubira?
  • Ekiragiro kino, “musooke munoonye obwakabaka bwa Katonda,” kyandifaananye kitya mu nsimbi zo omwezi guno?

study_questions.question: Lwaki Katonda yagamba Isirayiri obutatereka mmaanu okutuusa enkeera?
study_questions.answer: Katonda yali ayigiriza abantu be okumwesiga lunaku ku lunaku. Abo abaaterekangayo endala baagisanganga ejjudde envunyu ku makya, naye oyo eyakuŋŋaanyanga ennyingi oba entono bulijjo yabanga n’emumala (Okuva 16:17-18). Yesu yayigiriza okwesiga kwe kumu okwa buli lunaku bwe yatugamba okusaba nti, “Otuwenga emmere yaffe eya buli lunaku.”

study_questions.question: Yesu ategeeza ki bw’agamba nti “musooke munoonye obwakabaka bwa Katonda” mu Matayo 6:33?
study_questions.answer: Si ndagaano ereetera Katonda okutubanjibwa buli kye twagala. Nsonga ya kukulembeza: okufuga kwa Katonda, ebigendererwa bye n’obutuukirivu bwe bye bifuna okufaayo kwaffe okusooka, amaanyi gaffe agasinga obulungi n’ensimbi zaffe ezisooka. Katonda bw’aba ow’olubereberye, ebirala byonna bigwa mu kifo kyabyo, era Kitaffe yeetikka obuvunaanyizibwa ku bye twetaaga, wadde nga yasuubiza bye twetaaga, so si bye twegomba.

study_questions.question: Omukristaayo ayinza atya okuva mu kweraliikirira ku nsimbi n’atuuka ku kwesiga Katonda?
study_questions.answer: Si mulundi gumu, wabula nga emmaanu, lunaku ku lunaku. Essuula eno eteesa okufuula okweraliikirira okusaba, okujjukira Katonda bye yakola edda ng’atulabirira, okubeera mu lunaku lwa leero kubanga “olunaku olw’enkya lulyeraliikirira ebyalwo,” n’okukola ekintu ekituufu ekiddako, gamba ng’okusaba omulimu oba okwogera ne bbanka, n’oluvannyuma okuwummula.

fields.title: Akabi k’Obugagga
fields.body_html:
Omuvubuka omugagga yaddukira eri Yesu n’afukamira mu maaso ge. Yali munyiikivu, mwesimbu era ng’atambulira mu mpisa ennungi. Yali akuumye amateeka okuva mu buto bwe. Yabuuza ekibuuzo ekisinga obukulu mu byonna: “Omuyigiriza omulungi, nsaanidde kukola ki okufuna obulamu obutaggwaawo?” (Makko 10:17).

Makko atubuulira ekintu ekirungi ennyo: “Yesu n’amutunuulira enkaliriza, n’amwagala.” Awo Yesu n’amugamba ekintu kimu omuvubuka oyo kye yali tayagala kuwulira:

“N’amugamba nti, “Waliwo ekintu kimu kyokka ekikubulako, era kye kino: genda otunde ebintu byonna by’olina, ensimbi z’onoggyamu ozigabire abaavu, oliba n’obugagga mu ggulu, olyoke ojje ongoberere.” Bwe yawulira ebigambo ebyo n’anyiikaala, n’agenda ng’anakuwadde, kubanga yali mugagga nnyo.” (Makko 10:21-22)

Yagenda ng’anakuwadde. Yali ayagala obulamu obutaggwaawo, naye ebintu bye yali abyagala okusingawo. Bwe yali ng’agenda, Yesu n’akyukira abayigirizwa be n’abagamba ekintu ekyabewuunyisa ennyo: “kyangu eŋŋamira okuyita mu nnyindo y’empiso, okusinga omugagga okuyingira mu bwakabaka bwa Katonda” (Matayo 19:24).

Lwaki obugagga bwa kabi

Abayigirizwa beewuunya kubanga mu buwangwa bwabwe, obugagga bwali butwalibwa ng’akabonero k’omukisa gwa Katonda. Abagagga bwe baba nga tebayinza kulokolebwa, kale ani ayinza okulokolebwa? Yesu yabaddamu nti eri Katonda byonna bisoboka. Omugagga asobola okulokolebwa. Ibulayimu, Yobu, Zaakayo ne Yusufu ow’e Alimasaya bonna bakyoleka. Naye kizibu, era Yesu yayagala abayigirizwa be bategeere ensonga.

Obugagga buvuganya ku bwesige bwaffe. Kizibu nnyo okwesigama ku Katonda ng’olabika nga tomwetaaga. Engero egamba nti, “Oyo eyeesiga obugagga bwe aligwa” (Engero 11:28). Gye tukoma okuba n’ebingi, gye tukoma okukemebwa okwesiga bye tulina.

Obugagga bubuutikira ekigambo. Mu lugero lw’omusizi, ensigo ezimu zigwa mu maggwa: “okweraliikirira kw’ebintu by’ensi n’obugagga obutaliimu ne bibuutikira ekigambo ne kitabala bibala” (Matayo 13:22). Weetegereze ebigambo “obugagga obutaliimu.” Obugagga busuubiza ebyo bye butasobola kuwa.

Obugagga butuleetera amalala. Pawulo yagamba Timoseewo okulagira abagagga “obuteekuluntaza, wadde okwesiga obugagga kubanga si bwa lubeerera” (1 Timoseewo 6:17). Ensimbi zisobola okutuleetera okuwulira nga tusinga abalala, ng’abali ab’omuwendo omunene kubanga tulina bingi.

Obugagga butuziba amaaso. Yesu yayogera n’ekkanisa y’e Lawodikiya, eyagambanga nti, “Ndi mugagga era nnina ebintu bingi, sso siriiko kye neetaaga. Sirina kimbulako!” Okuddamu kwe kwali kwa maanyi nnyo: “Sso n’otomanya ng’oli munaku asaasirwa, omwavu, omuzibe w’amaaso era ali obwereere” (Okubikkulirwa 3:17).

Obugagga butwerabiza abalala. Mu lugero lwa Yesu olw’omugagga ne Lazaalo, ekibi ky’omugagga si kuba nti yali mugagga. Kye kino: omusabiriza yagalamiranga ku mulyango gwe buli lunaku, naye n’atamulaba n’akamu.

Ebintu bwe bitufuga

A. W. Tozer yalaba nti ekizibu kiri wansi nnyo okusinga ensimbi. Kikwata ku kwekwatirira ebintu. Mu kitabo kye ekimanyiddwa ennyo, The Pursuit of God (Okunoonya Katonda), yawandiikamu essuula gye yatuuma “The Blessedness of Possessing Nothing” (Omukisa gw’Obutaba na Kintu ky’Okwekwatirira). Yannyonnyola omutima gw’omuntu bw’ati:

“Munda mu mutima gw’omuntu mulimu omulandira omugumu ennyo ogw’obulamu obwagwa, nga obutonde bwagwo kwe kwekwatirira, okwekwatirira bulijjo.”

Yagamba nti ng’omuntu tannagwa, ebintu byali bigendereddwa okubeeranga “ebweru w’omuntu era nga bimuweereza.” Naye kati, bwe yawandiika, “Emirandira gy’emitima gyaffe gikkiridde wansi mu bintu, era tetwaŋŋanga kusimbulamu wadde akalandira kamu, nga tutya okufa.”

Ako ke kabi. Si kuba nti tulina ebintu, wabula nti ebintu bitulina. Tekikwetaagisa kuba nnaggagga ow’amaanyi ekyo okubaawo. Osobola okukwatibwa essimu, emmotoka, engoye zo, oba akawunti y’okuterekamu ensimbi ey’obunene bwonna.

Tozer yasonga ku Ibulayimu ng’okuddamu. Katonda bwe yasaba Ibulayimu okuwaayo Isaaka, omwana we, ekintu kye yalina ekisinga okuba eky’omuwendo, Ibulayimu yagondera, era Katonda n’amuddiza Isaaka. Tozer yawandiika nti, “Yalina buli kimu, naye nga tewali ky’ekwatiridde.” Ibulayimu yali mugagga, naye byonna yabikwatanga n’omukono oguggule.

Obugagga bwe bweyongera

Okuddamu kwa Bayibuli ku kabi k’obugagga si nti buli Mukristaayo alina okulayira okubeera omwavu. Abakkiriza abasinga obungi mu Bayibuli tebaalagirwa kutunda buli kimu. Zaakayo yagabako kitundu, so si byonna. Yesu teyagamba Yusufu ow’e Alimasaya kutunda ntaana ye. Naye eri omusajja oyo omu obugagga bwe bwali ekifaananyi ekyamuziyiza okujja eri Yesu, yagamba nti, “Tunda buli kimu.”

Etteeka erya bulijjo liri mu Zabbuli: “Temuyitirira okwewaanirawaanira mu bugagga bwammwe ne bwe bweyongeranga, era temubumalirangako mwoyo gwammwe” (Zabbuli 62:10). Obugagga buyinza okujja. Si kibi mu bwabwo. Naye tobumalirangako mwoyo gwo.
