Oyinza otya okukuuma omutima gwo obutagwa ku bugagga nga bweyongera? Pawulo awa Timoseewo okuddamu okw’ebitundu bina ku lw’abagagga:

“Okuutirenga abagagga ab’omu mirembe gya kaakano, obuteekuluntaza, wadde okwesiga obugagga kubanga si bwa lubeerera, wabula beesige Katonda atuwa byonna olw’okwesanyusanga, bakole ebirungi, babe bagagga mu bikolwa ebirungi, nga bagabi, era abaagala okugabana n’abalala. Bwe batyo beeterekere obugagga obw’engeri eyo nga gwe musingi omulungi ogw’ebiseera ebigenda okujja, balyoke banywezenga obulamu bwennyini.” (1 Timoseewo 6:17-19)

Teweekulumbazanga. Teweesiganga bugagga bwo. Nyumirwa ebirabo bya Katonda ng’omwebaza. Era gabanga n’omutima omugabi. Ekisembayo kye kisumuluzo. Okugaba y’engeri omugagga gy’akuumamu obugagga bwe obutafuuka mukama we.

Oli mugagga?

Kyangu okusoma essuula eno n’olowooza nti eyogera ku bantu abalala, abannaggagga ab’amaanyi n’abantu abatutumufu. Naye bw’oba ng’olina akasolya waggulu w’omutwe gwo, emmere mu kabada, engoye ez’okwambala okusukka sizoni emu, n’ensimbi ezimu ezisigalawo ku nkomerero y’omwezi, oli mugagga okusinga abantu abasinga obungi abaali babaddewo ku nsi, n’abangi abalamu leero. Essuula eno yiyo. Era yange.

Eddoboozi okuva mu biseera eby’edda

John Wesley yalaba bangi ku bakyufu be abasooka nga bagaggawala olw’okukola ennyo n’okwekomako mu nsaasaanya, oluvannyuma ne banyogoga eri Katonda. Teyabagamba kulekera awo kukola. Yabalabula nti obugagga, okusobola okubeera nga tebuliiko kabi, bulina okugabibwa. Mu bubaka bwe obumu yabuuza nti:

“Mulowooza nti ensimbi, ne bwe zandyeyongedde ng’omusenyu gw’ennyanja, zisobola okuleeta essanyu?”

Ate awalala, mu bigambo ebyangu:

“Ensimbi tezitera kuleeta ssanyu, ka kube mu nsi eno oba mu nsi egenda okujja.”

John Wesley, Sermons on Several Occasions

Ky’okukola wiiki eno

Saba okusaba kwa Tozer okuva mu The Pursuit of God buli lunaku wiiki eno, ng’oyogera amannya g’ebintu byo ebimu: “Ai Katonda, ogulumizibwenga okusinga ebintu byange.” Oluvannyuma londako ekintu kimu ky’okwatirira ennyo, osalewo kye kyandibadde kitegeeza okukikwata n’omukono oguggule: okukiwola, okukigabana n’abalala, oba okukigaba.

Ku lw’ebibinja

  • Lwaki abayigirizwa beewuunya nnyo ebyo Yesu bye yayogera ku bagagga?
  • Soma endowooza ya Tozer nti ekizibu kwe “kwekwatirira.” Njawulo ki eriwo wakati w’okuba n’ebintu n’okubyekwatirira?
  • Bw’ogeraageranya n’ensi yonna, oli mugagga? Ekyo kikyusa kitya engeri gy’osomamu 1 Timoseewo 6:17-19?
  • Kintu ki kimu ky’okwatirira ennyo? Okukikwata nga tokinywezezza nnyo kwandifaananye kutya?

study_questions.question: Lwaki Yesu yagamba omuvubuka omugagga okutunda buli kimu?
study_questions.answer: Omuvubuka yali mwesimbu era ng’akuumye amateeka, era “Yesu n’amutunuulira enkaliriza, n’amwagala.” Naye obugagga bwe bwe bwali ekifaananyi ekyamuziyiza okujja eri Yesu, n’agenda ng’anakuwadde, “kubanga yali mugagga nnyo.” Yesu ekyo takisaba buli muntu: Zaakayo yagabako kitundu, ne Yusufu ow’e Alimasaya yasigaza entaana ye.

study_questions.question: Lwaki Bayibuli egamba nti obugagga bwa kabi?
study_questions.answer: Essuula eno ewa ensonga ttaano: obugagga buvuganya n’obwesige bwaffe mu Katonda, “obugagga obutaliimu” bubuutikira ekigambo ng’amaggwa, butuleetera amalala, butuziba amaaso nga bwe bwaziba ekkanisa y’e Lawodikiya, era butwerabiza abalala, ng’omugagga ataalaba Lazaalo ku mulyango gwe.

study_questions.question: Pawulo agamba abagagga Abakristaayo kukola ki mu 1 Timoseewo 6:17-19?
study_questions.answer: Obuteekulumbaza, obutateeka ssuubi lyabwe mu bugagga obutali bwa lubeerera wabula mu Katonda, okunyumirwa ebirabo bye nga beebaza, n’okugaba n’omutima omugabi n’okugabana n’abalala. Okugaba kye kisumuluzo: y’engeri omugagga gy’akuumamu obugagga obutafuuka mukama we, era kimuterekera obugagga, “balyoke banywezenga obulamu bwennyini.”

fields.title: Funa Kyonna ky’Osobola, mu Bwesimbu
fields.body_html:
Mu kyasa eky’ekkumi n’omunaana, John Wesley yabuulira obubaka obuyitibwa “Enkozesa y’Ensimbi.” Bwafuuka obumu ku bubaka obusinga okumanyika obwali bubuuliddwa ku nsonga eno, kubanga bwafunza okuyigiriza kwa Bayibuli mu mateeka asatu buli muntu g’asobola okujjukira:

Funa kyonna ky’osobola. Tereka kyonna ky’osobola. Gaba kyonna ky’osobola.

Ekyewuunyisa lye tteeka erisooka. Wesley yali musajja mutukuvu nnyo, era yabeeranga mu bulamu obwangu ennyo. Oyinza okulowooza nti yandigaanyizza abantu okukola ensimbi n’akatono. Wabula yatandika na “Funa kyonna ky’osobola,” era yali akitegeeza. Yagamba nti Abakristaayo basaanidde okukola ennyo n’okufuna obulungi, nga bakozesa “okutegeera kwonna Katonda kw’akuwadde.” Yagamba nti ensobi “teri mu nsimbi, wabula mu abo abazikozesa.”

Naye yateekako obukwakkulizo, era bukulu. Tulina okufuna kyonna kye tusobola nga tetulumya mibiri gyaffe oba obulamu bwaffe, nga tetulumya birowoozo byaffe oba emmeeme zaffe, era nga tetulumya muliraanwa waffe. Mu ngeri endala: funa kyonna ky’osobola, mu bwesimbu.

Ebipimo ebituufu

Bayibuli eyogera bingi ku ngeri ensimbi gye zifunibwamu, so si ku ngeri gye zisaasaanyizibwamu kyokka. Ekimu ku biragiro byayo ebiddiŋŋanwa ennyo kikwata ku bipimo n’ebigero. Mu nsi ey’edda, okugula n’okutunda kwali kwetaagisa okupima ebintu oba effeeza ku minzaani. Omusuubuzi atali mwesimbu yasobolanga okuba n’ebipimo ebya mirundi ebiri, ekizito ky’agulisa n’ekiwewufu ky’atundisa, n’alyazaamaanya buli mugula katono.

Katonda akikyawa:

“Minzaani eteri ya mazima ya muzizo eri Mukama, naye ebipimo ebituufu bye bimusanyusa.” (Engero 11:1)

Nnabbi Amosi yanenya abasuubuzi ab’omu kiseera kye abaali beesunga ennaku entukuvu ziggweeko basobole okuddayo mu bya maduuka gaabwe, ng’abagamba nti: “Mukozesa minzaani enkyamu ne mwongera emiwendo ne mukozesa n’ebipimo ebitatuuse, mmwe abagula abaavu n’effeeza” (Amosi 8:5-6). Baagendanga okusinza, naye emitima gyabwe gyali mu maduuka gaabwe, era amaduuka gaabwe gaali gazimbiddwa ku bukumpanya.

Leero tetukozesa minzaani ng’ezo, naye etteeka lye limu. Minzaani eteri ya mazima efaanana ng’invoyisi egejjeddwa, ssente ezikwekeddwa, ekirango ekibuzaabuza, okusaba ssente z’ebyakozesebwa ezitali ntuufu, omusolo ogutasasuddwa, “omulimu ogw’ensimbi enkalu” okwewala okulaga ennyingiza, oba okutunda ekintu ekirina obuzibu bw’omanyi naye n’otobwogerako. Era efaanana ng’omukozi afuna omusaala gwonna ku mulimu ogw’ekitundu. Katonda byonna abiraba, era bimukwatako.

Akatono akafune mu butuukirivu

Engero ziwa omukozi omwesimbu ekisuubizo n’okulabula:

“Ensimbi enkumpanye ziggwaawo, naye ezijja empolampola zeeyongera obungi.” (Engero 13:11)

Waliwo obugagga obujja amangu: okuwangula akalulu, enteekateeka z’okugaggawala amangu, n’endagaano ez’enkwe. Era waliwo obujja empolampola, katono katono, okuyita mu kukola mu bwesimbu n’okutereka n’obugumiikiriza. Bayibuli yeegendereza obusooka era etendereza obwokubiri. “Omusajja omwesigwa aliweebwa emikisa mingi, naye oyo ayanguyiriza okugaggawala talirema kubonerezebwa” (Engero 28:20).

N’okusingawo: “Akatono akafune mu butuukirivu, kasinga obugagga obungi obufune mu bukyamu” (Engero 16:8). Obwesimbu bwa muwendo okusinga ennyingiza. Bw’oba olina okulonda wakati w’okufiirwa ensimbi n’okufiirwa obwesimbu bwo, kkiriza okufiirwa ensimbi.

Okukola mu bwesimbu kufaanana kutya

Bino bye bimu ku bubonero bw’okukola mu bwesimbu eri Omukristaayo.

Kola omulimu gw’olunaku lwonna. Ka obe ng’okolera mukama wo oba weekolera, waayo ekyo ky’osasulirwa. Pawulo agamba abakozi nti, “Si kubasanyusa lwa kubanga babalaba, naye mubagonderenga n’omutima ogutaliimu bukuusa” (Abakkolosaayi 3:22).

Saba omuwendo ogw’ensonga. Tokozesa butamanya oba obwetaavu bw’abantu okubanyunyunta. Zaakayo omusolooza w’omusolo, Yesu bwe yajja mu nnyumba ye, yasuubiza okuddizaawo emirundi ena buli kye yali aggyeko omuntu mu bukumpanya (Lukka 19:8).

Sasula mu bwenkanya. Bw’oba ng’olina b’okozesa, basasule mangu era mu bwenkanya. Yakobo alabula bannannyini ttaka abagagga nti, “Laba abakozi abaakola mu nnimiro zammwe ne mulyazaamaanya empeera yaabwe, bakaaba, n’abaakungula bakungubaga, era amaloboozi g’okwaziirana kwabwe gatuuse mu matu ga Mukama ow’Eggye” (Yakobo 5:4). Katonda awulira okukaaba kw’abakozi abatasasulwa bulungi.

Sasula omusolo. Yesu yagamba nti, “Kale ebya Kayisaali mubiwenga Kayisaali, n’ebya Katonda mubiwenga Katonda” (Matayo 22:21). Pawulo ayogera kye kimu: “Abantu bonna basasulenga ebibabanjibwa; musasulenga emisolo eri abo be muteekwa okuwa omusolo” (Abaruumi 13:7).

Londa omulimu gwo n’amagezi. Wesley yalabula ku buli mulimu ogulumya omubiri oba emmeeme y’omukozi oba ey’omuguzi. Waliwo engeri ezimu ez’okufunamu ensimbi Omukristaayo z’atasaanidde kukozesa n’akatono, ne bwe ziba nga zireeta amagoba mangi.

Malibwa omusaala gwo, naye era saba ekyo ekituufu. Abaserikale bwe baabuuza Yokaana Omubatiza okwenenya bwe kwandifaananye gye bali, yabagamba nti, “Temuggyangako bantu nsimbi zaabwe. So temubawaayirizanga, n’empeera ebaweebwa ebamalenga” (Lukka 3:14). Waliwo okumalibwa okw’okutya Katonda okutaabeera mu kwemulugunya bulijjo. Ekyo tekitegeeza nti tosobola n’akatono kusaba kwongezebwa musaala oba kunoonya mulimu mulungi okusingawo. Kitegeeza nti tokozesa kifo kyo kunyakula ekitali kyo.

Lwaki obwesimbu buba bujulizi

Okukola emirimu mu bwesimbu y’emu ku ngeri ez’amaanyi ennyo Omukristaayo z’asobola okulagamu ensi Katonda bw’ali. Abantu bayinza obutasoma Bayibuli yo n’akatono, naye bajja kusoma invoyisi zo. Omukozi wa payipu Omukristaayo bw’agaana okusaba ssente ezisukkiridde, omukozi Omukristaayo bw’akkiriza ensobi gye yakola eyafiiriza kampuni ensimbi, nnannyini bizinensi Omukristaayo bw’asasula abamuleetera ebintu mu budde, abantu bakiraba.

N’ekikontana nakyo kituufu. Ebintu bitono ebyonoona erinnya lya Yesu okusinga Abakristaayo abakumpanya mu bizinensi. “Erinnya eddungi lyagalibwa okusinga eby’obugagga ebingi” (Engero 22:1).

Funa kyonna ky’osobola

Tobuusa maaso ludda olulungi. Wesley ddala yagamba nti, “Funa kyonna ky’osobola.” Tewali butukuvu bwonna mu kuba omwavu olw’obugayaavu oba obulagajjavu. Katonda bw’aba yakuwa obusobozi, bukozese. Kola nnyo. Yiga obukugu obupya. Zimba bizinensi bw’oba ng’olina ekirabo ekyo. Saba omusaala ogw’ensonga. Omukristaayo afuna obulungi era agaba n’omutima omugabi asobola okukola ebirungi bingi nnyo.

Kyokka jjukira nti etteeka erisooka lye tteeka erisooka kyokka. Okufuna si kye kigendererwa. Ye ntandikwa y’okutereka n’okugaba, nga bwe tujja okulaba. Wesley yalabula nti abo abagondera etteeka erisooka ne bakoma awo bali mu kabi kanene.

Eddoboozi okuva mu biseera eby’edda

Charles Spurgeon, ng’asoma olugero olukwata ku kwanguyiriza okugaggawala, yawandiika bw’ati:

“Oyo ayanguyiriza okugaggawala taabeere mutuukirivu wadde ow’obukakafu; naye okunyiikira n’obwesimbu, ne bwe kutaaleeta bugagga, mazima kulireeta emirembe.”

Charles H. Spurgeon, Ekitabo kya Cheeki eky’Ebbanka y’Okukkiriza

Ne Wesley, mu “Enkozesa y’Ensimbi”:

“Funa kyonna ky’osobola ng’okola n’obunyiikivu obw’obwesimbu.”

John Wesley, Enkozesa y’Ensimbi

Ky’okukola wiiki eno

Kebera obwesimbu bwo ku mulimu gwo ne mu nsimbi zo. Waliwo ky’okola ku mulimu kye wandikwatiddwa ensonyi Yesu okukiraba? Waliwo omusolo gwe weewala okusasula, ssente z’ebyakozesebwa ze wagejja, oba omuguzi gwe wasaba ssente ezisukkiridde? Bwe kiba bwe kityo, kitereeze wiiki eno, ne bwe kiba nga kijja kukufiiriza. Bw’oba osobola, ziddizeewo, nga Zaakayo bwe yakola.

Ku lw’ebibinja

  • Lwaki mulowooza Wesley yatandika amateeka ge asatu na “Funa kyonna ky’osobola” mu kifo kya “Gaba kyonna ky’osobola”?
  • “Minzaani eteri ya mazima” ez’omulembe guno ze ziruwa?
  • Musome Engero 13:11 ne 28:20. Lwaki Bayibuli yeegendereza nnyo okugaggawala amangu?
  • Obwesimbu bw’omuntu mu bizinensi, oba obutabaamu bwesimbu, bukosezza butya endaba yo ku kukkiriza kwe?

study_questions.question: John Wesley yali ategeeza ki bwe yagamba nti “Funa kyonna ky’osobola”?
study_questions.answer: Mu bubaka bwe “Enkozesa y’Ensimbi,” Wesley yakubiriza Abakristaayo okukola ennyo n’okufuna obulungi, ng’agamba nti ensobi “teri mu nsimbi, wabula mu abo abazikozesa.” Naye yateekawo obukwakkulizo: funa nga tolumya mubiri gwo, birowoozo byo oba emmeeme yo, wadde muliraanwa wo. Okufuna lye tteeka erisooka kyokka, entandikwa y’okutereka n’okugaba.

study_questions.question: Bubonero ki obw’okukola mu bwesimbu eri Omukristaayo?
study_questions.answer: Kola omulimu gw’olunaku lwonna n’omutima ogutaliimu bukuusa, saba omuwendo ogw’ensonga, sasula b’okozesa mangu era mu bwenkanya, sasula omusolo gwo, londa omulimu ogutalumya mubiri oba mmeeme ya muntu yenna, era malibwa omusaala gwo nga tonyakula kitali kyo. Zaakayo, eyasuubiza okuddizaawo emirundi ena kye yali akumpanyizza, alaga nti kino kya maanyi nnyo.

study_questions.question: Lwaki obwesimbu mu bizinensi buba bujulizi bw’Omukristaayo?
study_questions.answer: Abantu bayinza obutasoma Bayibuli yo n’akatono, naye bajja kusoma invoyisi zo. Omukozi wa payipu agaana okusaba ssente ezisukkiridde oba omukozi akkiriza ensobi eyafiiriza kampuni alaga ensi Katonda bw’ali, so ng’Abakristaayo abakumpanya bonoona erinnya lya Yesu. “Akatono akafune mu butuukirivu, kasinga obugagga obungi obufune mu bukyamu” (Engero 16:8).

fields.title: Balirira Omuwendo
fields.body_html:
Yesu yali mutabani w’omuzimbi. Yali amanyi bulungi ennyumba etaggweerawo bw’efaanana.

“Singa omu ku mmwe ayagala okuzimba omulungooti, tamala kutuula n’abalirira omuwendo omulimu ogwo gwe gunaatwala, n’alaba obanga ensimbi ezeetaagibwa azirina okugumaliriza?” (Lukka 14:28)

Mu lugero, omusajja atateekateeka azimba omusingi, ensimbi ne zimuggwako, n’afuuka eky’okusekererwa. Buli ayitawo amusekerera: “Omuntu ono yatandika okuzimba naye n’alemwa okumaliriza!” (Lukka 14:30).

Yesu yagera olugero luno okuyigiriza ku kuyitibwa okuba omuyigirizwa. Okumugoberera kukusaba buli kimu, kale balirira omuwendo nga tonnatandika. Naye yakozesa ekyokulabirako eky’ensimbi ez’obulijjo kubanga amazima gaakyo geeyolefu nnyo. Abantu ab’amagezi bateekateeka nga tebannasaasaanya.

Amagezi gateekateeka

Ekitabo ky’Engero, ekijjudde amagezi ag’omugaso ku nsimbi, kiddiŋŋana ekirowoozo kino emirundi mingi:

“Enteekateeka z’omunyiikivu zivaamu magoba meereere, naye okwanguyiriza okutalina nteekateeka kuvaamu bwavu.” (Engero 21:5)

Okuteekateeka n’obunyiikivu bivaamu ebingi. Okwanguyiriza kuvaamu obwavu. Ekyo kya mazima leero nga bwe kyali emyaka enkumi ssatu egiyise. Okugula ebintu nga tolowoozezza, okusaasaanya awatali nteekateeka n’okusalawo mu bwangu bye bimu ku bisinga okuleetera abantu okugwa mu buzibu bw’ensimbi.

Engero zituweereza eri abasomesa abasinga obutono:

“Yigira ku biwuka, mugayaavu ggwe; fumiitiriza engeri gye bikolamu obiyigireko. Tebirina mukulembeze, mukungu oba mufuzi yenna abikulembera, kyokka byekuŋŋaanyiza emmere mu biseera eby’amakungula, ne bitereka emmere mu biseera ebituufu mu mwaka.” (Engero 6:6-8)

Ekiwuka ekyo kiteekateeka nga bukyali. Bwe wabaawo ebingi, kiterekako ebimu eby’ekiseera ekizibu. Tekyetaaga mukama kukigamba kukikola. Kirina magezi bugezi.

Manya embeera y’ekisibo kyo

Waliwo n’olugero olulala olwandibadde luwandiikiddwa buli muntu alina akawunti mu bbanka:

“Okakasanga nti omanyi bulungi embeera z’ekisibo kyo, ossangayo omwoyo ku ggana lyo. Kubanga eby’obugagga tebibeerera mirembe gyonna, n’engule tebeerera mirembe gyonna.” (Engero 27:23-24)

Mu nsi ey’obulimi, ebisibo n’amagana bye byali obugagga bwo. Omulimi ow’amagezi yali amanyi endiga mmeka z’alina, eziri obulwadde, n’engeri endiga gye zizaalamu obulungi. Teyabirekera mukisa.

Leero ekyo kitegeeza okumanya ensimbi ezikuyingirira, ezikuvaako, n’ebbanja ly’olina. Abantu bangi, nga mw’otwalidde n’Abakristaayo bangi, tebamanyi n’akatono ensimbi zaabwe gye zigenda buli mwezi. Beewuunya nga ziweddewo. Okumanya embeera y’ekisibo kyo si kintu kitali kya mwoyo. Bwe bwesigwa obwangu. Tosobola kulabirira ky’otapima.

Bajeti nteekateeka

Bajeti teri kirala wabula enteekateeka y’ensimbi zo. Kwe kusalawo nga bukyali ensimbi za Katonda gye zinaagenda, mu kifo ky’okuzuula oluvannyuma gye zaagenda. Teyeetaaga kuba nzibu. Mu ngeri yaayo esinga obwangu, erina ebitundu bina:

  • Ebikuyingirira. Ensimbi z’ofuna ng’omusolo gumaze okuggibwako.
  • Ebisooka okugenda eri Katonda. Okugaba kwo, kw’osalawo nga bukyali (laba essuula 13).
  • Ebyetaagisa okubeera mu bulamu. Ennyumba, emmere, amazzi n’amasannyalaze, entambula, okusasula amabanja.
  • Ebisigaddewo. Okuterekako, oluvannyuma n’ebirala by’osaasaanyiza.

Ku nkomerero y’ekitabo kino waliwo enteekateeka y’ensimbi ennyangu ku lupapula lumu (Ebyongerezeddwako 2). Bw’oba tonnakolaako bajeti, tandikira awo. Oyinza okuwulira ng’ekuziyiza mu kusooka, naye abantu abasinga bazuula nti ebaleetera eddembe. Mu kifo ky’okwewulira omusango n’okweraliikirira okutategeerekeka ku nsimbi, oba olina enteekateeka. Osobola okusaasaanya ebiri mu nteekateeka nga teweeraliikirira, kubanga omanyi nti bisasulibwa.

Tereka kyonna ky’osobola

Etteeka lya Wesley ery’okubiri lyali “Tereka kyonna ky’osobola.” Kino okusinga kyonna yali ategeeza nti: tozannyira nsimbi. Tozisaasaanyiza ku bintu ebiriisa obuliisa amalala, okwemanya oba okwagala okulabibwa. Beeranga mu bulamu obwangu, ebisingawo bisigalewo.

Naye Bayibuli era esiima okutereka mu makulu ag’omu biseera bino, okuteeka ebimu ku bbali olw’ebiseera eby’omu maaso. “Mu nnyumba y’omutuukirivu mubaamu eby’obugagga eby’omuwendo, naye omusirusiru ebibye byonna abyonoona.” (Engero 21:20). Omusirusiru asaasaanya byonna amangu ddala nga bw’abifunye. Omuntu ow’amagezi aterekako ekimu.

Yusufu yawonya Misiri enjala ng’atereka emmere ey’empeke mu myaka omusanvu egy’ebingi. Pawulo yagamba Abakkolinso okussangako ensimbi ku bbali buli kiseera, “Buli omu ku mmwe ng’asinziira ku kufuna kwe mu wiiki, abengako ky’atereka” (1 Abakkolinso 16:2), zibeere nga zeetegefu nga zeetaagiddwa.

Okutereka kukuwa ebbanga: w’okussiza omukka emmotoka bw’efa oba ekyuma ekibugumya amazzi bwe kyonooneka, akazibu akatono kaleme kufuuka bbanja. Kitegeeza nti osobola okugamba nti yee Katonda bw’akussaako obwetaavu mu maaso go. Era kitegeeza nti ab’omu maka go tebajja kuba mugugu ku balala.

Okutereka bwe kufuuka okukuŋŋaanya

Naye waliwo ensalo, era Yesu yagiteeka lwatu mu lugero lw’omugagga omusirusiru. Obuzibu bw’omusajja oyo tebwali nti yatereka. Bwali nti yatereka buli kimu ku lulwe yekka, n’azimba amawanika amanene era amanene okusingawo, n’ateekateeka okumala obulamu bwe ng’alya, ng’anywa era ng’asanyuka. Yatereka olw’okwefaako yekka n’okwagala obukuumi obutali mu Katonda. Era yafa ekiro ekyo.

Omanya otya nti osomose ensalo okuva ku kutereka okudda ku kukuŋŋaanya? Weebuuze lwaki oterekayo. Okutereka olw’ekigendererwa ekimanyiddwa era eky’amagezi, nga ensimbi ez’obwetaavu obw’amangu, ennyumba, ebyetaago by’abaana bo oba obukadde bwo, kwe kuwanika okulungi. Okutereka obutakoma nga tolina kigendererwa kirala okuggyako okwewulira ng’oli mu bukuumi kiyinza okuba akabonero nti ensimbi zifuuse obukuumi bwo mu kifo kya Katonda. Okugezesa okulungi kwe kulaba obanga okugaba kwo kweyongera ng’ebyo by’oterese byeyongera. Bw’oba oterekayo bingi nnyo naye ng’ogaba kye kimu oba kitono, oboolyawo waliwo ekitali kituufu.

Saasaanya bulungi

Ekisembayo, okuteekateeka kuzingiramu n’okusaasaanya. Okusaasaanya ensimbi si kibi. Katonda “atuwa byonna olw’okwesanyusanga” (1 Timoseewo 6:17). Oluwummula, okulya emmere ebweru, ekirabo eri omuntu gw’oyagala, ekintu ekirungi eky’omu nnyumba yo: bino byonna bisobola okufunibwa n’okwebaza. Ekibuuzo si kya kuba nti osaasaanya oba nedda, wabula oba osaasaanya n’amagezi era n’okwebaza, ng’omuwanika.

Spurgeon, mu kitabo kye eky’olulimi olwangu eky’ekyalo John Ploughman’s Talk, yakyogera bw’ati:

“Okukozesa ensimbi n’obwegendereza kitundu kya lutalo lw’obulamu; okufuna ensimbi si kizibu nga bwe kiri okuzisaasaanya obulungi.”

Charles H. Spurgeon, John Ploughman’s Talk

Eddoboozi okuva mu biseera eby’edda

John Wesley yayigiriza nti bw’omala okufuna kyonna ky’osobola, “mu magezi ag’obwesimbu n’obunyiikivu obutakoowa,” etteeka ery’okubiri ery’amagezi g’Ekikristaayo liri “Tereka kyonna ky’osobola.” Yali akitegeeza ng’ekikuumi eri okuzannyira ensimbi, ebisingawo bisigalewo eby’okugaba. Teyali asiima kukuŋŋaanya, wabula yali asumulula ensimbi olw’etteeka ery’okusatu.

Ky’okukola wiiki eno

Wiiki eno wandiika buli ssente gy’osaasaanya. Wandiika byonna, ne kaawa. Ku nkomerero ya wiiki, byawule mu biti obitunuulire n’obwesimbu. Oluvannyuma jjuza enteekateeka y’ensimbi ku lupapula lumu eri mu Byongerezeddwako 2. Bw’oba oli mufumbo, mukikolere wamu.

Ku lw’ebibinja

  • Bajeti ogisanga ekuwa eddembe oba ekuziyiza? Lwaki?
  • Musome Engero 27:23-24. “Okumanya bulungi embeera z’ekisibo kyo” kyandifaananye kitya mu bulamu bwo?
  • Ensalo eri wa wakati w’okutereka okw’amagezi n’okukuŋŋaanya? Oyinza otya okumanya ludda ki lw’olimu?
  • Kitundu ki ekimu eky’okusaasaanya kwo ekyetaaga enteekateeka?

study_questions.question: Olugero lwa Yesu olw’omunaala ogutaggwa luyigiriza ki ku nsimbi?
study_questions.answer: Mu Lukka 14:28 omuzimbi atasooka kubalirira muwendo azimba omusingi, ensimbi ne zimuggwako, n’afuuka eky’okusekererwa. Yesu yalugera ku muwendo gw’okuba omuyigirizwa, naye yakozesa ekifaananyi eky’obulijjo kubanga amazima gaakyo geeyolefu nnyo: abantu ab’amagezi bateekateeka nga tebannasaasaanya. “Enteekateeka z’omunyiikivu zivaamu magoba meereere” (Engero 21:5).

study_questions.question: Ebitundu ebikulu ebya bajeti ey’Ekikristaayo bye biruwa?
study_questions.answer: Bajeti kwe kusalawo nga bukyali ensimbi za Katonda gye zinaagenda, mu kifo ky’okuzuula oluvannyuma gye zaagenda. Mu ngeri yaayo esinga obwangu erina ebitundu bina: ebikuyingirira ng’omusolo gumaze okuggibwako, ebisooka okugenda eri Katonda, ebyetaagisa okubeera mu bulamu, n’ebisigaddewo eby’okutereka n’oluvannyuma ebirala by’osaasaanyiza. Abantu abasinga bazuula nti enteekateeka ebaleetera eddembe.

study_questions.question: John Wesley yali ategeeza ki bwe yagamba nti “Tereka kyonna ky’osobola”?
study_questions.answer: Okusinga kyonna Wesley yali ategeeza nti tozannyira nsimbi: tozisaasaanyiza ku bintu ebiriisa obuliisa amalala, okwemanya oba okwagala okulabibwa, era beeranga mu bulamu obwangu ebisingawo bisigalewo. Kyali kikuumi eri okuzannyira ensimbi, ebisingawo bisigalewo eby’okugaba, so si kusiima kukuŋŋaanya; kyasumulula ensimbi olw’etteeka lye ery’okusatu, “Gaba kyonna ky’osobola.”

fields.title: Enjegere z’Oyo Eyeewola
fields.body_html:
Lumu nnabbi Erisa yajjirwa nnamwandu eyali mu buzibu bungi. Bba yali omu ku bannabbi, omusajja eyatyanga Katonda. Yafa ng’alina ebbanja, era kaakano omuntu eyali amubanja yali ajja okutwala batabani be bombi babeere abaddu okusasula ebbanja eryo.

Erisa n’amubuuza ky’alina mu nnyumba. N’addamu nti talina kintu kyonna, okuggyako akasumbi akatono ak’amafuta. N’amugamba yeewole ensuwa ezitaliimu kintu eri baliraanwa be bonna, nnyingi nga bw’asobola, aggale oluggi atandike okufuka. Amafuta ne gagenda mu maaso nga gakulukuta okutuusa buli nsuwa lwe yajjula. Awo Erisa n’agamba nti, “Genda otunde amafuta ago, osasule amabanja go, ebinaafikkawo bikuliisenga ggwe ne batabani bo” (2 Bassekabaka 4:7).

Eno mboozi ya Katonda okugabirira mu ngeri ey’ekyamagero. Naye era mboozi eraga nti ebbanja liyinza okuba ekintu eky’entiisa ennyo. Mu nsi ey’edda, ebbanja lyali liyinza okukufiiriza eddembe ly’abaana bo.

Ebbanja kika kya buddu

“Omugagga afuga abaavu, naye eyeewola aba muddu w’oyo amuwola.” (Engero 22:7)

Ekyo kigambo kizibu, naye kya mazima. Bw’oba ng’olina ebbanja ly’ensimbi, toli wa ddembe ddala. Ekitundu ku nsimbi z’olifuna mu maaso kiri dda kya muntu mulala. Buli mwezi ekitundu ku mulimu gwo kigenda okusasula eby’emabega mu kifo ky’okuzimba eby’omu maaso oba okugabira Katonda. Ebbanja likendeeza ku by’osobola okulondawo. Oyinza obutasobola kukyusa mulimu, kusenguka, kugaba n’omutima omugabi, oba kwanukula Katonda bw’akuyita, kubanga olina okugenda mu maaso n’okusasula.

Ebbanja era lya bbeeyi. Amagoba gategeeza nti osasula ensimbi nnyingi nnyo okusinga ekintu kye wagula bwe kigula. Ku kaadi z’ebbanja ez’amagoba amangi oba looni ez’akaseera akatono ez’amagoba agasukkiridde, ekyo kiyinza okukuzikiriza.

Era ebbanja litera okuleeta okweraliikirira, obukuubagano mu bufumbo n’ensonyi. Abantu bangi beetikka ebbanja ng’omugugu gwe batayogerako n’akatono.

Amabanja gonna kibi?

Bayibuli teyogera nti okwewola kwonna kibi. Amateeka ga Musa gaawa ebiragiro ku kuwola, ekiraga nti okwewola kwaliwo, era gaalagira Abayisirayiri okuwola baliraanwa baabwe abaavu n’omutima omugabi. Yesu yagamba nti, “Akusaba omuwanga, n’oyo ayagala okukwewolako tomukubanga mabega” (Matayo 5:42). Abantu abasinga obungi beetaaga okwewola okugula ennyumba, era looni y’ennyumba eteekeddwateekeddwa obulungi eyinza okuba ey’amagezi.

Naye Bayibuli etwala lwatu ebbanja ng’ekintu eky’okwewala bwe kiba kisoboka, era eky’okuvaamu amangu ddala nga bw’osobola. Ekiragiro kya Pawulo kiri nti: “Temubeeranga na bbanja lyonna eri omuntu yenna, wabula okwagalananga” (Abaruumi 13:8). Ebbanja lyokka lye tusaanidde okusigala nalyo emirembe gyonna lye bbanja ly’okwagala.

Era Bayibuli eyogera lwatu nti tulina okusasula bye twewola. “Ababi beewola, ne batasasula; naye abatuukirivu basaasira era bagaba bingi” (Zabbuli 37:21). Obutasasula, ng’osobola okusasula, kika kya bubbi.

Weegendereze okweyimirira amabanja

Engero ziddiŋŋana okulabula ku kika ky’ebbanja ekirala: okweyimirira looni y’omuntu omulala.

“Teweegattanga ku abo abeeyama, newaakubadde ku abo abeeyimirira ab’amabanja. Bw’oliba nga tolina kya kusasula ekitanda kyo kyennyini kye kirikuggyibwako” (Engero 22:26-27)

Ekyo kiwulikika ng’ekikakali. Tetusaanidde kuyamba mikwano gyaffe? Yee, naye Engero za magezi. Bw’oyeyimirira ebbanja ly’omuntu omulala, oba osuubiza okusasula bw’aliba nga tasobola, era ofiirwa obuyinza ku nsimbi zo wekka. Emikwano mingi n’amaka mangi byayabika mu ngeri eno. Bw’oba oyagala okuyamba omuntu, emirundi mingi kirungi okumuwa ky’osobola okugaba, okusinga okweyimirira ky’otoyinza kugumira kufiirwa.

Okufuna eddembe

Bw’oba ng’olina ebbanja, toggwaamu maanyi. Abantu bangi bavudde mu mabanja nga Katonda abayamba, naawe osobola. Bino bye bimu ku by’okukola.

Lekera awo okusima. Etteeka erisooka ery’okuva mu kinnya kwe kulekera awo okusima. Teweewola bbanja ddala lipya. Ekyo kiyinza okutegeeza okusalaasala kaadi oba okuggalawo akawunti.

Tunuulira amazima. Wandiika buli bbanja ly’olina: gw’obanjibwa, obungi bwalyo, amagoba, n’ensimbi z’osasula buli mwezi. Kiyinza okutiisa, naye tosobola kuwangula mulabe gw’otayagala kutunuulira.

Kola enteekateeka. Kozesa enteekateeka y’ensimbi eri mu Byongerezeddwako 2. Noonya buli ssente gy’osobola okusumulula. Abantu bangi basooka kusasula bbanja lyabwe erisinga obutono, okufuna amaanyi, oluvannyuma ensimbi ze baabadde basasula ne bazongera ku bbanja eriddako. Abalala batandikira ku bbanja erisinga amagoba, okukekkereza ensimbi. Kyonna ky’onoolondamu, beera n’enteekateeka.

Funa obuyambi. Mu nsi nnyingi waliwo empeereza ez’obwereere era ez’okwesigibwa eziwa amagezi ku mabanja, era amakanisa mangi galina abantu abasobola okuyamba. Tewali nsonyi mu kusaba buyambi. Amalala gakuuma abantu bangi mu mabanja okusinga obwavu.

Genda mu maaso n’okugaba. Kiyinza okulabika ng’ekyewuunyisa, naye tolekeraawo ddala kugaba, ne bwe kiba nti ky’ogaba kirina okuba kitono okumala ekiseera. Okugaba kukuuma omutima gwo nga gwa ddembe okuva mu nkwata y’ensimbi, era kukujjukiza Omugabirizi wo y’ani.

Saba. Saba Katonda akuyambe, akuwe amagezi, era oluusi akugabirire by’oyetaaga. Nnamwandu ow’omu biseera bya Erisa ekyo kyennyini kye yakola, era Katonda n’amuddamu.

Gumiikiriza. Kirabika teweeyingiza mu bbanja mu lunaku lumu, era tojja kulivaamu mu lunaku lumu. Jaguza buli bbanja ly’omaliriza okusasula.

Eddembe

Ekifaananyi kya Bayibuli eky’obulamu obulungi kizingiramu okuba nga tolina bbanja. Kuba akafaananyi ku kye kyandibadde okuba nga tobanjibwa muntu yenna kintu kyonna. Buli pawundi oba ddoola gy’ofuna yandibadde yiyo okuddukanya ku lwa Katonda: okugiriirako, okugitereka n’okugigaba. Wandibadde wa ddembe okwanukula Katonda bw’akuyita, yonna gy’akutwala. Eddembe eryo lisaanira okulikolerera.

Era jjukira enjiri. Ffenna twali tubbidde mu bbanja lye tutaali tusobola kusasula, ebbanja ly’ekibi. Yesu yalisasula lyonna. Yatuyigiriza okusaba nti, “Tusonyiwe ebyonoono byaffe nga naffe bwe tusonyiwa abatwonoona” (Matayo 6:12). Eddembe erisingayo obuziba lyaffe dda mu Kristo. Okuva mu bbanja ly’ensimbi kifaananyi kitono eky’eddembe eryo eddene.

Eddoboozi okuva mu biseera eby’edda

John Ploughman wa Spurgeon yawa amagezi gano ku kuwola n’okweyimirira:

“Emirundi mingi oyo awola ensimbi ze afiirwa zaabu ye n’emikwano gye, era oyo eyeeyimirira omulala tabeera mukakafu n’akatono.”

Charles H. Spurgeon, John Ploughman’s Talk

Ky’okukola wiiki eno

Kola olukalala olujjuvu olwa buli bbanja ly’olina. Lusabire. Oluvannyuma salawo ekintu kimu ekirambulukufu ky’osobola okukola wiiki eno okugenda mu ddembe, era okikole. Bw’oba tolina bbanja, weebaze Katonda, era weebuuze oba waliwo omuntu gw’oyinza okuyamba, oboolyawo ng’omuwa mu kifo ky’okumuwola.

Ku lw’ebibinja

  • Lwaki Engero zigeraageranya eyeewola n’omuddu? Ekyo mwali mukirabyeko?
  • Musome Abaruumi 13:8. “Ebbanja ly’okwagala” kye ki?
  • Lwaki mulowooza nti Engero zirabula nnyo bwe zityo ku kweyimirira looni z’abantu abalala?
  • Kintu ki ekimu ekiremesa abantu okufuna obuyambi ku mabanja? Ekkanisa eyinza kuyamba etya?

study_questions.question: Bayibuli egamba nti amabanja gonna kibi?
study_questions.answer: Nedda. Amateeka gaawa ebiragiro ku kuwola, Yesu yagamba obutakuba mabega oyo ayagala okwewola, era looni y’ennyumba eteekeddwateekeddwa obulungi eyinza okuba ey’amagezi. Naye Bayibuli etwala ebbanja ng’ekintu eky’okwewala bwe kiba kisoboka, n’okuvaamu amangu ddala nga bw’osobola: “Temubeeranga na bbanja lyonna eri omuntu yenna, wabula okwagalananga” (Abaruumi 13:8). Era bye twewola tulina okubisasula.

study_questions.question: Emboozi ya Erisa n’amafuta ga nnamwandu eyigiriza ki ku mabanja?
study_questions.answer: Bba wa nnamwandu yafa ng’alina ebbanja, era eyali amubanja yali ajja okutwala batabani be bombi babeere abaddu. Katonda yajjuza amafuta buli nsuwa gye yeewola, n’asobola okugatunda, okusasula ebbanja n’okuliisibwa ebyafikkawo (2 Bassekabaka 4:7). Eyo mboozi ya Katonda okugabirira, era eraga nti ebbanja liyinza okuba ekintu eky’entiisa ennyo.

study_questions.question: Omukristaayo ayinza atya okuva mu mabanja?
study_questions.answer: Lekera awo okusima ng’olekayo okwewola amabanja amapya; tunuulira amazima ng’owandiika buli bbanja, amagoba n’ensimbi z’osasula; kola enteekateeka; funa obuyambi, kubanga amalala gakuuma abantu bangi mu mabanja okusinga obwavu; genda mu maaso n’okugaba, ne bwe kiba kitono; saba, nga nnamwandu ow’omu biseera bya Erisa bwe yakola; era gumiikiriza, ng’ojaguza buli bbanja ly’omaliriza okusasula.

fields.title: Labirira Abantu Bo
fields.body_html:
Abantu abamu bwe bafuna okukkiriza, amangu ago baagala okugaba buli kye balina. Ekyo kiyinza okuba ekirowoozo ekirungi ennyo. Naye era kiyinza okugenda obubi ennyo.

William Seymour, omubuulizi Omumerika ow’ensibuko y’Afirika eyali wakati mu kuzuukuka kw’eby’omwoyo okwa Azusa Street mu Los Angeles mu 1906, yalaba enjuyi zombi. Mu kuyigiriza okumpi kwe yayita “In Money Matters” (Ku Nsonga z’Ensimbi), yalabula ku bayigiriza abaagambanga abakkiriza abapya okutunda buli kintu, ekyavaamu ebibi eby’entiisa. Yawandiika nti: “Olw’okuyigiriza okw’obulimba, abaana balekeddwa nga batambula kumpi bwereere, abakazi baalese abaami baabwe, n’abasajja baleka bakyala baabwe okwoza n’okukuuta, ate Bayibuli egamba nti ekyo kibi okusinga obutakkiriza.”

Awo n’ajuliza olunyiriri olussaawo ekkomo ku bunyiikivu obw’engeri eyo.

Mubi okusinga atakkiriza

“Naye omuntu yenna bw’atalabirira bantu be, na ddala ab’omu nnyumba ye, aba yeegaanyi okukkiriza, era aba mubi okusinga atakkiriza.” (1 Timoseewo 5:8)

Ekyo kye kimu ku bigambo ebisinga amaanyi mu Ndagaano Empya, era kyogera ku nsimbi. Omukristaayo agaana okulabirira ab’omu maka ge, ate nga asobola, aba yeeyisa bubi okusinga atakkiriza. Ne bantu abatamanyi Katonda bamanyi nti ab’omu maka go olina okubalabirira.

Olunyiriri luno lusinga kwogera ku kulabirira ab’ekika abakadde, naddala bannamwandu, mu nsi omutaali nsimbi za bukadde (pension). Naye lukwata ku buvunaanyizibwa bwaffe bwonna eri ab’omu maka: eri munno mu bufumbo, eri abaana baffe, eri bazadde baffe abakaddiwa. Okubalabirira si kintu ekikuggya ku kuweereza Katonda. Kitundu ku kuweereza Katonda.

Okutebenkeza

Kino tekyatuusa Seymour ku kugamba bantu okutereka obutereka. Yeeyongera okulabula n’amaanyi ge gamu ku nsobi ey’oludda olulala: “Tekitegeeza nti olina okuba n’ettaka eddene n’ensimbi nnyingi eziterekeddwa mu bbanka nga baganda bo ne bannyoko babonaabona.” Era yayigiriza nti Omwoyo yandikulembedde buli mukkiriza mu kugaba kwe. Tekiri nti kimu oba kirala. Byombi: labirira ab’omu maka go, era gaba n’omutima omugabi.

Okutebenkeza okwo kutambula mu Bayibuli yonna. Omukazi ow’omu Engero 31 musuubuzi omukugu agula ennimiro, n’asimba ennimiro y’emizabbibu, era n’akakasa nti ab’omu nnyumba ye bambadde bulungi mu biseera eby’empewo. Era “Ayanjululiza abaavu omukono gwe, n’agololera omukono gwe oyo ali mu bwetaavu.” (Engero 31:20). Alabirira era agaba.

Okulabirira kufaanana kutya

Okulabirira ab’omu maka go kisingawo ku kusasula bisale byokka. Bino bye bimu ku bintu by’oyinza okulowoozaako.

Ebyetaago bya buli lunaku. Emmere, engoye, aw’okusula, obujjanjabi n’okusoma. Guno gwe musingi, era ensimbi ze tufuna ezisinga obungi zigenda wano.

Ekyokwerinda ku bizibu ebigwawo. Kino twakitunuulira mu ssuula ewedde. Ensimbi ezitereke ez’ebizibu ebigwawo zikuuma ab’omu maka go obutaleka bizibu ebitono kufuuka binene.

Obukuumi. Okusinziira ku w’obeera n’embeera zo, kino kiyinza okutegeeza yinsuwa, ab’omu maka go baleme kusigala mu bwavu obw’amaanyi singa olwala oba n’ofa. Abakristaayo abamu beeraliikirira nti yinsuwa eraga obutaba na kukkiriza. Naye Yusufu yatereka emmere ey’empeke olw’enjala, era tewali amulumiriza butakkiriza. Okulabirira mu magezi kye kimu ku bifaananyi by’okwagala.

Eby’omu maaso. Engero zigamba nti: “Omuntu omulungi alekera bazzukulu be ebyobusika” (Engero 13:22). Ekyo tekiteekwa kutegeeza bugagga bungi. Kitegeeza okulowooza ng’oyitirira ku ggwe wennyini ne ku bulamu bwo. Kiyinza okuzingiramu okutereka ensimbi ez’obukadde, oleme kuba mugugu ku baana bo, n’okuwandiika ekiraamo, ab’omu maka go baleme kusigala mu kutabulwa.

Obudde n’okubeerawo. Okulabirira si kwa nsimbi zokka. Bazadde bangi bakola nnyo nnyo okufunira abaana baabwe ebintu ne kiba nti tebasigaza budde bwa kwewaayo bo bennyini gye bali. Abaana beetaaga omuzadde okusinga bwe beetaaga ennyumba ennene.

Bazadde abakaddiwa

Mu buwangwa bungi, okulabirira bazadde abakadde kintu ekisuubirwa obusuubirwa. Mu bulala, kifuuse kya kwesalirawo. Bayibuli etegeerekeka bulungi. Yesu yanenya abakulembeze b’eddiini abaali bazudde ekkubo ery’okwewala okuyamba bazadde baabwe nga balangirira nti ensimbi zaabwe “ziweereddwayo eri Katonda.” Yagamba nti baali basazaamu ekigambo kya Katonda olw’obulombolombo bwabwe. Okussa ekitiibwa mu kitaawo ne nnyoko kizingiramu okubalabirira bwe batakyasobola kwerabirira bokka.

Ekyo kiyinza okuba eky’ebbeeyi, mu nsimbi ne mu budde. Naye ye emu ku ngeri ezisinga okutegeerekeka Bayibuli gy’etusaba okulagamu okukkiriza kwaffe.

Okulabirira si kutereka butereka

Oyawula otya wakati w’okulabirira ab’omu maka go n’okweterekera ggwe wekka? Bino bye bimu ku bibuuzo by’oyinza okwebuuza.

  • Ndi mu kulabirira byetaago bya ddala, oba ndi mu kuzimba ekyokwekwekamu ekigenda kikula buli lukya olw’okutya?
  • Okugaba kwange kukula wamu n’okulabirira ab’omu maka gange?
  • Nkozesa “okulabirira ab’omu maka gange” ng’ekyekwaso eky’obutagaba?
  • Njigiriza abaana bange okwesiga Katonda, oba okwesiga ensimbi?

Bw’oba tosobola kulabirira

Abasomi abamu bajja kuwulira obuzito bw’essuula eno mu ngeri ey’obulumi. Oboolyawo wafiirwa omulimu, oba oli mulwadde, oba oli muzadde omu akola emirimu ebiri ate nga tosobola kumalawo byetaago. 1 Timoseewo 5:8 si kigambo ekikwolekedde. Kigendereddwamu abo abandisobodde okulabirira naye ne bagaana.

Bw’oba ng’olwanagana n’obulamu, essuula y’emu eyo egamba ekkanisa okulabirira abo abatalina mulala yenna. Si kya buswavu okufuna obuyambi. Abakristaayo abaasooka baagabananga, ne kiba nti “Mu bo temwali baali mu kwetaaga” (Ebikolwa 4:34). Leka ab’omu maka go ag’ekkanisa bakuyambe okwetikka omugugu, era jjukira nti Kitaawo ow’omu ggulu amanyi by’oyetaaga.

Eddoboozi okuva mu biseera eby’edda

William Seymour, bwe yamala okulabula ku kuyigiriza okutali kwa kwegendereza, yawa ekigambo kino ekitebenkevu ku by’obugagga:

“Kituufu ggwe okuba n’eby’obugagga, naye Mukama bw’agamba nti, ddira doola 200 oba 500 oba 1,000 ozigabe wano oba wali, kikole.”

William J. Seymour, In Money Matters

Ky’okukola wiiki eno

Tuula wansi, wekka oba ne munno mu bufumbo, mwebuuze nti: waliwo ebituli mu ngeri gye tulabiriramu ab’omu maka gaffe? Tulina ensimbi ezitereke ez’ebizibu ebigwawo? Ekiraamo? Bazadde baffe abakaddiwa beetaaga obuyambi? Londa ekituli kimu, otandike okukola ekigere ekisooka okukiziba omwezi guno.

Ku lw’ebibinja

  • Lwaki mulowooza nti Pawulo akozesa ebigambo eby’amaanyi bwe bityo mu 1 Timoseewo 5:8?
  • Omukazi ow’omu Engero 31 atuyigiriza ki ku kutebenkeza okulabirira n’okugaba?
  • “Okulabirira ab’omu maka gange” kuyinza kutya okufuuka ekyekwaso eky’obutagaba?
  • Ekkanisa eyinza etya okuyamba abo abalwanagana okulabirira ab’omu maka gaabwe?

study_questions.question: Bayibuli eyogera ki ku kulabirira ab’omu maka go?
study_questions.answer: “Naye omuntu yenna bw’atalabirira bantu be, na ddala ab’omu nnyumba ye, aba yeegaanyi okukkiriza, era aba mubi okusinga atakkiriza.” (1 Timoseewo 5:8). Lwawandiikibwa okusinga ku bannamwandu abakadde mu nsi omutaali nsimbi za bukadde, naye lukwata ku munno mu bufumbo, ku baana ne ku bazadde abakaddiwa. Okubalabirira si kintu ekikuggya ku kuweereza Katonda; kitundu ku kwo.

study_questions.question: William Seymour yayigiriza ki ku nsimbi mu “In Money Matters”?
study_questions.answer: Seymour, ow’okuzuukuka kw’eby’omwoyo okwa Azusa Street, yalabula ku bayigiriza abaagambanga abakkiriza abapya okutunda buli kintu, ne kireka abaana nga batambula kumpi bwereere n’abafumbo nga balekeddwawo. Yalabula n’amaanyi ge gamu ku kuba n’eby’obugagga n’ensimbi eziterekeddwa mu bbanka ng’abalala babonaabona. Yawandiika nti: “Kituufu ggwe okuba n’eby’obugagga,” naye Mukama bw’agamba okugaba, “kikole.”

study_questions.question: Okugula yinsuwa oba okuwandiika ekiraamo kiraga obutaba na kukkiriza?
study_questions.answer: Nedda. Yusufu yatereka emmere ey’empeke olw’enjala era tewali amulumiriza butakkiriza; okulabirira mu magezi kye kimu ku bifaananyi by’okwagala. Okulabirira kuzingiramu ebyetaago bya buli lunaku, ensimbi ezitereke ez’ebizibu ebigwawo, obukuumi nga yinsuwa, okutereka ensimbi ez’obukadde n’okuwandiika ekiraamo, era n’obudde n’okubeerawo, kubanga abaana beetaaga omuzadde okusinga ennyumba ennene.

fields.title: Ebibala Ebibereberye
fields.body_html:
Mu Isirayiri ey’edda, amakungula gaali biseera bya ssanyu era bya kweraliikirira. Omulimi yalindanga omwaka gwonna ebirime bye byengere. Binaabeera bimala? Enkuba enaatonnya? Enzige zinajja? Ebinywa ebisooka eby’ebbaale bwe byakungulwanga, okukemebwa kwabanga kwa kubikuuma byonna, singa wabaawo ekibi ekigwawo.

Katonda yagamba abantu be bakole kyennyini ekikontana n’ekyo. Ebisooka mu makungula, ebibala ebibereberye, byalina okuleetebwa gy’ali nga tebanalya kintu kirala kyonna.

“Mukama mugulumizenga n’eby’obugagga byo; n’ebibala ebisooka eby’ebintu byo byonna eby’omu nnimiro yo, olwo amaterekero go lwe ganajjulanga ebintu enkumu, era n’amasenero go ne gajjula ne gabooga omwenge omusu.” (Engero 3:9-10)

Ebisooka era ebisinga obulungi. Si ebifisseewo. Si ebisigalawo ku nkomerero y’omwezi. Ebisooka.

Lwaki okusooka?

Okusooka okugaba kikolwa kya kukkiriza. Bw’ogaba ku bisooka mu nnyingiza yo, nga tonnamanya obanga ebisigadde binaakumala, oba ogamba nti, “Katonda, nkwesiga okumpa ebisigadde.” Bw’ogaba ku bifisseewo, mu butuufu oba ogamba nti, “Nja kusooka kwesiga nze, ate nkuwe ebyo bye siyinza kwetaaga.”

Okusooka okugaba era kikolwa kya kusinza. Kirangirira nti Katonda y’asooka mu bulamu bwo, si mu bigambo byo byokka, naye ne mu akawunti yo ey’omu bbanka. Kiteeka Matayo 6:33 mu nkola: “musooke munoonye obwakabaka.”

Era okusooka okugaba kya magezi. Bw’olinda okutuusa ku nkomerero y’omwezi olabe ebisigaddewo, kumpi bulijjo ojja kusanga nga tewali kisigaddewo. Okusaasaanya kweyongera okutuuka ku kyonna ekiriwo. Bw’osooka okusalawo ky’onoogaba, kikolebwa.

Ekimu eky’ekkumi

Endagaano Enkadde yawa ekipimo ekigere eky’okugaba kuno okw’ebibala ebibereberye: ekimu eky’ekkumi. Ibulayimu yawa kabona Merukizeddeeki ekimu eky’ekkumi. Yakobo yasuubiza Katonda ekimu eky’ekkumi ku byonna bye yandifunye. Amateeka ga Musa gaalagira Isirayiri okuleeta ekimu eky’ekkumi eky’ebirime byabwe n’eky’ebisibo byabwe:

“Buli lw’onookungulanga ebibala byo nga biva mu nnimiro yo buli mwaka, weegenderezanga n’ossangako wabbali ekitundu kyabyo eky’ekkumi.” (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 14:22)

Weetegereze ekigendererwa, ekijja mu lunyiriri oluddako: “Olyokenga oyige okutyanga Mukama Katonda wo bulijjo” (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 14:23). Ekimu eky’ekkumi kyali kkubo lya kutendeka mutima okusooka Katonda.

Oluvannyuma lw’ebyasa bingi, Isirayiri bwe yali egayaavu, nnabbi Malaki yaleeta okusoomoozebwa kwa Katonda:

“Muleete ekimu eky’ekkumi ekijjuvu mu nnyumba yange, ennyumba yange ebeeremu emmere, era mungezese,” bw’ayogera Mukama ow’Eggye, “obanga siribaggulirawo ebituli eby’omu ggulu, ne mbawa omukisa ne gutabaako ne we guligya.” (Malaki 3:10)

Kye kifo kyokka mu Bayibuli Katonda w’ayita abantu be okumugezesa. Yali yakamala okubalumiriza nti bamunyaga: “Omuntu alinyaga Katonda? “Naye mmwe munnyaga. Kyokka mugamba nti, ‘Tukunyaga tutya?’ “Mu biweebwayo ne mu kimu eky’ekkumi” (Malaki 3:8).

Abakristaayo balina okuwaayo ekimu eky’ekkumi?

Kino kibuuzo Abakristaayo abeesigwa kye batakkaanyaako. Abamu bakkiriza nti ekimu eky’ekkumi kikyali kye kipimo eri abakkiriza leero. Abalala bagamba nti Endagaano Empya tekiragira butereevu. Yesu akyogerako omulundi gumu, ng’akikkiriza mu kuyitamu bw’aba anenya Abafalisaayo olw’okulagajjalira obwenkanya n’okusaasira. Okuyigiriza kw’Endagaano Empya ku kugaba mu kifo ky’ekyo kussa essira ku bugabi, ku kugaba okusinziira ku by’olina, ku ssanyu, n’ekyokulabirako kya Kristo.

Ekitabo kino kitunuulira ekimu eky’ekkumi ng’olusiba olw’entandikwa olulungi ennyo, naye si kkomo. Lwaki? Obanga Isirayiri, wansi w’endagaano enkadde, yasabibwa okuwaayo ekimu eky’ekkumi, kizibu okulowooza nti Abakristaayo, abaafuna ebisingawo ennyo mu Kristo, basaanidde okumatira n’okuwaayo ebitono okusinga ebyo. Era ekyokulabirako ky’Endagaano Empya kirabika kitusindika okusukka ekimu eky’ekkumi, so si okukka wansi waakyo: Abamakedoni baawaayo “n’okusukka kwe baali basobola,” Zaakayo yawaayo kimu kyakubiri eky’ebintu bye, nnamwandu yawaayo byonna.

Kale bw’oba tonnawaayo kimu eky’ekkumi, kiruubirirwa kirungi eky’okukolerera. Bw’oba ng’owaayo dda ekimu eky’ekkumi, toyimirira awo. Buuza Katonda obanga ayagala ggwe okukula mu kugaba nga bw’akuza ennyingiza yo.

Ekisinga obukulu si kitundu ku kikumi kigere. Gwe mutima: okusooka okugaba, okugabanga obutayosa, okugaba n’essanyu, n’okugaba okusinziira ku ebyo Katonda by’akuwadde.

Okugaba okusinziira ku by’olina

Endowooza eyo esembayo, okugaba okusinziira ku by’olina, eva butereevu mu Pawulo. Bwe yali ategeka ensimbi ez’okuyamba ab’e Yerusaalemi, yagamba Abakkolinso nti: “Buli omu ku mmwe ng’asinziira ku kufuna kwe mu wiiki, abengako ky’atereka” (1 Abakkolinso 16:2). Buli muntu asaanidde okugaba okusinziira ku Katonda bw’amuwadde omukisa.

Ekyo kitegeeza nti omuyizi akola omulimu ogw’ekiseera ekitono n’omuntu alina bizinensi ennene n’ennyingiza ennene tebasuubirwa kuwaayo kigero kye kimu. Naye bombi basuubirwa okugaba, era bombi basuubirwa okugaba okusinziira ku by’alina. Nga Pawulo bw’agamba awalala, “buli muntu aweeyo okusinziira ku ekyo ky’alina so si ky’atalina” (2 Abakkolinso 8:12).

Ate ekisuubizo?

Engero 3 ne Malaki 3 byombi bisuubiza omukisa eri abo abagaba. Ekyo kitegeeza nti Katonda bulijjo ajja kukusasula mu nsimbi?

Wano weegendereze. Ebisuubizo bino bya mazima. Katonda awa omukisa obugabi, era Abakristaayo bangi basobola okunyumya engeri Katonda gye yabagabirira oluvannyuma lw’okutandika okugaba. Naye ebisuubizo by’Endagaano Enkadde eri Isirayiri emirundi mingi byali bikwatagana n’obulamu bwabwe mu nsi gye baaweebwa, era omukisa Katonda gw’awa abantu be si bulijjo nti gwa nsimbi. Yesu ye muntu asinga obugabi eyali abaddewo, era yafa nga talina kintu kirala okuggyako engoye ze yali ayambadde.

Engeri entuufu ey’okukwatamu ebisuubizo bino y’eno: gaba lwa kuba oyagala Katonda era omwesiga, so si ng’enteekateeka y’okusiga ensimbi. Katonda ajja kukakasa nti tofiirwa n’akatono olw’okuba omugabi, naye ye yennyini y’anaasalawo engeri gy’anaakusasulamu, oba mu bulamu buno oba mu bulamu obujja.

Okutandika

Bw’oba tonnagabanga buli kiseera, oba ng’obadde ogaba ku bifisseewo byokka, eno ye ngeri ennyangu ey’okutandika.

Salawo ekitundu ku kikumi. Kisabire. Bw’oba olaba nga ekimu eky’ekkumi tekisoboka kaakano, londa ekitundu ku kikumi ky’osobola, era teekateeka okukyongerako ekitundu kimu ku kikumi buli mwaka.

Kisooke. Kitegeke kikolebwe amangu ddala ng’osasuddwa. Kitwale ng’olunyiriri olusooka mu bajeti yo.

Kisooke kiweebwe ekkanisa yo. Abakristaayo abasinga obungi bakkiriza nti okugaba kwaffe okwa buli kiseera kusaanidde okutandikira mu kkanisa ey’omu kitundu gye tuliisibwa, gye tuyigirizibwa era gye tulabirirwa. “Oyo ayigirizibwa ekigambo kya Katonda, agabanirenga wamu n’amuyigiriza ku birungi byonna by’alina” (Abaggalatiya 6:6).

Laba ekinaabaawo. Si kulaba obanga ogenda kugaggawala, wabula okulaba engeri Katonda gy’akugabiriramu n’engeri omutima gwo gye gukyukamu.

Eddoboozi okuva mu biseera eby’edda

George Müller, eyagabanga kumpi buli kimu kye yafunanga, yawa Abakristaayo abaali baagala okutandika okugaba amagezi gano amangu:

“Kyokka salawo ekigero, ne bwe kiba ekisingayo obutono, ky’oteesa okugaba ku nnyingiza yo, era kigabenga obutayosa; era nga Katonda bw’asiima okwongera ku kitangaala kyo n’ekisa kyo, era bw’asiima okukuwa omukisa okusingawo, naawe bw’otyo gaba okusingawo.”

George Müller, ng’ajuliziddwa mu George Müller of Bristol

Ne F. B. Meyer yalaba nti okugaba ekitundu ekigere kukuuma omutima:

“Okusobola okwekuuma okwagala ensimbi, tusaanidde okwegendereza okuwaayo ekitundu ekigere eri omulimu gwa Kristo.”

F. B. Meyer, Our Daily Walk

Ky’okukola wiiki eno

Salawo ekitundu ku kikumi eky’ennyingiza yo ky’onoowanga Katonda, ng’otandikira ku musaala gwo oguddako. Kitegeke kibeere ekisooka okukolebwa. Bw’oba ng’ogaba dda, saba Katonda obanga akusaba okwongerako ddaala limu.

Ku lw’ebibinja

  • Njawulo ki eriwo wakati w’okugaba ebibala ebibereberye n’okugaba ebifisseewo? Ki ky’obadde okola ennyo?
  • Olowooza Abakristaayo balina okuwaayo ekimu eky’ekkumi? Lwaki oba lwaki nedda?
  • Soma 1 Abakkolinso 16:2. Okugaba “ng’asinziira ku kufuna kwe” kitegeeza ki mu mbeera yo?
  • Wandiddamu otya omuntu agamba nti, “Sirina busobozi bwa kugaba”?

study_questions.question: Lwaki Bayibuli egamba okuwa Katonda ebisooka mu nnyingiza yaffe?
study_questions.answer: Engero 3:9-10 esaba “ebibala ebisooka,” so si ebifisseewo. Okusooka okugaba kikolwa kya kukkiriza ekyesiga Katonda ku bisigadde, kikolwa kya kusinza ekiteeka mu nkola “musooke munoonye obwakabaka,” era kya magezi ag’omu bulamu obwa bulijjo, kubanga okusaasaanya kweyongera okutuuka ku kyonna ekiriwo, era enkomerero y’omwezi emirundi mingi esanga nga tewali kisigaddewo.

study_questions.question: Ekimu eky’ekkumi lye kkomo ly’okugaba kw’Omukristaayo?
study_questions.answer: Essuula eno eyita ekimu eky’ekkumi “olusiba olw’entandikwa olulungi ennyo, naye si kkomo.” Abakristaayo abeesigwa tebakkaanya obanga kikyali kiragiro, naye obanga Isirayiri yawaayo ekimu eky’ekkumi wansi w’endagaano enkadde, abo abaafuna ebisingawo ennyo mu Kristo tebasaanidde kuwaayo bitono okusinga ebyo. Abamakedoni, Zaakayo ne nnamwandu bonna baakisukka.

study_questions.question: Malaki 3:10 esuubiza nti Katonda ajja kusasula abagabi mu nsimbi?
study_questions.answer: Ebisuubizo bya mazima era Katonda awa omukisa obugabi, naye omukisa gwe si bulijjo nti gwa nsimbi; Yesu, omuntu asinga obugabi eyali abaddewo, yafa ng’alina engoye ze zokka. Gaba lwa kuba oyagala Katonda era omwesiga, so si ng’enteekateeka y’okusiga ensimbi. Ajja kukakasa nti tofiirwa n’akatono olw’okuba omugabi, naye ye y’asalawo engeri gy’asasulamu, mu bulamu buno oba mu bulamu obujja.

fields.title: Okugaba n’Essanyu, Bulijjo, era mu Kyama
fields.body_html:
Omutume Pawulo yali ayigiriza ku kugaba, era okuyigiriza okwo kukyabumba ekkanisa okutuusa leero. Kwajjira mu bbaluwa gye yawandiikira ekkanisa eyali tegaba bulungi.

Abakkolinso baali basooka okuba n’ebbugumu lingi ku nsimbi ezaali zikuŋŋaanyizibwa ku lw’e Yerusaalemi, naye ebbugumu eryo lyali liweddewo. Pawulo teyabanenya. Yabayigiriza ebintu bisatu ku ngeri y’okugabamu: n’omutima omugabi, n’essanyu, era nga beeyagalidde.

“Naye mujjukire nti, “Asiga ekitono alikungula kitono, naye asiga ekinene alikungula kinene.” Buli omu akola nga bw’asazeewo mu mutima gwe, si lwa nnaku, newaakubadde olw’okuwalirizibwa, kubanga Katonda ayagala oyo agaba n’essanyu. Katonda ayinza okwaza ekisa kyonna gye muli, bulijjo mubeerenga n’ebibamala byonna mu buli kintu nga musukkirira mu mulimu gwonna omulungi” (2 Abakkolinso 9:6-8)

Omugabi

Pawulo atandika n’ekifaananyi ky’okulima. Omulimi asiga ensigo ntono akungula bitono. Omulimi asiga nnyingi akungula bingi. Okugaba kufaanana okusiga. Si kusuula nsimbi. Kuzisimba.

N’Engero zigamba kye kimu, mu ngeri erabika ng’ekyuusiddwa:

“Omuntu agaba obuteerekereza, yeeyongera bweyongezi kugaggawala; naye akwatirira kye yandigabye, yeeyongera kwavuwala. Omuntu agaba anagaggawalanga, n’oyo ayamba talibulako amuyamba.” (Engero 11:24-25)

Ensi egamba nti ogaggawala ng’otereka. Katonda agamba nti ofuuka mugagga ddala ng’ogaba. Era nate, kino si kye kkubo ery’okufuna ensimbi. Naye ye nnono Katonda gye yateeka mu nsi ye: abagabi bazzibwamu amaanyi, ate abakodo bakendeera.

N’essanyu

“Katonda ayagala oyo agaba n’essanyu.” Enkyusa enkadde zigamba nti “omugabi omusanyufu.” Katonda tayagala nsimbi zaffe bwe zijja n’amaaso amasunwavu. Talina bwetaavu bwa nsimbi. Ky’ayagala gwe mutima gwaffe, era essanyu kye kabonero nti omutima guli mu kye tukola.

Kino tekitegeeza nti olina okuwulira essanyu buli lw’ogaba. Oluusi okugaba kuba kugondera okw’omuwendo omunene, era essanyu lijja oluvannyuma. Naye kitegeeza nti okugaba tekusaanye kukakibwa okuva mu ffe olw’okwesalira omusango, okunyigirizibwa oba okukozesebwa mu bukujjukujju. Pawulo agamba nti, “si lwa nnaku, newaakubadde olw’okuwalirizibwa.”

Ofuuka otya omugabi omusanyufu? Jjukira essuula 4. “mumanyi ekisa kya Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo.” Okugaba n’essanyu kukulukuta okuva mu mutima ogumanyi bwe guweereddwa ebingi. Pawulo afundikira ekitundu kino n’ebigambo bino: “Katonda yeebazibwe olw’ekirabo ekitayogerekeka!” (2 Abakkolinso 9:15). Okwebaza ye ttaka okugaba n’essanyu mwe kukulira.

Yesu yennyini yagamba nti, “Okugaba kwa mukisa okusinga okuweebwa” (Ebikolwa 20:35). Pawulo ajuliza ebigambo bino, ebitawandiikibwa mu Njiri, eri abakadde b’e Efeso. Okugaba si kufiirwa. Mukisa, era emirundi mingi gusinga ogw’okuweebwa.

Nga weeyagalidde era ng’omaze okusalawo

“Buli omu akola nga bw’asazeewo mu mutima gwe.” Okugaba kusaanye kusalibwewo nga bukyali, n’okulowooza n’okusaba. Tekusaanye kuba kwa kukubirizibwa kuyitiridde olw’okusikirizibwa mu nneewulira, wadde ekintu ky’ojjukira oluvannyuma. Pawulo yali abasabye okwawulangawo ensimbi buli wiiki (1 Abakkolinso 16:2), bw’anaatuuka baleme kwetaaga kukuŋŋaanya nsimbi mu kaseera akasembayo.

Kino kye kimu ku bintu ebisinga obukulu by’osobola okukola. Salawo ky’onoogabanga bulijjo, era okigabe bulijjo. Olwo oba wa ddembe okuyamba ne mu bwetaavu obw’enjawulo, okuva mu ebyo bye wateekateeka okuterekawo. George Müller yalabula nti okugaba okw’okukubirizibwa obukubirizibwa kufiirwa:

“Bw’olagajjalira okugaba okw’empisa, okugaba okwa bulijjo, okugaba okw’ennono era okwesigamye ku Byawandiikibwa, n’okulekera ennewulira n’okukubirizibwa oba embeera ez’enjawulo ezikusikiriza, mazima ddala ojja kufiirwa.”

Mu kyama

Yesu yayongerako engeri endala emu: okukola mu kyama.

“Mwegendereze, ebikolwa byammwe eby’obutuukirivu obutabikoleranga mu lujjudde lw’abantu nga mwagala babasiime, kubanga bwe munaakolanga bwe mutyo Kitammwe ali mu ggulu talibawa mpeera.” “Bw’obanga ogabira omwavu ekintu teweeraganga nga bannanfuusi bwe bakola ne basooka okufuuwa eŋŋombe mu makuŋŋaaniro ne mu nguudo, nga bagenda okugabira abaavu, abantu babalabe babawe ekitiibwa. Ddala ddala mbagamba nti Abo, eyo y’empeera yaabwe. Naye ggwe bw’obanga ogabira omuntu yenna ekintu omukono gwo ogwa kkono guleme kumanya ogwa ddyo kye gukola. Kale Kitaawo amanyi ebyama byonna alikuwa empeera” (Matayo 6:1-4)

Weetegereze Yesu ky’ayogera ku abo abagaba okulabibwa: “Abo, eyo y’empeera yaabwe.” Bw’ogaba olw’okulabibwa, ojja kufuna kyennyini kye wayagala: okulabibwa. Ekyo kyokka ky’onoofuna. Naye bw’ogaba mu kyama, Kitaawo alaba, era alikuwa empeera.

Kino tekitegeeza nti okugaba kwonna kulina kuba kwa kyama. Ekkanisa ey’olubereberye yali emanyi nti Balunabba yatunda ennimiro n’awaayo ensimbi. Oluusi okugaba kuba kwa lwatu, era ekyokulabirako kiyinza okusikiriza abalala. Ekibuuzo kiri ku kigendererwa. Ngaba okulabibwa abantu, oba Katonda?

George Müller yeeteekerawo etteeka obutafulumya mannya g’abo abaagabanga eri amaka g’abaana bamulekwa. Lipoota ze eza buli mwaka zaalaganga omuwendo n’olunaku lwa buli kirabo, naye si linnya ly’eyagaba. Yayagala ekitiibwa kidde eri Katonda yekka.

Katonda agabira omugabi

Tosubwa nkomerero y’okuyigiriza kwa Pawulo: “Katonda ayinza okwaza ekisa kyonna gye muli, bulijjo mubeerenga n’ebibamala byonna mu buli kintu nga musukkirira mu mulimu gwonna omulungi” (2 Abakkolinso 9:8). Era mu nnyiriri ntono oluvannyuma: “Anaabagaggawazanga mu buli kintu” (2 Abakkolinso 9:11).

Kino kye kigendererwa ky’ebyo Katonda by’atuwa. Atuwa tulyoke tusobole okugabira abalala. Tetuli bidiba omukisa mwe gukuŋŋaanira. Tuli mikutu omukisa mwe gukulukutira.

Eddoboozi okuva mu biseera eby’edda

Charles Spurgeon, ng’alowooza ku ngeri Katonda gy’ayisaamu abagabi, yawandiika nti:

“Abantu beesiga abawanika abalungi n’ensimbi eziyitirira bwe zigenda zeeyongera, era bwe kityo bwe kiba emirundi mingi ne Mukama; agabira mu bigaali abo abagaba mu bipimo.”

N’ayongerako ekigambo eky’okutebenkeza: “Obugagga bwe butaweebwa, Mukama afuula ekitono okuba ekingi olw’okumalibwa omutima omutukuziddwa kwe guwulira mu mugabo gwe, ogwaweebwayo ekimu eky’ekkumi eri Mukama.”

Ate A. B. Simpson yalaba ensonga esinga obuziba:

“Kyekyava Mukama waffe atuyigiriza okugaba, kubanga okugaba kitegeeza okwagala, ate okwagala liba linnya ddala eddala ery’obulamu.”

A. B. Simpson, Ennaku ez’Eggulu ku Nsi

Ky’okukola wiiki eno

Wiiki eno kola ekikolwa kimu eky’okugaba mu kyama. Gaba ekintu, ensimbi, ekijjulo, kaadi y’ekirabo, ensawo y’emmere, eri omuntu ali mu bwetaavu, era tobaako gw’obuulira. Tokibuulira mikwano gyo, era tokiteeka ku mikutu gy’empuliziganya. Kibeere kya wakati wo ne Kitaawo yekka.

Ku lw’ebibinja

  • Njawulo ki eriwo wakati w’okugaba n’essanyu n’okugaba olw’okunyigirizibwa? Amakanisa gayinza gatya okwewala okukozesa abantu mu bukujjukujju basobole okugaba?
  • Soma Engero 11:24-25. Olabye otya ennono eno ng’ekola?
  • Lwaki olowooza Yesu yassa essira ddene bwe lityo ku kugaba mu kyama?
  • Kitegeeza ki nti Katonda atuwa tulyoke tusobole okugabira abalala?

study_questions.question: Kitegeeza ki nti “Katonda ayagala oyo agaba n’essanyu”?
study_questions.answer: Katonda talina bwetaavu bwa nsimbi; ayagala mitima gyaffe, era essanyu lyoleka nti omutima guli mu kye tukola. Tojja kuwuliranga ssanyu buli lw’ogaba, era oluusi essanyu lijja oluvannyuma, naye okugaba tekusaanye kukakibwa olw’okwesalira omusango, okunyigirizibwa oba okukozesebwa mu bukujjukujju, “si lwa nnaku, newaakubadde olw’okuwalirizibwa.” Okwebaza olw’ekirabo kya Kristo ye ttaka mwe kukulira.

study_questions.question: Lwaki George Müller yalabula ku kugaba olw’okukubirizibwa obukubirizibwa?
study_questions.answer: Müller yagamba nti oyo alagajjalira okugaba okw’empisa era okwa bulijjo “okw’ennono era okwesigamye ku Byawandiikibwa” n’akulekera “ennewulira n’okukubirizibwa kyokka” “mazima ddala ajja kufiirwa.” Ne Pawulo yasaba Abakkolinso okusalawo ekirabo kyabwe mu mitima gyabwe n’okwawulangawo ensimbi buli wiiki. Okugaba okutegekeddwa nakyo kukuleka ng’oli wa ddembe okuyamba mu bwetaavu obw’enjawulo.

study_questions.question: Yesu agaana okugaba kwonna okwa lwatu?
study_questions.answer: Nedda. Mu Matayo 6:1-4 Yesu alabula nti abo abagaba okulabibwa, “eyo y’empeera yaabwe,” so nga Kitaffe alaba ebyama alibawa empeera. Naye ekkanisa ey’olubereberye yali emanyi nti Balunabba yatunda ennimiro n’awaayo ensimbi, era ekyokulabirako kiyinza okusikiriza abalala. Ekibuuzo kiri ku kigendererwa: ngaba okulabibwa abantu, oba Katonda?

fields.title: Okuwola Mukama
fields.body_html:
Mu Engero mulimu olunyiriri olwandikyusizza engeri gye tutunuuliramu buli mwavu gwe tusisinkana:

“Oyo akwatirwa omwavu ekisa awola Mukama, era Mukama alimusasula olw’ekikolwa kye ekyo.” (Engero 19:17)

Bw’owa omuntu ali mu bwetaavu, Katonda akitwala nga ggwe amuwoze Ye kennyini. Era Katonda bulijjo asasula amabanja ge.

Katonda afaayo ku baavu

Okuva ku ntandikwa ya Bayibuli okutuuka ku nkomerero yaayo, Katonda alaga nti afaayo mu ngeri ey’enjawulo ku mwavu, ku nnamwandu, ku mulekwa ne ku munnaggwanga. Bano be bantu abaali batalina ttaka, nga tebalina abakuuma, era nga tebalina ddoboozi mu nsi ey’edda, era Katonda yagamba enfunda n’enfunda nti Ye mulwanirizi waabwe.

Amateeka ga Musa gaateeka okufaayo ku baavu mu bulamu obwa buli lunaku. Abalimi tebaalina kukungula okutuuka ddala ku nsalosalo z’ennimiro zaabwe, wadde okulonda ebyo ebyagwanga wansi: “Obirekeranga abaavu ne bannamawanga. Nze Mukama Katonda wammwe” (Ebyabaleevi 19:10). Buli mwaka ogwokusatu ekimu eky’ekkumi kyalina okuweebwa Abaleevi, bannamawanga, bamulekwa ne bannamwandu. Amabanja gaalina okusonyiyibwa buli mwaka ogw’omusanvu. Era Musa yagamba Isirayiri engeri y’okuyisaamu muliraanwa ali mu bwetaavu:

“Tokakanyazanga mutima gwo wadde okukodowaliranga muganda wo oyo omwavu. Omwanjululizanga engalo zo, n’omuwolanga n’okwagala kyonna ky’anaabanga yeetaaga okumuwewulako obuzibu bwe.” (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 15:7-8)

“Omwanjululizanga engalo zo.” Nga kifaananyi kirungi! Ekikonde ekinywezeddwa kikwatirira. Omukono oguggule gugaba.

Bannabbi baddangamu bulijjo ensonga eno. Amosi yabwatuka ng’avumirira abo “abalinnyirira abali mu bwetaavu.” Mikka yafunza Katonda by’ayagala: “okukola eby’ensonga, okuba n’ekisa era n’okutambulira mu buwombeefu ne Katonda wo” (Mikka 6:8). Engero zigamba nti, “Omuntu atulugunya abaavu anyooma oyo eyabatonda, naye buli abakwatirwa ekisa, agulumiza Katonda” (Engero 14:31).

Yesu n’abaavu

Yesu yatandika obuweereza bwe ng’alangirira nti yali azze “okubuulira abaavu Amawulire Amalungi.” Yazaalibwa nga mwavu, yabeera mu baavu, era bulijjo yasikirizanga abantu okubafaako. Yagamba omuntu eyali afumbye ekijjulo obutayita mikwano gye abagagga, wabula “oyitanga abaavu, n’abagongobavu, n’abalema ne bamuzibe. Oliweebwa omukisa kubanga bo tebalina kya kukusasula” (Lukka 14:13-14).

Era mu kimu ku bintu bye yayigiriza ebisinga obuzito, yeegatta ddala n’abaavu. Ku musango ogw’enkomerero, bwe yagamba, Kabaka aligamba abatuukirivu nti:

“Kubanga nnali muyala ne mundiisa, nnali muyonta ne mumpa ekyokunywa, nnali mugenyi ne munnyaniriza, nnali bwereere ne munnyambaza, nnali mulwadde ne munnambula, nnali mu kkomera ne mujja okundaba.” (Matayo 25:35-36)

Bwe bamubuuza ddi lwe baakola ekyo, abaddamu nti: “Ddala ddala mbagamba nti bwe mwabikolera baganda bange bano abasembayo wansi kye kimu mwabikolera nze!” (Matayo 25:40).

Bw’oliisa omuntu omuyala, oliisa Yesu.

Okukkiriza okulina ebikolwa

Ekkanisa eyasooka kino yakitwala nga kikulu nnyo. Yakobo yawandiika nti:

“Singa muganda wo oba mwannyoko takyalina kyakwambala wadde ekyokulya, naye omu ku mmwe n’amugamba nti, “Genda mirembe, obugume, era olye bulungi”, naye nga tamuwaddeeyo byetaago bya mubiri, olwo kimugasa ki?” (Yakobo 2:15-16)

Ne Yokaana:

“Buli alina ebintu eby’omu nsi n’alaba muganda we nga yeetaaga, naye n’abulwako ky’amuwa, okwagala kwa Katonda, kuyinza kutya okuba mu ye? Abaana abaagalwa, tetusaana kwagala mu bigambo kyokka, wabula twagalanenga ne mu bikolwa ne mu bulamu obulabika eri abantu.” (1 Yokaana 3:17-18)

Ebigambo tebigula. Okwagala okutasumulula nsawo yaakwo si kwagala kwa Katonda.

Okugaba mu magezi eri abaavu

Okulabirira abaavu si kyangu bulijjo. Kyetaagisa amagezi era n’okusaasira. Bino by’ebimu ku misingi.

Tandikira kumpi. Pawulo agamba nti, “Noolwekyo, buli lwe kinaabanga kisobose tukolerenga abantu bonna ebirungi, na ddala ab’omu nnyumba ey’okukkiriza” (Abaggalatiya 6:10). Tandikira ku byetaago ebiri mu kkanisa yo, mu kitundu kyo, ne mu b’ennganda zo.

Gaba mu ngeri eziyamba. Oluusi ensimbi enkalu kye kirabo ekisinga obulungi. Oluusi ziyinza okuleeta obulabe. Emmere ey’okulya, ebisale ebisasuddwa butereevu, ensawo y’ebyokulya, oba okutwala omuntu gy’agenda okubuuzibwa ku mulimu biyinza okusinga. Buuza ekinaayamba ddala.

Ssaamu abantu ekitiibwa. Abaavu si pulojekiti. Bantu abaatondebwa mu kifaananyi kya Katonda. Bawulirize. Manya amannya gaabwe. Gy’osobola, yamba mu ngeri ezisobozesa abantu okukola n’okwerabirira bokka, nga Bowaazi bwe yakolera Luusi bwe yamukkiriza okulonda ebisigalira mu nnimiro ze.

Wagira abo abakikola obulungi. Amakanisa n’ebibiina by’Ekikristaayo bingi birina obumanyirivu n’amagezi mu kuyamba abaavu. Okugaba ng’oyita mu byo kisobola okwongera ennyo ku birungi by’okola.

Obuzibu bw’ensonga tobufuula kya kwekwasa. Kyangu okugamba nti, “Simanyi oba banaazikozesa bulungi,” n’olwekyo n’otogaba n’akatono. Kirungi okusobya oluusi ng’oli ku ludda lw’obugabi, okusinga okukakanyaza omutima gwo.

Obwenkanya, so si kuyamba kwokka

Bayibuli tetuyita kugaba eri baavu kwokka, wabula n’okukola eby’obwenkanya. Ekyo kitegeeza okusasula empeera ey’obwenkanya, okugaana okunyigiriza abantu, okwogerera abo abanyigirizibwa, n’okukola, we tusobola, okuleeta ensi ey’obwenkanya okusingawo. Bannabbi tebaavumirira bukodo bwokka, naye n’obutali bwenkanya: kkooti ezaalyanga enguzi, abasuubuzi abakumpanya, ne bannannyini ttaka abaamiranga ennimiro za baliraanwa baabwe. Abakristaayo abakwata ensimbi basaanye okuzikwata mu bwenkanya.

Eddoboozi okuva mu biseera eby’edda

John Wesley lumu yanyumya emboozi eyamuswaza ye kennyini. Bwe yali e Oxford, ku lunaku olumu olw’empewo ennyingi mu biseera by’obutiti, omuwala omuto omuweereza okuva mu ssomero lye yali ayambako okuddukanya yajja mu kisenge kye. Yali ayambadde kiteteeyi kyokka ekigonvu eky’olugoye lwa linena. Wesley yayingiza omukono mu nsawo ye okumuwaako ekintu, n’asanga nga kumpi takyalinaawo kantu. Yali yakazimalira ku bifaananyi eby’okuwanika ku bisenge bye. Ekyo kyamukuba ng’omuggo:

“Mukama wo alikugamba nti, ‘Weebale, omuwanika omulungi era omwesigwa’? Oyooyoosezza ebisenge byo n’ensimbi ezandibadde zikuuma ekitonde kino ekyavu okuva mu mpewo!”

John Wesley, Sermons on Several Occasions

Awalala yakyogera mu ngeri esinga okusala:

“Bwe muba nga musaasaanya ensimbi ezo ku ngoye ez’ebbeeyi, ze mwandisobodde okuterekera abaavu, olwo mubaggyako ekyo Katonda, nnannyini byonna, kye yateeka mu mikono gyammwe olw’okubagasa.”

Ky’okukola wiiki eno

Funa engeri emu ey’omugaso gy’oyinza okuyambamu omuntu omwavu wiiki eno: gula ebyokulya obiwe etterekero ly’emmere ery’abaavu, sasulira amaka agali mu buzibu ebisale, twalira muliraanwa emmere, oba gaba mu ssanduuko y’ekkanisa ey’abali mu bwetaavu. Bwe kiba kisoboka, kikole ggwe kennyini, era manya erinnya ly’omuntu gw’oyamba.

Ku lw’ebibinja

  • Kitegeeza ki nti okugaba eri abaavu kwe “kuwola Mukama”?
  • Soma Matayo 25:31-40. Ekitundu kino kikyusa kitya engeri gy’olabamu abaavu?
  • Engeri ki ez’amagezi n’ezitali za magezi ez’okuyamba abantu abali mu bwetaavu?
  • Butali bwenkanya ki mu kitundu kyo Katonda bw’ayinza okuba ng’ayita Abakristaayo okukolako?

study_questions.question: Bayibuli eyogera ki ku ngeri Katonda gy’afaayo ku baavu?
study_questions.answer: Okuva ku ntandikwa ya Bayibuli okutuuka ku nkomerero yaayo, Katonda alwanirira omwavu, nnamwandu, omulekwa n’omunnaggwanga. Amateeka gaalekanga ensalosalo z’ennimiro eri abalonzi b’ebisigalira, ne gaweereza ekimu eky’ekkumi eky’omwaka ogwokusatu eri abali mu bwetaavu, ne gasonyiwa amabanja buli mwaka ogw’omusanvu, era Musa yagamba nti, “Omwanjululizanga engalo zo, n’omuwolanga n’okwagala.” Okunyigiriza abaavu kunyooma oyo eyabatonda (Engero 14:31).

study_questions.question: Yesu yali ategeeza ki bwe yagamba nti okuweereza abasembayo wansi kwali kumukolera Ye?
study_questions.answer: Mu Matayo 25, Kabaka agamba abatuukirivu nti bwe yali muyala, muyonta, mugenyi, bwereere, mulwadde oba mu kkomera, baamulabirira. “Bwe mwabikolera baganda bange bano abasembayo wansi kye kimu mwabikolera nze!” Yesu yeegatta ddala n’abaavu: bw’oliisa omuntu omuyala, oliisa Ye.

study_questions.question: Kiki ekyaliwo John Wesley bwe yamala ensimbi ze ku bifaananyi?
study_questions.answer: E Oxford, ku lunaku lw’empewo ennyingi mu biseera by’obutiti, omuwala omuto yajja mu kisenge kye ng’ayambadde kiteteeyi kyokka ekigonvu ekya linena. Bwe yagezaako okumuwaako ekintu, n’asanga nga kumpi takyalina kantu, kubanga yali yakagula ebifaananyi eby’okuwanika ku bisenge bye. Yeekangavvula yekka: “Oyooyoosezza ebisenge byo n’ensimbi ezandibadde zikuuma ekitonde kino ekyavu okuva mu mpewo!”

fields.title: Gaba Kyonna ky’Osobola
fields.body_html:
Yesu yatuula emitala w’eggwanika lya yeekaalu, n’atunuulira abantu nga bateekamu ebiweebwayo byabwe. Abagagga bangi bajja ne basuulamu ensimbi nnyingi. Ensimbi bwe zaali zigwa mu ggwanika nga zivuga, zateekwa okuba nga zaavanga eddoboozi eriwulikika obulungi ennyo.

Awo nnamwandu omwavu n’ajja n’ateekamu obusente bubiri obutono ddala, obusente obwali businga obutono bwonna, nga tebutuuka na ku peni emu. Yesu n’ayita abayigirizwa be.

“Ddala ddala mbagamba nti nnamwandu oyo omwavu awaddeyo nnyo okusinga bonna bali abatadde mu ggwanika. Kubanga bonna bataddemu ku bibafikkiridde, naye ate nnamwandu ono mu kwetaaga kwe ataddemu kyonna ky’abadde nakyo, ekibadde kijja okumuyamba obulamu bwe bwonna.” (Makko 12:43-44)

Engeri Katonda gy’abala

Mu kubala kwa Katonda, nnamwandu yawaayo okusinga bonna. Kiba kitya? Kubanga Katonda tapima kirabo okusinziira ku bunene bwakyo. Akipima okusinziira ku kye kisasuzza. Abagagga baagaba ku bibafikkiridde. Baali bakyalina bingi. Nnamwandu yagaba mu bwavu bwe. Teyasigaza kintu.

Gano mawulire malungi eri abantu abalina ebitono. Ekirabo kyo ekitono, ky’ogaba nga weefiiriza, kiyinza okuba eky’omuwendo ennyo mu ggulu okusinga ekirabo ekinene ekigabiddwa okuva mu bulamu obunyuvu. Katonda tasikirizibwa bunene. Atunuulira omutima, n’ekyo ekirabo kye kisasuzza oyo agaba.

Omubuulizi w’okuzuukuka Omumerika, Charles Finney, yagamba ekintu kye kimu eri abakkiriza abagagga ab’omu kkanisa mu mulembe gwe:

“Oboolyawo omukazi oli omwavu, ateekamu senti kkumi n’ebbiri n’ekitundu mu lukuŋŋaana lw’okusaba olwa buli mwezi, yeegaanye nnyo okusinga bo bwe bagaba enkumi n’enkumi.”

Era kino kisoomooza abo abalina ebingi. Katonda bw’aba apima n’ebyo bye tusigaza nga bw’apima bye tugaba, bangi ku ffe abagaba omuwendo oguwulikika ng’omunene tukyagaba ku bitufikkiridde. Tugaba ekyo kye tutaliwulira nti kitubulako.

Etteeka lya Wesley ery’okusatu

Tumaze okulaba amateeka abiri agasooka aga John Wesley: “Funa kyonna ky’osobola” ne “Tereka kyonna ky’osobola.” Etteeka lye ery’okusatu kye kifo gye gatutwala:

“Bw’omala, okusooka, okufuna kyonna ky’osobola, n’okubiri okutereka kyonna ky’osobola, olwo ‘gaba kyonna ky’osobola.’”

John Wesley, Enkozesa y’Ensimbi

Wesley yalabula nti omuntu afuna n’atereka naye n’atagaba ali mu kabi kanene. Okufuna n’okutereka awatali kugaba kikufuula mukodo mugagga okusingawo. Ekigendererwa kyonna eky’okufuna n’okutereka kwe kugaba.

Era ekyo yakitambuliramu mu bulamu bwe. Emboozi etera okunyumizibwa ku ye yava mu bawandiisi b’ebyafaayo bye abaasooka. Bwe yali akyali muvubuka e Oxford, yakizuula nti asobola okubeera ku pawundi nga 28 buli mwaka, n’agaba ezaasigalangawo. Ensimbi ze yafunanga bwe zaakubisaamu emirundi ebiri, n’oluvannyuma ne zeeyongera, yasigala ng’abeera ku pawundi ze zimu 28, n’agaba endala zonna. Ensimbi ze zaakula, naye engeri gye yabeerangamu n’esigala nnyangu. Ku nkomerero y’obulamu bwe, ebitabo bye byamuyingiza ensimbi nnyingi nnyo, era kumpi zonna zaagenda eri abaavu n’eri omulimu gw’enjiri.

Okusoomooza kwa Wesley gye tuli si “waayo ekimu eky’ekkumi.” Kuli “gaba kyonna ky’osobola.” Ekyo tekitegeeza kugaba buli kimu n’oleka amaka go mu bwavu obw’amaanyi. Kitegeeza: sooka olabirire ebyetaago byo ebyannamaddala, olwo weebuuze nti, nsobola okugaba ekisingawo kyenkana wa?

Ekkomo ku nsaasaanya

Engeri emu ey’omugaso ey’okugoberera Wesley kwe kuteeka ekkomo ku ngeri gy’obeeramu. Salawo ggwe n’ab’omu maka go kye mwetaaga ddala okubeerawo, mu bulamu obwangu naye nga si bwa nnaku. Olwo, ensimbi zo bwe zigenda zeeyongera, leka okugaba kwo kweyongere mu kifo ky’ensaasaanya yo.

Abasinga obungi ku ffe tukola ekyennyume. Ensimbi ze tufuna bwe zeeyongera, n’engeri gye tubeeramu yeeyongera okwenkanankana nazo. Ennyumba ennene, emmotoka empya, ennaku z’okuwummula ez’ebbeeyi ennyo. Mu bbanga ttono, tuwulira nga tunyigirizibwa ku nsimbi ennyingi nga bwe twawuliranga ku ntono. Kino oluusi kiyitibwa “ensaasaanya eyeeyongera mpolampola,” era y’emu ku nsonga enkulu lwaki abantu abafuna ennyo tebagaba nnyo.

Okuteeka ekkomo ku nsaasaanya y’engeri ey’okugamba nti, “Kimala.” Kye kyennyume ky’omululu. Kisumulula ensimbi ennyingi buli mwaka ku lw’omulimu gwa Katonda.

Okuyita kw’abagagga

Pawulo yawa Timoseewo ebiragiro ebitongole ku lw’abagagga ab’omu kkanisa ye, ng’amugamba abalagire:

“Bakole ebirungi, babe bagagga mu bikolwa ebirungi, nga bagabi, era abaagala okugabana n’abalala. Bwe batyo beeterekere obugagga obw’engeri eyo nga gwe musingi omulungi ogw’ebiseera ebigenda okujja, balyoke banywezenga obulamu bwennyini.” (1 Timoseewo 6:18-19)

Weetegereze: “babe bagagga mu bikolwa ebirungi.” Abagagga tebagambibwa kulekera awo kuba bagagga. Bagambibwa okufuuka abagagga mu nsimbi za ngeri ndala, era okukozesa obugagga obusooka okufuna obw’okubiri.

Era weetegereze ekivaamu: “balyoke banywezenga obulamu bwennyini.” Okugaba si kufiirwa bulamu. Y’engeri gye tukwata obulamu obwa nnamaddala. Obukodo bukendeeza emmeeme. Obugabi bugigaziya.

Okugaba okw’okwefiiriza

Ekkanisa ez’e Makedoniya Pawulo ze yatendereza mu 2 Abakkolinso 8 zaali zaavu nnyo, naye ate “Tebaagaba kutuuka we basobola wokka, naye nawo baasukkawo, era baagaba lwa kweyagalira” (2 Abakkolinso 8:3). Okwo kwe kugaba okw’okwefiiriza: okugaba okukusasuza. Kwe kugaba okutegeeza nti weerekereza ekintu ky’oyandyagadde.

Eri abasinga obungi ku ffe, okugaba okw’okwefiiriza tekujja kutegeeza kugaba buli kimu. Naye kuteekwa okutegeeza okugaba ekimala ne tukiwulira. Okugaba kwaffe bwe kuba nga tekukwata ku ngeri gye tubeeramu n’akatono, kiyinza okuba nti bulijjo tugaba ku bitufikkiridde bwokka.

Buli kimu

Nnamwandu yawaayo “kyonna ky’abadde nakyo, ekibadde kijja okumuyamba obulamu bwe bwonna.” Ku nkomerero, ekyo Katonda ky’asaba buli muyigirizwa. Si nti buli kiseera ensimbi zaffe zonna, wabula ffe ffennyini ffenna. Ab’e Makedoniya “baasooka kwewaayo eri Mukama.” Bwe tumala okwewaayo, ensimbi zaffe zigoberera.

Eddoboozi okuva mu biseera eby’edda

Amy Carmichael, omuminsani mu Buyindi, yawandiika akatabo akatono ak’ebibuuzo ebikebera omutima ku kye yayita “okwagala kwa Kalvaliyo.” Kimu ku byo kigenda butereevu mu mutima gw’okugaba:

“Bwe wabaawo kye nkwekweeka mu kugaba kwange eri Oyo eyanjagala ennyo n’awaayo ekisinga okuba eky’omuwendo gy’ali ku lwange... olwo sirina kye mmanyi ku kwagala kwa Kalvaliyo.”

Amy Carmichael, If

Ky’okukola wiiki eno

Bala, mu bufunze, ggwe n’ab’omu maka go kye mwetaaga okubeerawo, mu bulamu obwangu naye nga si bwa nnaku. Kiwandiike. Olwo saba ku kibuuzo kino: ensimbi ze nfuna bwe zinaayongera omwaka ogujja, nnyinza okuleka okugaba kwange ne kweyongera mu kifo ky’ensaasaanya yange?

Ku lw’ebibinja

  • Lwaki Yesu yagamba nti nnamwandu yawaayo okusinga abalala bonna?
  • Kisoboka omuntu okugaba omuwendo omunene naye n’akyagaba ku bimufikkiridde? Mwandikimanye mutya?
  • Mulowooza ki ku nkola ya Wesley ey’okuteeka ekkomo ku nsaasaanya ye ey’okubeerawo? Mwandisobodde okukola ekintu ekifaananako bwe kityo?
  • Njawulo ki eriwo wakati w’okugaba okw’okwefiiriza n’okugaba okutali kwa buvunaanyizibwa?

study_questions.question: Katonda apima atya obunene bw’ekirabo?
study_questions.answer: Si okusinziira ku bunene bwakyo, wabula ku kye kisasuzza. Abagagga baagaba ku bibafikkiridde, naye nnamwandu, n’obusente bubiri obutono ddala, yawaayo “kyonna ky’abadde nakyo, ekibadde kijja okumuyamba obulamu bwe bwonna” (Makko 12:43-44). Ekirabo ekitono ekigabiddwa nga weefiiriza kiyinza okuba eky’omuwendo ennyo mu ggulu okusinga ekirabo ekinene ekigabiddwa okuva mu bulamu obunyuvu, nga Charles Finney bwe yagamba abakkiriza abagagga ab’omu kkanisa mu mulembe gwe.

study_questions.question: John Wesley yatambulira atya mu tteeka lye “Gaba kyonna ky’osobola”?
study_questions.answer: Bwe yali akyali muvubuka e Oxford, Wesley yakizuula nti asobola okubeera ku pawundi nga 28 buli mwaka n’agaba ezaasigalangawo. Ensimbi ze bwe zaakubisaamu emirundi ebiri ne zeeyongera n’okusingawo, yasigala ng’abeera ku muwendo gwe gumu n’agaba endala zonna. Ku nkomerero y’obulamu bwe ebitabo bye byamuyingiza ensimbi nnyingi nnyo, era kumpi zonna zaagenda eri abaavu n’eri enjiri.

study_questions.question: “Ensaasaanya eyeeyongera mpolampola” kye ki, era Abakristaayo bayinza batya okugiziyiza?
study_questions.answer: Kwe kuleka ensaasaanya okweyongera okwenkanankana na buli musaala ogwongezeddwa, ennyumba ennene, emmotoka empya n’ennaku z’okuwummula ez’ebbeeyi, okutuusa lwe tuwulira nga tunyigirizibwa nga bwe twali edda. Okuteeka ekkomo ku nsaasaanya, nga tusalawo kye twetaaga okubeerawo “mu bulamu obwangu naye nga si bwa nnaku,” kireka okugaba okweyongera mu kifo kyayo. Y’engeri ey’okugamba nti “Kimala,” era kye kyennyume ky’omululu.

fields.title: Omwesigwa mu Bintu Ebitono
fields.body_html:
Hudson Taylor yali muvubuka omuyambi w’omusawo mu kibuga Hull, ng’yeeteekerateekera okugenda e China ng’omuminsani. Yali amaliridde nti yeetaaga okuyiga okwesiga Katonda ku nsonga y’ensimbi nga tannava mu Bungereza. Yalowooza nti, bw’aba tasobola kwesiga Katonda ng’ali e Hull, yandimwesize atya ng’ali e China? Kale mukama we bwe yeerabira okumusasula omusaala gwe, Taylor teyamujjukiza. Mu kifo ky’ekyo, yasaba.

Ekiro ky’olunaku lwa Mukaaga lumu, yakizuula nti yali asigazza ssente emu yokka, half-crown. Akawungeezi ka Ssande eyo, omusajja omwavu yamusaba ajje asabire mukyala we eyali ali kumpi kufa. Taylor yamugoberera n’atuuka mu kisenge ekyali mu mbeera embi ennyo, mwe mwali maama agalamidde ng’akooye nnyo okumpi n’omwana omuwere, n’abaana abalala abawerako nga bayimiridde awo, amatama gaabwe nga gagwiiridde olw’enjala ey’ekiseera ekiwanvu.

Taylor n’atandika okubabuulira ku Kitaffe ow’okwagala ali mu ggulu, naye ebigambo bye yennyini ne bimusalira omusango. Yakitegeera nti yali asobola okwesiga Katonda “nga kw’ogasse silingi emu ne sente mukaaga,” naye si nga mu nsawo ye temuli kantu. Bwe yagezaako okusaba, omuntu we ow’omunda n’amugamba nti, “Oyinza otya okufukamira n’omuyita Kitaffe nga half-crown eyo ekyali mu nsawo yo?” Ku nkomerero yawa omusajja ssente eyo, ssente ye esembayo mu nsi. Yawandiika nti, “Essanyu lyonna ne likomawo mu mutima gwange ng’amazzi amangi agajjula.”

Enkeera ne wajja ebbaluwa nga temuli linnya wadde obubaka, wabula ggalavu ez’emikono bbiri. Bwe yazaanjuluza, half-sovereign n’egwa wansi, emirundi ena ku ekyo kye yali awaddeyo. Nga wayise emyaka mingi, oluvannyuma lw’obulamu bw’okwesiga Katonda mu bizibu ebinene e China, yatunuulira emabega ekiro ekyo n’awandiika nti:

“Bwe tuba abeesigwa eri Katonda mu bintu ebitono, tujja kufuna obumanyirivu n’amaanyi ebinaatuyamba mu kugezesebwa okw’amaanyi okw’obulamu.”

Ebintu ebitono, ebintu ebinene

Taylor yali addamu ebigambo bya Yesu, eyagamba nti:

“Omuntu omwesigwa mu kintu ekitono, abeera mwesigwa ne mu kinene; n’oyo ataba mwesigwa mu kitono era ne mu kinene taba mwesigwa. Kale obanga temwesigibwa mu bugagga obutali butuukirivu, ani agenda okubeesiga mu bugagga obw’amazima?” (Lukka 16:10-11)

Yesu ensimbi aziyita “ekintu ekitono.” Gye tuli ensimbi zirabika ng’ekintu ekinene ennyo. Ze zisalawo gye tubeera, kye tulya, n’engeri gye tuwuliramu nga tuli mirembe. Naye okuva mu ggulu, ensimbi kye kimu ku bintu ebisinga obutono mu bulamu. Lumu zonna zirivaawo. Kyokka Yesu agamba nti engeri gye tukwatamu ekintu kino ekitono eraga era ebumba empisa zaffe olw’ebintu ebinene.

Ebintu ebinene bye biruwa? Yesu abiyita “obugagga obw’amazima,” oba nga enkyusa za Bayibuli enkadde bwe zigamba, “obugagga obwa nnamaddala.” Bino bye bintu ebibeerawo emirembe gyonna: abantu, emmeeme, obwakabaka bwa Katonda, empisa, empeera etaggwaawo, obuvunaanyizibwa mu mulembe ogujja. Ensimbi kye kifo eky’okutendekerwamu. Bwe tuba nga tetuyinza kwesigibwa na bugagga obuyita obw’ensi eno, lwaki Katonda yandituteresa obugagga obw’ensi ejja?

Ensimbi kigezo

Kino kitegeeza nti buli kusalawo ku nsimbi, ne bwe kuba kutono kutya, kitundu ku bulamu bwaffe ng’abayigirizwa. Engeri gy’okwatamu pawundi entono ez’ensimbi ensaanuuse mu nsawo yo, engeri gy’ojjuzaamu foomu y’ebisaasaanyizo, engeri gy’oyisaamu omuweereza mu wooteeri, engeri gy’oddamu omuntu bw’akusaba obuyambi, byonna kitundu ku kutendeka kwa Katonda.

Ekyo kitukubiriza okwekenneenya era kituzzaamu amaanyi. Kitukubiriza okwekenneenya kubanga kitegeeza nti tewali kintu kiyitibwa kwekkiriranya okutono. Bw’okumpanya mu kitono, ojja kukumpanya ne mu kinene, singa ofuna omukisa. Naye kituzzaamu amaanyi kubanga kitegeeza nti tekikwetaagisa kuba mugagga okusobola okuba omwesigwa. Nnamwandu ng’alina obusente bubiri n’omugagga ow’obukadde ng’alina obugagga obungi bayita mu kigezo kye kimu. Obwesigwa mu kitono bwa muwendo eri Katonda nga obwesigwa mu kingi.

Olugero lwa ttalanta

Yesu yagera olugero lw’omusajja eyagenda olugendo oluwanvu n’akwasa abaddu be ebintu bye. “Eyasooka yamuwa ttalanta ttaano, owookubiri bbiri n’owookusatu emu, ng’ageraageranya ng’okusobola kwa buli omu bwe kwali.” (Matayo 25:15) Abaddu ababiri abaasooka ne bakozesa ensimbi ne bazikubisaamu emirundi ebiri. Ow’okusatu n’aziika eyiye mu ttaka.

Mukama waabwe bwe yakomawo, buli omu ku babiri abaasooka n’amugamba ebigambo bye bimu ddala:

“Weebale, oli muddu mulungi era mwesigwa, obadde mwesigwa mu bintu ebitono, ndikusigira ebintu ebingi. Yingira sanyukira wamu ne mukama wo.” (Matayo 25:21)

Omuddu eyalina ttalanta ttaano n’oyo eyalina bbiri baafuna okutenderezebwa kwe kumu. Mukama waabwe teyabageraageranya. Yabuuza bubuuza obanga buli omu yali mwesigwa ku ebyo bye yaweebwa.

Naye omuddu ow’okusatu, eyali aweereddwa ttalanta emu, yagikweka. Yagamba nti yali atya mukama we. Mukama we n’amuyita mubi era mugayaavu, n’amuggyako ne kye yalina.

Eky’okuyiga kyeyoleka. Katonda awa abantu ab’enjawulo ebigera eby’enjawulo, eby’ensimbi, eby’ebitone, eby’emikisa n’eby’obudde. Tasuubira buli muntu kuvaamu kye kimu.
