Asuubira buli omu ku ffe okuba omwesigwa n’ebyo by’alina, n’okubikozesa ku lulwe. Ekibi ekinene mu lugero si kufiirwa nsimbi. Kwe kuzirekera awo nga tozikozesezza olw’okutya.

Obwesigwa mu bulamu obwa bulijjo

Obwesigwa mu kitono bufaanana butya buli lunaku?

Obwesimbu mu bintu ebitono. Zzaayo ensimbi ez’okukyusa ezisukkiridde. Tegeeza ensobi eyakuganyula. Sasulira ekintu ekimenyese.

Okufaayo mu bintu ebitono. Labirira by’olina. Tosaasaanya mmere, masannyalaze oba ebintu. Bw’osobola, ddaabiriza ebintu mu kifo ky’okubisuula.

Obugabi mu bintu ebitono. Tolinda kusooka kugaggawala olyoke obeere mugabi. Gaba ky’osobola kati. Abantu bangi bagamba nti, “Bwe ndifuna ebisingawo, ndigaba bingi.” Naye bw’oba toli mugabi mu kitono, oboolyawo toliba mugabi ne mu kingi.

Obunyiikivu mu bintu ebitono. Wandiika by’osaasaanya. Sasula bbiru zo mu budde. Tuukiriza ebisuubizo byo.

Okusaba mu bintu ebitono. Leeta eri Katonda ne ensonga z’ensimbi entono. Taylor yayiga okukkiriza ng’asaba ku silingi ntono ez’omusaala gwe. Katonda afaayo ku buli kantu.

Obugagga obutali butuukirivu

Waliwo ekirala kimu. Nga tannayogera bigambo bye ku bwesigwa, Yesu yagera olumu ku ngero ze ezisinga okwewuunyisa, ku muwanika omukumpanya eyali anaatera okugobwa, n’akozesa ensimbi za mukama we okwefunira emikwano egyandimusembezza. Yesu tatendereza bukumpanya bwe. Atendereza amagezi ge: omusajja oyo yakozesa ensimbi, ze yali agenda okufiirwa ne bwe kityo, okweteekerateekera ebiseera bye eby’omu maaso.

Awo Yesu n’akiteeka mu nkola: “mwefunire emikwano mu bugagga obutali butuukirivu, bwe buliggwaawo balyoke babasembeze mu weema ezitaggwaawo” (Lukka 16:9). Mu ngeri endala, kozesa ensimbi, z’otasobola kukuuma, ku bintu by’osobola okukuuma: abantu n’obulamu obutaggwaawo. Zikozese okuwa abalala omukisa, okuwagira enjiri, n’okuyamba abaavu. Lumu ensimbi zirivaawo. Abantu be wayamba, n’okukwaniriza kwe balikwaniriza, biribeerawo emirembe gyonna.

Eddoboozi okuva mu biseera eby’edda

Charles Spurgeon yayogera ku musingi guno mu sentensi bbiri ezijjukirwa:

“Zaabu wa Katonda si nsimbi za mukodo, wabula yakolebwa okusuubulibwamu.”

Charles H. Spurgeon, Morning by Morning

“Ebintu byo tebibeera mu bukuumi nnyo ng’ekiseera bw’oba ng’oyagala okubiwaayo, era tobeera mugagga nnyo ng’ekiseera bw’oteeka byonna by’olina mu mukono gwa Mukama.”

Charles H. Spurgeon, Ebyalondebwa mu Binywa

Ky’okukola wiiki eno

Buli lunaku wiiki eno, noonya “ekintu ekitono” kimu mw’osobola okuba omwesigwa n’ensimbi: okuzzaayo ensimbi ez’okukyusa ezisukkiridde, okusasula ebbanja ettono lye wali weerabidde, okuwaayo ekirabo ekitono, okuwandiika obulungi ekintu ky’oguze. Ku nkomerero ya wiiki, fumiitiriza ku ngeri okulonda kuno okutono gye kukubumbye.

Ku lw’ebibinja

  • Olowooza lwaki Yesu ensimbi aziyita “ekintu ekitono”?
  • “Obugagga obw’amazima” oba “obugagga obwa nnamaddala” Yesu bw’ayogerako mu Lukka 16:11 bwe buluwa?
  • Mu lugero lwa ttalanta, lwaki abaddu abaalina ttalanta ttaano ne bbiri baafuna okutenderezebwa kwe kumu?
  • Wa w’osinga okukemebwa obutaba mwesigwa mu bintu ebitono?

study_questions.question: Kiki ekyaliwo Hudson Taylor bwe yawaayo half-crown ye esembayo?
study_questions.answer: Bwe yayitibwa eri amaka agaali gafa enjala e Hull, Taylor yakitegeera nti yali asobola okwesiga Katonda “nga kw’ogasse silingi emu ne sente mukaaga” naye si nga talina kantu, era omuntu we ow’omunda n’amubuuza engeri gye yandisobodde okuyita Katonda Kitaffe nga ssente eyo ekyali mu nsawo ye. Yagiwaayo, essanyu ne likomawo nga lijjuvu. Enkeera ebbaluwa n’ereeta ggalavu ez’emikono bbiri ne half-sovereign, emirundi ena ku ekyo kye yali awaddeyo.

study_questions.question: Yesu ayigiriza ki mu Lukka 16:10 ku kuba omwesigwa n’ensimbi?
study_questions.answer: Engeri gye tukwatamu ensimbi, ekintu ekitono era ekiyita, eraga era ebumba empisa zaffe olw’ebintu ebinene. Ekyo kitukubiriza okwekenneenya, kubanga tewali kintu kiyitibwa kwekkiriranya okutono. Era kituzzaamu amaanyi, kubanga tekikwetaagisa kuba mugagga okusobola okuba omwesigwa: nnamwandu ng’alina obusente bubiri n’omugagga ow’obukadde ng’alina obugagga obungi bayita mu kigezo kye kimu.

study_questions.question: Lwaki omuddu ow’okusatu mu lugero lwa ttalanta yasalirwa omusango?
study_questions.answer: Bwe yaweebwa ttalanta emu, yagiziika, ng’agamba nti yali atya mukama we, eyamuyita omubi era omugayaavu. Eky’okuyiga kiri nti Katonda awa abantu ab’enjawulo ebigera eby’enjawulo era asuubira buli omu okuba omwesigwa n’okubikozesa ku lulwe. Ekibi ekinene mu lugero si kufiirwa nsimbi, wabula kuzirekera awo nga tozikozesezza olw’okutya.

fields.title: Ensimbi n’Omulimu gwa Katonda
fields.body_html:
Yesu bwe yatuma abayigirizwa be abaasooka okubuulira, yabagamba obutatwala nsimbi. “Omukozi asaanira empeera ye” (Lukka 10:7), bwe yagamba. Baalina okwesigama ku kusembeza kw’abantu be baali baweereza. Okuva ku ntandikwa, okubuna kw’Enjiri kwesigamanga ku bantu ba Katonda okuggulawo amaka gaabwe n’ensawo zaabwe.

Bwe kityo bwe kibadde okuva olwo. Lukka atugamba nti Yesu bwe yali atambula okuva mu kibuga ekimu okudda mu kirala, ekibinja ky’abakazi baagendanga naye, nga mu bo mwe muli Maliyamu Magudaleene ne Jowaana, muka omukulu w’olubiri lwa Kerode. Bano be bakazi “abaatoolanga ku byabwe ne balabirira Yesu n’abayigirizwa be” (Lukka 8:3). Obuweereza bw’Omwana wa Katonda bwayimirizibwangawo, mu kitundu, olw’obugabi bw’abakazi bano.

Abakolera awamu mu Njiri

Ebbaluwa Pawulo gye yawandiikira Abafiripi, mu bintu ebirala, ebbaluwa ya kwebaza olw’ensimbi. Ekkanisa ey’e Firipi yayamba Pawulo emirundi n’emirundi, ng’emuweereza ebirabo bwe yali asimba amakanisa mu bifo ebirala era ne bwe yali mu kkomera. Pawulo abayita abakolera awamu naye mu Njiri. Awandiika nti:

“Soogera kino lwa kubanga njagala okufuna ekirabo, wabula kye njagala kwe kulaba ng’ekibala kyeyongera ku lwammwe. Naye kaakano nfunye bingi okusinga bye neetaaga, kino kisinzidde mu ebyo bye mwampeereza, Epafuladito bye yandeetera. Biri ng’akaloosa akalungi ennyo aka ssaddaaka esanyusa era esiimibwa Katonda.” (Abafiripi 4:17-18)

Weetegereze ebintu bibiri. Ekisooka, Pawulo agamba nti okugaba kwabwe kwali kwongera “ekibala” ku lwabwe bo bennyini. Bwe tugaba okuyamba Enjiri, tugabana ku bibala by’omulimu ogwo. Buli muntu akkiriza ng’ayita mu muminsani gwe tuyamba, mu ngeri emu, abalibwa ne ku lwaffe.

Eky’okubiri, Pawulo ekirabo kyabwe akiyita “akaloosa akalungi ennyo aka ssaddaaka esanyusa era esiimibwa Katonda.” Okugaba okuyamba omulimu gwa Katonda si nsonga ya nsimbi yokka. Kwe kusinza, nga bwe kiri ku luyimba lwonna oba okusaba kwonna.

Awo ne kujja ekisuubizo: “Kale ne Katonda wange alibawa buli kye mwetaaga ng’obugagga bwe obungi obuli mu Kristo Yesu bwe buli” (Abafiripi 4:19). Olunyiriri luno olumanyiddwa ennyo terwawandiikirwa bantu abaakuŋŋaanya bukuŋŋaanya ensimbi ne bazitereka. Lwawandiikirwa abantu abaali bagabye n’omutima omugabi eri omulimu gwa Katonda.

Okuyamba abo abayigiriza

Endagaano Empya eraga lwatu nti amakanisa galina okuyamba abo abayigiriza n’ababuulira. “Oyo ayigirizibwa ekigambo kya Katonda, agabanirenga wamu n’amuyigiriza ku birungi byonna by’alina” (Abaggalatiya 6:6). Pawulo yannyonnyola mu bujjuvu mu 1 Abakkolinso 9 nti abo ababuulira Enjiri basaanidde okuggya obulamu bwabwe mu Njiri, newakubadde nga ye kennyini emirundi mingi yasalawo obutakozesa ddembe eryo.

Ekyo kitegeeza nti okugaba kwaffe kusaanidde okutandikira mu kkanisa yaffe, gye tuyigirizibwa, gye tuliisibwa era gye tulabirirwa. Naye tekusaanidde kukoma awo. Omulimu gwa Katonda gutuuka ku nkomerero z’ensi.

Okutuuka ku nkomerero z’ensi

Ekiragiro kya Yesu ekisembayo eri abayigirizwa be kyali kugenda okufuula amawanga gonna abayigirizwa. Abamu bayitibwa okugenda. Abasingawo obungi bayitibwa okutuma. Awatali batuma, tewabaawo bagenda.

Leero wakyaliwo obuwumbi n’obuwumbi bw’abantu abatawulirangako Njiri ng’ennyonnyoddwa bulungi, bangi ku bo nga bali mu bifo ebirimu abakkiriza batono n’obujulirwa bw’Ekikristaayo butono. Wakyaliwo ennimi ezitalina Bayibuli. Waliwo abakkiriza mu nsi ezisingako obwavu abakola n’ebintu bitono nnyo. Ensimbi zaffe zisobola okuyamba.

Lowooza ku ebyo okugaba bye kusobola okukola: okuyamba amaka g’abaminsani, okusasulira okuvvuunula Bayibuli, okutendeka abasumba mu bifo ebirimu amatendekero g’eby’eddiini matono, okukuba n’okugaba Ebyawandiikibwa, okuyamba ekkanisa eyiganyizibwa okuwangaala. Ekirabo ekitono okuva ku Mukristaayo ali obulungi kisobola okuleeta enjawulo ennene ennyo awalala.

Ensimbi awatali kusaba

Naye ensimbi zokka tezimala. E. M. Bounds, eyawandiika ebimu ku bitabo ebisinga obukulu ku kusaba, yalabula mu Ebikulu mu Kusaba nti ensimbi eziweebwayo awatali kusaba tezisobola kukola kinene:

“Ensimbi nkulu, naye ensimbi awatali kusaba tezirina maanyi mu maaso g’ekizikiza, g’obunaku n’ekibi ebiri mu nsi Enjiri gy’etannatuuka.”

Era yalaba ekintu ku kkanisa ekikyali ekituufu:

“Newankubadde okugaba kwaffe kutono, ensimbi ze tuwaayo zisinga ebiweebwayo byaffe eby’okusaba.”

E. M. Bounds, Ekigendererwa mu Kusaba

Omulimu gwa Katonda gwa mwoyo. Gutambuzibwa Mwoyo Mutukuvu ng’ayita mu kusaba, era ensimbi muddu wa mulimu ogwo, so si kintu kya kudda mu kifo kyagwo. Abagabi abasinga obulungi era be basinga okusaba. Bw’oba oyamba omuminsani, musabire ng’omwogerako erinnya lye. Bw’oba ogaba eri ensonga emu, sabira abantu b’eweereza.

Ebiseera bwe bikaluba

Kino kibuuzo kizibu. Ensimbi bwe zifuuka ntono, kiki ekisooka okuvaawo? Eri Abakristaayo bangi, eky’okuddamu kwe kugaba. Nga Martyn Lloyd-Jones bwe yalaga, “Ensimbi bwe zikaluba, ekintu kye tusooka okukendeeza kwe kuwaayo kwaffe eri omulimu gwa Katonda.”

Ekyo kitegeerekeka. Naye lowooza ku kye kyogera. Kyogera nti omulimu gwa Katonda kye kintu ekisembayo obukulu mu bajeti yaffe, ekisooka okusalibwako. Ebimu ku kugaba okusinga okuzzaamu amaanyi mu byafaayo kwava mu Bakristaayo abaali mu biseera ebizibu abaagaana okusooka okusala ku mugabo gwa Katonda. Pawulo yayogera ku makanisa g’e Makedoni nti, “Mu kugezesebwa okw’okubonaabona, baagattika essanyu lyabwe ery’ekitalo n’obwavu bwabwe obungi, ne bafunamu okugaba okwewuunyizibwa ennyo” (2 Abakkolinso 8:2).

Kya mazima nti waliwo ebiseera obuzibu obw’amazima lwe butegeeza nti okugaba kwaffe kulina okukendeera okumala akaseera. Katonda akimanyi era tatusalira musango. Naye kusaanidde kubeera kintu kye tusembayo okusalako, so si kye tusooka.

Okusiga mu bulamu obutaggwaawo

Yesu yagamba nti, “mweterekerenga obugagga bwammwe mu ggulu gye butayinza kwonoonebwa nnyenje wadde obutalagge, n’ababbi gye batayinza kuyingira kububba” (Matayo 6:20). Okugaba eri omulimu gwa Katonda y’emu ku ngeri ezisinga okweyoleka ez’okukola ekyo. Ensimbi eziweebwayo okubunya Enjiri ze nsimbi zokka z’olirabako nate. Ziteekeddwa mu bantu, era abantu tebaggwaawo.

Buli kirabo kye tufuna kiva eri Katonda, era buli kirabo kye tuwa abalala kiyinza okugabibwa nga tukolagana naye.

Eddoboozi okuva mu biseera eby’edda

Andrew Murray, omusumba era omuwandiisi ku kusaba ow’e South Africa, yannyonnyola George Müller kye yakkiriza ku nsimbi:

“Ssente buwanika Katonda bw’akwasa omuntu, era nti... ssente zonna kyezaava zaali zirina okufunibwa n’okugabibwa mu kukolagana obutereevu ne Katonda yennyini.”

Andrew Murray, Wamu ne Kristo mu Ssomero ly’Okusaba

Ky’okukola wiiki eno

Noonyereza ku muminsani omu, ekitongole ky’abaminsani, oba ekkanisa mu kitundu ekirala eky’ensi. Manya amannya gaabwe n’ebyetaago byabwe. Oluvannyuma tandika okubasabira buli kiseera, era bw’oba osobola, bagabire okubayamba. Bw’oba ng’olina gw’oyamba dda, muwandiikire wiiki eno omubuulire nti omusabira.

Ku lw’ebibinja

  • Musome Abafiripi 4:14-19. Kiki kye mwetegereza ku ndowooza ya Pawulo ku kirabo ky’Abafiripi?
  • Lwaki mulowooza nti Pawulo okugaba yakuyita “akaloosa akalungi ennyo”?
  • Okusaba n’okugaba bikwatagana bitya?
  • Ensimbi singa zikufuukira ntono, kiki ky’osooka okusalako? Kiki ky’okuuma?

study_questions.question: Obuweereza bwa Yesu bwayimirizibwangawo butya?
study_questions.answer: Lukka atugamba nti Yesu bwe yali atambula okuva mu kibuga ekimu okudda mu kirala, abakazi, nga mu bo mwe muli Maliyamu Magudaleene ne Jowaana muka omukulu w’olubiri lwa Kerode, be “baatoolanga ku byabwe ne balabirira Yesu n’abayigirizwa be” (Lukka 8:3). Okuva ku ntandikwa, okubuna kw’Enjiri kwesigamanga ku bantu ba Katonda okuggulawo amaka gaabwe n’ensawo zaabwe.

study_questions.question: Pawulo yali ategeeza ki ku “kibala” ekyeyongera ku lw’Abafiripi?
study_questions.answer: Pawulo yagamba Abafiripi, abaali bakolera awamu naye mu Njiri, nti kye yali ayagala si kirabo, wabula “kwe kulaba ng’ekibala kyeyongera ku lwammwe” (Abafiripi 4:17). Abo abagaba okuyamba Enjiri bagabana ku bibala by’omulimu ogwo. Ekisuubizo ekimanyiddwa ennyo nti Katonda “alibawa buli kye mwetaaga” kyawandiikirwa abagabi bano, so si abo abakuŋŋaanya ne batereka.

study_questions.question: E. M. Bounds yayogera ki ku nsimbi n’okusaba mu mulimu gw’okubuna Enjiri?
study_questions.answer: Bounds yalabula nti “ensimbi awatali kusaba tezirina maanyi mu maaso g’ekizikiza, g’obunaku n’ekibi” eby’ensi Enjiri gy’etannatuuka, era n’alaba nti “ensimbi ze tuwaayo zisinga ebiweebwayo byaffe eby’okusaba.” Omulimu gutambuzibwa Mwoyo Mutukuvu ng’ayita mu kusaba; ensimbi ziweereza omulimu ogwo naye tezigudda mu kifo.

fields.title: Okukwasa Abaddirira
fields.body_html:
Buli muzadde ayigiriza abaana be ku nsimbi, k’abe ng’akigenderera oba nedda. Abaana batunuulira engeri gye tusaasaanyaamu. Bawuliriza engeri gye twogeramu ku nsimbi: oba tuzeeraliikirira, oba tuziyombera, oba tuzeemulugunyiza, oba twebaza Katonda ku lwazo. Bakitegeera oba tugaba, era nga tugaba na ssanyu ki. Bwe banaaba bakuze, empisa zaabwe nnyingi ku nsimbi zinaaba zaatondebwa dda awaka.

Ekyo kirowoozo ekikuzuukusa. Naye era mukisa munene.

Bayigirize awaka

Musa yagamba Isirayiri okufuula ebiragiro bya Katonda ekitundu ku bulamu bw’amaka obwa buli lunaku:

“Amateeka gano ge nkuwa leero ogakwatanga ku mutima gwo. Ogayigirizanga abaana bo n’obwegendereza. Ogoogerengako bw’onoobanga otudde mu maka go, ne bw’onoobanga otambula mu kkubo, bw’onoobanga ogalamiddeko, ne bw’onoobanga ogolokose.” (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 6:6-7)

Weetegereze okuyigiriza gye kubeera: awaka, mu kkubo, ng’ogenda kwebaka, ku ky’enkya. Okusinga si mu bisomo ebitongole, wabula mu ngeri ez’obulijjo ez’obulamu. Era n’abaana bwe batyo bwe bayiga ku nsimbi. Bayigira mu dduuka, mu mmotoka, ng’ebisale bituuse, ng’ekibbo ky’ekiweebwayo kiyitibwamu.

Era weetegereze n’omutendera: “Amateeka gano ge nkuwa leero ogakwatanga ku mutima gwo.” kisooka, olwo “Ogayigirizanga abaana bo n’obwegendereza.” Tosobola kukwasa balala ky’otalina. Ekisinga obulungi ky’osobola okukola okuyigiriza abaana bo ku nsimbi kwe kukiwangaalira ggwe kennyini.

“Manyiiriza omwana mu kkubo erimugwanira okutambulirangamu, ne bw’alikula talirivaamu.” (Engero 22:6)

Kye tuyigiriza

Bino bye bimu ku bisomo buli mwana by’alina okuyiga ku nsimbi.

Katonda ye nnannyini byonna. Tandikira ku Zabbuli 24:1. Ne omwana omuto asobola okutegeera nti ensi ya Katonda era nti ye yatuwa bye tulina.

Okukola kirungi. Leka abaana bafune ensimbi nga bakola emirimu awaka oba mu baliraanwa. Bayambe okuwulira ekitiibwa n’essanyu ly’okwekolera.

Sooka ogabe. Omwana bw’afuna ensimbi, muyambe asooke kwawulayo ekitundu kya Katonda. Amaka mangi gakozesa ebibya oba envulopu ssatu: Gaba, Tereka, Kozesa. Leka abaana beerondere okugaba kwabwe gye kugenda, era balabe enjawulo gye kuleeta.

Tereka olw’ekintu. Bayambe batereke ensimbi olw’ekintu kye baagala, balyoke bayige obugumiikiriza n’essanyu ly’okulinda.

Kozesa n’amagezi. Leka basalewo, era oluusi bakole ensobi, nga balina ensimbi ntono. Omwana ayonoona pawundi kkumi ku kintu ekyonooneka enkeera ayiga ekisomo ekirimuwonya ensimbi nnyingi okusingawo gye bujja.

Okumalibwa. Mwogere ku birango n’engeri gye bigezaako okutwegombesa ebintu. Mwegezeemu okwebaza nga muli wamu. Bayambe balabe bwe balina ebingi edda.

Ebbanja kya kabi. Abaana abakulu n’abavubuka beetaaga okutegeera amagoba ku looni bwe gakola n’amabanja bwe gasobola okukula amangu. Abavubuka bangi bagwa mu mabanja olw’okuba nti tewali n’omu yali abannyonnyodde.

Labirira abaavu. Yingiza abaana mu kuweereza n’okugabira abali mu bwetaavu. Leka balabe obwavu, mpola era mu ngeri esaanidde emyaka gyabwe, era balabe n’okusaasira kwo.

Bawe ekyokulabirako

Abaana bayiga bingi okuva mu bye tukola okusinga mu bye twogera. Bw’ogamba abaana bo okugaba naye nga tebakulabangako ng’ogaba, bajja kuyiga nti okugaba kintu kya kwogerako, so si kya kukola. Bw’obagamba obuteeraliikirira naye nga buli kiro bakuwulira ng’oyeeraliikirira ensimbi, bajja kuyiga okweraliikirira.

Lowooza ku ky’okuleka abaana bo okulaba okugaba kwo. Kiyinza okulabika ng’ekikontana n’okuyigiriza kwa Yesu ku kugabira mu kyama, naye waliwo enjawulo wakati w’okwerekeza eri ensi n’okutendeka abaana bo. Bannyonnyole lwaki ogaba, engeri gy’osalawo obungi, n’ekyo kye kitegeeza gy’oli. Leka bakulabe ng’osaba ku nsimbi. Leka bakulabe ng’osalawo obutagula kintu kubanga tekiri mu nteekateeka.

Era singa empisa zo ku nsimbi zibadde mbi, tekinnaba kuba kikeerezi. Abaana bo basobola okuyiga bingi nga bakulaba ng’okyuka. Bagambe mu bwesimbu: “Si bulijjo nti nkozesezza bulungi ensimbi, naye njiga okuzikozesa mu ngeri ya Katonda.” Ekyo kiyinza okuba ekisomo ekisinga amaanyi byonna.

Amagezi ga Wesley

John Wesley yayogera butereevu n’abazadde mu bubaka bwe. Amagezi ge gaali makakali, naye nga ga magezi:

“Mubateekemu, nga bukyali nnyo nga bwe kisoboka, okutya n’okunyooma ekitiibwa eky’okwerekeza n’okwekuza; okukyawa n’okutya okwagala ensimbi; n’okukakasa okw’omunda ennyo nti obugagga tebusobola kuleeta ssanyu.”

Weetegereze ky’ayagala abaana bayige: si kutya nsimbi, wabula okutya okwagala ensimbi. Si kunyooma mulimu, wabula okunyooma okwerekeza. Era n’okukakasa okw’omunda ennyo nti obugagga tebusobola kukusanyusa.

Leka obusika

“Omuntu omulungi alekera bazzukulu be ebyobusika” (Engero 13:22). Ku maka agamu, ekyo kijja kuzingiramu ensimbi oba ebintu, era kya magezi okukiteekerateekera n’obwegendereza, ng’owandiika ekiraamo era ng’osaba. Obusika obungi ennyo, obufunibwa nga bukyali nnyo, busobola okulumya omwana: “Eby’obusika ebifune ng’ekiseera kyabyo tekinnatuuka, ku nkomerero tebiba na mukisa.” (Engero 20:21). Abazadde Abakristaayo bangi ab’amagezi balekera omulimu gwa Katonda ekitundu kinene ku by’obugagga bwabwe, ng’ekikolwa ekisembayo eky’obuwanika.

Naye obusika obusinga obukulu si nsimbi. Kukkiriza. Pawulo yajjukiza Timoseewo okukkiriza okw’amazima okwasooka okubeera mu jjajja we Loyisi ne mu nnyina Ewuniike, era kati nga kuli mu ye. Obwo bwe busika obusinga obukulu. Omwana ayize okwesiga Katonda, okukola ennyo, okugaba n’omutima omugabi n’okumalibwa alekeddwa ekintu ekisinga ennyo omuwendo eby’obugagga byonna.

Si bazadde bokka

Essuula eno si ya bazadde bokka. Bajjajja, ba ssenga ne ba kojja, abazadde ab’omu batismu, abakulembeze b’abavubuka, abasomesa n’emikwano emikulu bonna basobola okuyamba abavubuka okuyiga okukozesa ensimbi mu ngeri ya Katonda. Ekkanisa maka, era buli mukkiriza omukulu alina ky’asobola okukwasa omuto.

Eddoboozi okuva mu biseera eby’edda

Susanna Wesley yazaala abaana kkumi na mwenda, era mwenda ku bo baafa nga bakyali bawere. Abalala yabakuliza mu nnyumba y’omusumba ennaavu mu kyalo, ng’alina amabanja agaali gatayagala kuggwaawo, era n’omuliro ogwayokya ennyumba yonna. Yali amanyi obuzibu bw’ensimbi ng’abuyiseemu yennyini, era yabuyigirizaako abaana be. Mutabani we John bwe yali akyali muyizi muto e Oxford, yamuwandiikira nti:

“Nandyagadde otereke ensimbi zonna z’osobola okwawulako awatali kukaluubirirwa, so si kuzisaasaanya ku kukyala, wabula olw’ekigendererwa eky’amagezi ennyo era ekisingako obulungi — okusasula amabanja, n’okwewa emirembe.”

Susanna Wesley, mu bbaluwa gye yawandiikira mutabani we John

Okuva mu maka ago agaali mu kalumi mwavaamu John ne Charles Wesley, abaayamba okukyusa eggwanga. John yakula n’afuuka omusajja eyabuulira nti “Gaba kyonna ky’osobola,” era yagaba obugagga bungi nnyo.

Ky’okukola wiiki eno

Bw’oba n’abaana awaka, tandika wiiki eno ebibya oba envulopu za Gaba, Tereka, Kozesa, era mwogere ku nsonga lwaki ogaba. Bw’oba tobalina, lowooza ku muvubuka omu gw’osobola okuzzaamu amaanyi oba okuluŋŋamya mu kukozesa ensimbi, era noonya akakisa akajja mu ngeri ey’obulijjo okumubuulira ku kintu ky’oyize.

Ku lw’ebibinja

  • Kiki kye wayiga ku nsimbi okuva ku bazadde bo, ekirungi oba ekibi?
  • Bisomo ki ebiri mu ssuula eno by’osinga okwagala nti wandibiyize ng’okyali mwana?
  • Abazadde basobola batya okulaga abaana baabwe okugaba kwabwe nga tebamenye kuyigiriza kwa Yesu ku kugabira mu kyama?
  • Busika ki obusinga omuwendo bw’oyinza okulekera omulembe oguddako?

study_questions.question: Bayibuli eyogera ki ku kuyigiriza abaana ku nsimbi?
study_questions.answer: Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 6:6-7 kiteeka okuyigiriza mu ngeri ez’obulijjo ez’awaka: ng’otudde mu maka, ng’otambula mu kkubo, ng’ogalamidde ne bw’ogolokoka. Abaana bayigira ku nsimbi mu dduuka, mu mmotoka n’ebisale bwe bituuka. Naye ebigambo bisooka kubeera ku mutima gw’omuzadde yennyini, kubanga tosobola kukwasa balala ky’otalina.

study_questions.question: Bisomo ki ku nsimbi abazadde Abakristaayo bye basaanye okuyigiriza abaana baabwe?
study_questions.answer: Nti Katonda ye nnannyini byonna, nti okukola kirungi, okusooka okugaba (amaka mangi gakozesa ebibya bya Gaba, Tereka ne Kozesa), okutereka olw’ekintu, okukozesa n’amagezi nga bakola ensobi entono, okumalibwa wadde nga waliwo ebirango, nti ebbanja kya kabi, n’okulabirira abaavu. Okusinga byonna, abaana bayiga bingi okuva mu bye tukola okusinga mu bye twogera.

study_questions.question: John Wesley yawa abazadde magezi ki ku kuyigiriza abaana baabwe ku bugagga?
study_questions.answer: Wesley yakubiriza abazadde okuteeka mu baana nga bukyali “okutya n’okunyooma ekitiibwa eky’okwerekeza n’okwekuza; okukyawa n’okutya okwagala ensimbi” n’okukakasa okw’omunda ennyo “nti obugagga tebusobola kuleeta ssanyu.” Yayagala abaana batye, si nsimbi, wabula okwagala ensimbi, era banyoome, si mulimu, wabula okwerekeza.

fields.title: Weebale
fields.body_html:
Lumu, buli omu ku ffe aliyimirira mu maaso ga Katonda n’annyonnyola engeri gye yatambuzaamu obulamu bwe. Bayibuli ekyogera lwatu:

“Kubanga ffe ffenna kitugwanira okulabika mu maaso g’entebe ya Kristo ey’okusalirako omusango, buli muntu asalirwe olw’ebyo bye yakola ng’akyali mulamu, okusinziira ku ebyo bye yakola oba birungi oba bibi.” (2 Abakkolinso 5:10)

“Noolwekyo buli omu ku ffe alyennyonnyolako eri Katonda” (Abaruumi 14:12).

Eri Omukristaayo, guno si musango gwa kusalawo oba tulirokolebwa oba nedda. Ekyo kyaggwa ku musaalaba. Pawulo agamba nti “abo abali mu Kristo Yesu, tebaliiko musango” (Abaruumi 8:1). Naye gwe musango ogw’ebikolwa byaffe, obwesigwa bwaffe, n’engeri gye twakozesaamu ebyo Katonda bye yatukwasa. Era ekyo kizingiramu n’ensimbi zaffe.

Okunnyonnyola

Olugero lwa Yesu olw’omuwanika atali mwesigwa lutandika n’ebigambo bino ebya mukama we: “Biki ebyo bye nkuwulirako? Kale genda otegeke lipoota y’ebintu byange nga bwe biri ogindeetere. Omulimu gukufudde” (Lukka 16:2).

Olunaku olwo lujja eri buli muwanika. John Wesley yabuulira obubaka ku nsonga eno ddala, obuyitibwa “Omuwanika Omulungi.” Yajjukiza abamuwuliriza nti ekiseera kyaffe eky’okuba abawanika kirikoma, era olwo tulinnyonnyola. Emibiri gyaffe, ebirowoozo byaffe, ebiseera byaffe, ebitone byaffe, ensimbi zaffe: byonna Katonda yabituwola, era tulibinnyonnyola engeri gye twabikozesaamu.

Ekyo tekisaanye kutiisa Mukristaayo. Naye kisaanye okutufuula abegendereza. Kitegeeza nti bye tulonda bikulu. Kitegeeza nti bye tukola n’ensimbi leero birina ebiva mu byo eby’emirembe n’emirembe.

Essanyu lya mukama

Jjukira ebigambo bya mukama mu lugero lwa ttalanta: “Weebale, oli muddu mulungi era mwesigwa, obadde mwesigwa mu bintu ebitono, ndikusigira ebintu ebingi. Yingira sanyukira wamu ne mukama wo” (Matayo 25:21).

Lowooza ku kuwulira ebigambo ebyo okuva eri Yesu. Lowooza ku Oyo eyakuwaayo buli kimu ng’atunuulira obulamu bwo, nga mw’otwalidde n’engeri gye wakwatamu ensimbi zo, n’agamba nti, “Weebale.” Ebikolwa byonna ebitono eby’obwesigwa: ekimu eky’ekkumi ekyaweebwayo nga kizibu, emisolo n’ebbaluwa z’ebisale ebyawandiikibwa mu bwesimbu, ebirabo eby’ekyama, amabanja agaasasulibwa, muliraanwa omwavu eyayambibwa, omubaka w’enjiri eyawagirwa, omwana eyayigirizibwa okugaba. Byonna birabiddwa, byonna bijjukirwa, byonna birisasulwa.

“Kubanga Katonda mwenkanya tayinza kwerabira mulimu gwammwe omunene bwe gutyo, n’okwagala kwe mwagala erinnya lye, era amanyi bwe mwaweereza abantu be, era bwe mukyeyongera okubaweereza” (Abaebbulaniya 6:10).

Obugagga mu ggulu

Yesu yatukubiriza nti “mweterekerenga obugagga bwammwe mu ggulu” (Matayo 6:20). Ekyo kitegeeza ki? Kitegeeza nti bye tugaba mu bulamu buno, ku lwa Kristo n’obwakabaka bwe, tebibula. Bisindikibwa mu maaso. Buli kirabo eri abaavu, buli kiweebwayo eri omulimu gwa Katonda, buli kye twefiiriza ku lw’enjiri, kiterekebwa awo ennyenje n’obutalagge n’ababbi gye batasobola kukituukako.

C. T. Studd, omuzannyi wa cricket Omungereza eyagaba obugagga bungi okufuuka omubaka w’enjiri, yawandiika olunyiriri olutono lwe bangi bazze baddamu okuva olwo: “Obulamu bumu bwokka, bujja kuyita mangu; ebyo byokka ebikolebwa ku lwa Kristo bye birisigalawo.” Kino kituufu ne ku nsimbi zaffe. Ebyo byokka ebigabibwa ku lwa Kristo bye birisigalawo.

Si kukolerera, wabula kusasulwa

Kikulu okukitegeera obulungi wano. Tetulokolebwa lwa kugaba kwaffe. Obulokozi kirabo kya bwereere. Tosobola kugula kkubo lyo okuyingira mu ggulu, era tekikwetaagisa. Yesu yasasula byonna.

Naye Bayibuli eyigiriza nti Katonda asasula abaana be olw’obwesigwa, era nti empeera zirina amadaala. Yesu yayogera ku abamu abaliweebwa okufuga ebibuga kkumi n’abalala ebibuga bitaano. Pawulo yayogera ku bikolwa ebiyita mu muliro ne bisigalawo n’ebikolwa ebyokebwa ne biggwaawo. Tetutegeera bulungi empeera ezo bwe ziriba. Naye tumanyi nti Katonda mugabi, era nti asanyuka okusasula abaddu be okusinga ennyo kye basaanira.

Ekyo kikyusa engeri gye tulowoozaamu ku nsimbi. Buli pawundi oba doola eyita mu mikono gyaffe mukisa okwetereka obugagga obulibeerawo emirembe gyonna.

Okubeera mu bulamu ng’otunuulidde enkomerero

Eno y’engeri emu ey’okusalawo ku nsimbi. Nga tonnasaasaanya ssente nnyingi, oba nga tonnasalawo ky’onoogaba, oba nga tonneewola, weebuuze: “Kino kirirabika kitya ku lunaku lwe ndinnyonnyola?” Si na kutya, wabula na bwesimbu.

Ekibuuzo ekyo kirina engeri gye kiggyawo olufu. Kitulaga ebikulu ddala. Kifuula emmotoka empya oba ennyumba ennene okulabika nga si nkulu nnyo, n’amaka agali mu bizibu oba omubaka w’enjiri oba ekkanisa empya etandikibwawo okulabika nga bikulu nnyo. Kituyamba okubeera mu bulamu, nga Pawulo bwe yagamba, “tusobole okunyweza obulamu obwa nnamaddala.”

Ekisa okutuuka ku nkomerero

Bw’obanga osomye okutuuka wano n’owulira nti obadde muwanika mubi, toggwaamu essuubi. Buli omu ku ffe yali alemereddwa mu nsimbi mu ngeri emu oba endala. Omubbi ku musaalaba teyalina ky’agaba wadde ekiseera eky’okugaba, naye Yesu yamwaniriza mu lusuku lwa Katonda. Ekisa kya Katonda kisinga okulemererwa kwaffe.

Tandikira w’oli. Weenenye ebyo by’oteekwa okwenenya. Funa okusonyiwa kwe. Olwo, okuva leero, tandika okuba omwesigwa mu ebyo by’akuwadde. Tekiba kikeerezi n’akatono okutandika okwetereka obugagga mu ggulu.

Eddoboozi okuva mu biseera eby’edda

Mu bubaka bwe “Ku Bugagga,” John Wesley yawa buli mukkiriza essuubi lino:

“Beera muwanika mulungi ow’ebirabo bya Katonda eby’engeri nnyingi; bw’oliyitibwa okunnyonnyola obuwanika bwo, alyoke agambe nti, ‘Weebale, muddu mulungi era mwesigwa, yingira mu ssanyu lya Mukama wo!’”

Ne Thomas à Kempis, ebyasa bingi emabega, yasonga ewala okusinga ebirabo byonna, eri Oyo abigaba:

“Bw’oba n’obugagga, tobwenyumirizaamu, wadde mu mikwano gyo olw’okuba ba buyinza, wabula weenyumirize mu Katonda awa ebintu byonna era ayagala okusinga byonna okwewaayo Ye kennyini.”

Thomas à Kempis, The Imitation of Christ

Ky’okukola wiiki eno

Wiiki eno twala essaawa emu olowooze era osabe ku kibuuzo kino: “Singa leero nnyonnyola obuwanika bwange, kiki kye nandisanyukidde? Kiki kye nandyagadde okuba nga nakikola mu ngeri ndala?” Wandiika ekintu kimu ky’oyagala okukyusa, era okikyuse.

Ku lw’ebibinja

  • Owulira otya ku ky’okunnyonnyola Katonda ku nsimbi zo? Lwaki?
  • Njawulo ki eriwo wakati w’okulokolebwa olw’ebikolwa n’okusasulwa olw’ebikolwa?
  • Soma Matayo 25:21. Kyandikutegeezezza ki okuwulira ebigambo ebyo?
  • Kusalawo ki kumu kw’olina kati okwandibadde okw’enjawulo “ng’otunuulidde enkomerero”?

study_questions.question: Bayibuli eyogera ki ku kunnyonnyola Katonda ku nsimbi zaffe?
study_questions.answer: “Ffe ffenna kitugwanira okulabika mu maaso g’entebe ya Kristo ey’okusalirako omusango” (2 Abakkolinso 5:10). Eri Omukristaayo, guno si musango ku bulokozi, obwaggwa ku musaalaba, wabula ku bwesigwa bwaffe mu ebyo Katonda bye yatukwasa, nga mw’otwalidde n’ensimbi. Obubaka bwa Wesley “Omuwanika Omulungi” bwayigiriza nti byonna Katonda yabituwola.

study_questions.question: Kitegeeza ki okwetereka obugagga mu ggulu?
study_questions.answer: Bye tugaba ku lwa Kristo n’obwakabaka bwe tebibula, wabula bisindikibwa mu maaso, ne biterekebwa awo ennyenje, obutalagge n’ababbi gye batasobola kubituukako. Nga C. T. Studd bwe yawandiika, “Obulamu bumu bwokka, bujja kuyita mangu; ebyo byokka ebikolebwa ku lwa Kristo bye birisigalawo.” Tetulokolebwa lwa kugaba, naye Katonda asasula obwesigwa bw’abaana be okusinga ennyo kye basaanira.

study_questions.question: Waliwo essuubi eri Omukristaayo abadde omuwanika omubi ow’ensimbi?
study_questions.answer: Yee. Buli omu ku ffe yali alemereddwa mu nsimbi mu ngeri emu oba endala, era ekisa kya Katonda kisinga okulemererwa kwaffe; omubbi ku musaalaba teyalina ky’agaba, naye Yesu yamwaniriza mu lusuku lwa Katonda. Tandikira w’oli, weenenye, funa okusonyiwa kwe era otandike okuba omwesigwa leero. Tekiba kikeerezi n’akatono okwetereka obugagga mu ggulu.

fields.title: Okufundikira: Enkola y’Obulamu ku Nsimbi
fields.body_html:
Twatandika n’oluggi. Ensimbi kye kisenge eky’ekyama ekisembayo mu nnyumba, ekifo Abakristaayo bangi we basirikira ne batayingiza Yesu. Ekitabo kino kibadde kukuyita okuggulawo oluggi olwo.

Tulabye nti buli kintu kya Katonda era nti ffe tuli bawanika be. Tutunuulidde omutima oguli emabega w’ensawo: omululu, okweraliikirira, okumalibwa n’akabi k’obugagga. Tulowoozezza ku nsimbi eza buli lunaku: okukola mu bwesimbu, okuteekateeka, amabanja n’okulabirira amaka. Twetegerezza okugaba: ebibala ebibereberye, okugaba n’essanyu, abaavu, n’okugaba kyonna kye tusobola. Era tutunuulidde eby’omu maaso: obwesigwa mu bintu ebitono, omulimu gwa Katonda, omulembe oguddako, n’olunaku lwe tuliwulira nti “Weebale.”

Kati kiki ekiddako?

Enkola y’obulamu

Mu byafaayo by’ekkanisa, Abakristaayo bangi bakizudde nga kya mugaso okuwandiika “enkola y’obulamu,” ekibinja ky’obweyamo obwangu obubumba engeri gye babeeramu. Si mateeka ag’okufuna ekisa kya Katonda. Kiringa emiti egiwanirira ekimera ekiranda, egikiyamba okukula nga kigenda mu kkubo ettuufu.

Wano waliwo enkola y’obulamu ku nsimbi gye nkuteeka mu maaso, ezimbiddwa ku mateeka asatu aga John Wesley n’okuyigiriza kw’ekitabo kino. Gisome mpola. Gikyuse etuukane n’embeera yo. Oluvannyuma gisabireko, era lowooza ku kuwandiika eyiyo n’ogiteeka w’onoogirabanga.

Nja kujjukira nti byonna bya Katonda.
Buli kye nnina kikye. Ndi muwanika, so si nnannyini.

Nja kufuna kyonna kye nsobola, mu bwesimbu.
Nja kukola nnyo, ng’akolera Mukama. Nja kukolagana n’abalala mu bwenkanya. Sijja kukumpanya, kulimba wadde okulumya abalala okufuna ensimbi.

Nja kusooka kugaba.
Nga sinnaba kukozesa nsimbi ku kintu kirala kyonna, nja kuwa Katonda ekitundu ky’enyingiza yange kye nnategese, nga ntandikira ku kkanisa yange ey’omu kitundu, era nja kwongerangako ku kitundu ekyo nga Katonda bw’anakkirizanga.

Nja kutereka kyonna kye nsobola.
Nja kubeera mu bulamu obwangu era nneewale okwonoona. Nja kuteekateeka bye nsaasaanya, nterekeyo ensimbi ezimu, era mmanye bulungi embeera z’ekisibo kyange.

Nja kubeera wa ddembe.
Nja kwewala amabanja agateetaagisa, nsasule amabanja gange, era nfube obutabeera na bbanja lyonna wabula okwagala.

Nja kulabirira abange.
Nja kufaayo ku bwetaavu obwa nnamaddala obw’amaka gange, nga mw’otwalidde ne bazadde bange abakaddiye, era nteekateeke n’amagezi olw’eby’omu maaso.

Nja kugaba kyonna kye nsobola.
Nja kussaawo ekkomo ku ngeri gye mbeeramu, nti enyingiza yange bw’eneeyongeranga, n’okugaba kwange kweyongere. Nja kugabanga n’essanyu, bulijjo era mu kasirise, eri abaavu n’eri omulimu gwa Katonda.

Nja kukuuma omutima gwange.
Nja kulwanyisa omululu nga nneebaza era nga ngaba. Nja kuyiga okumalibwa. Buli kweraliikirira ku nsimbi nja kukutwala eri Katonda mu kusaba.

Nja kukikwasa abaddako.
Nja kuyigiriza omulembe oguddako, mu bigambo ne mu kyokulabirako, okukwata ensimbi mu ngeri ya Katonda.

Nja kubeera mu bulamu nga ntunuulidde enkomerero.
Nja kujjukira nti ndiwa embalirira, era nja kufuba okuwulira nti “Weebale.”

Emitendera emitono

Togezaako kukola bino byonna omulundi gumu. Londako omutendera gumu oba ebiri, oboolyawo egyo Katonda gy’akuteeka ku mutima ng’osoma. Gikole omwezi guno. Oluvannyuma okole omulala. Obwesigwa bukula mutendera gumu mutono ku gumu.

Era jjukira nti toli wekka. Yogera ne munno mu bufumbo, ne mikwano gyo, n’ekibinja kyo ekitono oba n’omusumba wo. Saba omuntu asabe naawe era akugobererenga okulaba nti okola by’oweyamye. Ensimbi kye kisenge eky’ekyama, naye tekiteekwa kusigala nga kya kyama.

Obugagga

Yesu yagamba nti, “Obugagga bwo gye buli n’omutima gwo gye gunaabeeranga” (Matayo 6:21). Twatandika n’olunyiriri olwo, era tukomekkereza nalwo.

Obugagga bwo buli ludda wa? Bwe buba nga buli mu akawunti yo ey’omu bbanka, omutima gwo gujja kubugoberera eyo, era lumu omutima gwo gulisigala nga tegulina kantu. Naye obugagga bwo bwe buba mu Kristo, olwo omutima gwo guli mirembe. Tewali kiyinza kubukuggyako.

Lumu Yesu yagera olugero lw’omusajja eyazuula obugagga obwali bukwekeddwa mu nnimiro. Olw’essanyu lye n’agenda n’atunda byonna bye yalina n’agula ennimiro eyo. Teyawulira nti yali yeefiiriza. Yali amanyi nti azudde ekintu ekisinga byonna omuwendo.

Ekyo kye kitegeeza okumanya Kristo. Ye bugagga. Bw’omala okumuzuula, ebirala byonna bigenda mu kifo kyabyo. Osobola okukwata ensimbi nga tozinywezezza, okuzigaba awatali kwekunya, okuziddukanya n’obwesigwa n’okuzinyumirwa ng’oyebaza, kubanga omutima gwo gujjudde dda.

Katonda akuwe ekisa okubeera omwesigwa mu bintu ebitono, era lumu owulire ebigambo buli muyigirizwa by’ayaayaanira okuwulira: “Weebale, oli muddu mulungi era mwesigwa… Yingira sanyukira wamu ne mukama wo.”

study_questions.question: Enkola y’obulamu ku nsimbi ey’Omukristaayo kye ki?
study_questions.answer: Enkola y’obulamu kibinja kya bweyamo obwangu obuwandiikiddwa obubumba engeri Omukristaayo gy’abeeramu. Si mateeka ag’okufuna ekisa kya Katonda, wabula “kiringa emiti egiwanirira ekimera ekiranda, egikiyamba okukula nga kigenda mu kkubo ettuufu.” Enkola ekitabo gye kiteeka mu maaso ezimbiddwa ku mateeka asatu aga Wesley, era eyita abasomi okugikyusa n’okuwandiika eyaabwe.

study_questions.question: Obweyamo ekkumi obuli mu nkola y’obulamu ku nsimbi bwe buluwa?
study_questions.answer: Okujjukira nti byonna bya Katonda; okufuna kyonna kye nsobola, mu bwesimbu; okusooka kugaba; okutereka kyonna kye nsobola; okubeera wa ddembe okuva mu mabanja agateetaagisa; okulabirira abange; okugaba kyonna kye nsobola, nga nteeka ekkomo ku ngeri gye mbeeramu; okukuuma omutima gwange; okukikwasa omulembe oguddako; n’okubeera mu bulamu nga ntunuulidde enkomerero, nga nfuba okuwulira nti “Weebale.”

study_questions.question: Olugero lw’obugagga obwali bukwekeddwa mu nnimiro luyigiriza ki ku nsimbi?
study_questions.answer: Omusajja eyazuula obugagga yatunda byonna n’essanyu, nga tawulira nti yeefiiriza, kubanga yali amanyi nti azudde ekintu ekisinga byonna omuwendo. Kristo bwe bugagga obwo. Bw’omala okumuzuula, osobola okukwata ensimbi nga tozinywezezza, okuzigaba awatali kwekunya, okuziddukanya n’obwesigwa n’okuzinyumirwa ng’oyebaza, kubanga omutima gwo gujjudde dda.

fields.title: Ebyongerezeddwako 1: Enteekateeka y’Okusoma ey’Ennaku 30
fields.body_html:
Zino nnyiriri amakumi asatu ezisinga obukulu mu kitabo kino, lumu buli lunaku okumala omwezi gumu. Soma olunyiriri mpolampola, oluvannyuma osome katono ku ssuula yonna mwe lusangibwa mu Bayibuli yo. Weebuuze ebibuuzo bibiri: Kino kindaga ki ku Katonda? Kino kinsaba kukola ki? Maliriza n’essaala ennyimpi.

Wiiki 1: Bya ani?

  • Olunaku 1. Zabbuli 24:1. Ensi ya Mukama n’ebigirimu byonna. Kiki kye ntwala ng’ekyange so nga ddala kikye?
  • Olunaku 2. 1 Ebyomumirembe 29:11-14. Byonna biva gy’oli. Mwebaze olw’ebintu bisatu by’akuwadde.
  • Olunaku 3. Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 8:17-18. Y’akuwa obuyinza okufuna obugagga. Wa we nkemebwa okumwerabira?
  • Olunaku 4. Olubereberye 2:15. Agirimenga era agikuumenga. Leero waayo omulimu gwo eri Katonda.
  • Olunaku 5. Matayo 6:24. Toyinza kuweereza Katonda na mamona. Mukama ki alina omutima gwange?
  • Olunaku 6. 2 Abakkolinso 8:9. Yafuka omwavu ku lwammwe. Mala akaseera ng’owebaza Yesu olw’obugagga bwe gy’oli.
  • Olunaku 7. Matayo 6:19-21. Obugagga bwange buli wa? Omutima gwange guli wa?

Wiiki 2: Omutima oguli emabega w’ensawo

  • Olunaku 8. Omubuulizi 5:10. Oyo alulunkanira ensimbi, tasobola kuba na nsimbi zimumala. Wa we kinzibuwalira okugamba nti “kimala”?
  • Olunaku 9. Lukka 12:15. Obulamu bw’omuntu tebugererwa ku bugagga bw’abeera nabwo. Kiki kye nnoonyamu obulamu?
  • Olunaku 10. Engero 30:8-9. Tonjavuwazanga wadde okungaggawaza. Saba essaala eno mu bwesimbu.
  • Olunaku 11. Abafiripi 4:11-13. Mu buli mbeera gye mbaamu nayiga okumalibwanga. Kiki Katonda ky’anjigiriza mu mbeera zange?
  • Olunaku 12. Abaebbulaniya 13:5. “Sirikuleka era sirikwabulira n’akatono.” Leeta okutya kwo okw’ensimbi eri Katonda atakwabulira n’akatono.
  • Olunaku 13. Matayo 6:33. Musooke munoonye obwakabaka bwa Katonda. Okukulembeza Katonda kwandifaananye kutya leero?
  • Olunaku 14. 1 Timoseewo 6:6-10. Weewaawo okutya Katonda kulimu amagoba mangi, omuntu bw’amalibwa mu ekyo ky’alina. Wa okululunkanira ensimbi we kwesenzese mu mutima gwange?

Wiiki 3: Amagezi ku nsimbi eza buli lunaku

  • Olunaku 15. Engero 11:1. Minzaani eteri ya mazima ya muzizo eri Mukama. Waliwo obutali bwesimbu bwonna mu ngeri gye nfunamu oba gye nkozesaamu ensimbi?
  • Olunaku 16. Engero 13:11. Ezijja empolampola zeeyongera obungi. Wa we nneetaaga obugumiikiriza mu kifo ky’okwanguyiriza?
  • Olunaku 17. Engero 21:5. Enteekateeka z’omunyiikivu zivaamu magoba meereere. Nnina enteekateeka y’ensimbi zange?
  • Olunaku 18. Lukka 14:28. Abalirira omuwendo. Waliwo ekintu kye nnina okusalawo kye nneetaaga okulowoozaako n’obwegendereza okusingawo?
  • Olunaku 19. Engero 27:23-24. Okakasanga nti omanyi bulungi embeera z’ekisibo kyo. Mmanyi ensimbi zange gye zigenda?
  • Olunaku 20. Engero 22:7. Eyeewola aba muddu w’oyo amuwola. Ddaala ki lye nsobola okutuuka okutambula okuva mu mabanja?

Wiiki 4: Abagabi nga Katonda

  • Olunaku 21. Engero 3:9-10. Mukama mugulumizenga n’eby’obugagga byo; n’ebibala ebisooka. Ngaba okusooka, oba ku ebyo ebisigaddewo?
  • Olunaku 22. Malaki 3:10. Muleete ekimu eky’ekkumi ekijjuvu. Kiki Katonda ky’ansaba okugaba?
  • Olunaku 23. 2 Abakkolinso 9:6-8. Katonda ayagala oyo agaba n’essanyu. Kiki ekyandifudde okugaba kwange okw’essanyu okusingawo?
  • Olunaku 24. Engero 11:24-25. Omuntu agaba anagaggawalanga. Ani gwe nsobola okuzzaamu amaanyi leero?
  • Olunaku 25. Ebikolwa 20:35. Okugaba kwa mukisa okusinga okuweebwa. Ddi lwe nnalaba nga kino kya mazima?
  • Olunaku 26. Engero 19:17. Oyo akwatirwa omwavu ekisa awola Mukama. Ani ali mu bwetaavu gwe nsobola okuyamba wiiki eno?
  • Olunaku 27. Makko 12:43-44. Nnamwandu ono mu kwetaaga kwe ataddemu kyonna ky’abadde nakyo. Okugaba okw’okwefiiriza kwandifaananye kutya gye ndi?

Ennaku 28-30: Obugagga obutaggwaawo

  • Olunaku 28. 1 Timoseewo 6:17-19. Babe bagagga mu bikolwa ebirungi. Nnyinza ntya okukozesa bye nnina okukola ebirungi?
  • Olunaku 29. Lukka 16:10-11. Omuntu omwesigwa mu kintu ekitono, abeera mwesigwa ne mu kinene. Kintu ki ekitono mwe nsobola okuba omwesigwa leero?
  • Olunaku 30. Matayo 25:21. “Weebale, oli muddu mulungi era mwesigwa.” Saba olunaku lumu owulire ebigambo bino, era owandiike ekintu kimu ky’oyagala okwesuubiza okukuuma.

study_questions.question: Enteekateeka y’okusoma ey’ennaku 30 ku nsimbi ekola etya?
study_questions.answer: Etwala ennyiriri amakumi asatu ezisinga obukulu mu kitabo, lumu buli lunaku okumala omwezi gumu. Soma olunyiriri mpolampola, oluvannyuma osome katono ku ssuula mwe lusangibwa mu Bayibuli yo, era weebuuze ebibuuzo bibiri: Kino kindaga ki ku Katonda? Kino kinsaba kukola ki? Buli lunaku luggwera mu ssaala ennyimpi.

study_questions.question: Enteekateeka y’okusoma ey’ennaku 30 etegekeddwa etya?
study_questions.answer: Egoberera ebitundu bitaano eby’ekitabo: Wiiki 1, Bya ani?; Wiiki 2, omutima oguli emabega w’ensawo; Wiiki 3, amagezi ku nsimbi eza buli lunaku; Wiiki 4, abagabi nga Katonda; n’Ennaku 28 okutuuka ku 30, obugagga obutaggwaawo. Buli lunaku lugatta olunyiriri olukulu n’ekibuuzo ekimpi eky’okufumiitirizaako oba ekiragiro, nga “Obugagga bwange buli wa? Omutima gwange guli wa?”

study_questions.question: Nnyiriri ki ezitandika n’ezimaliriza enteekateeka y’okusoma ey’ennaku 30 ku nsimbi?
study_questions.answer: Olunaku 1 ye Zabbuli 24:1, “Ensi ya Mukama n’ebigirimu byonna,” nga kibuuza kiki kye ntwala ng’ekyange so nga ddala kikye. Olunaku 30 ye Matayo 25:21, “Weebale, oli muddu mulungi era mwesigwa,” nga kikuyita okusaba olunaku lumu owulire ebigambo bino, n’okuwandiika ekintu kimu ky’oyagala okwesuubiza okukuuma.

fields.title: Ebyongerezeddwako 2: Enteekateeka y’Ensimbi ku Lupapula Lumu
fields.body_html:
Eno nteekateeka ennyangu ey’omwezi. Teweetaaga pulogulaamu ya njawulo ku kompyuta. Olupapula lumu, kalaamu y’essasi n’essaawa emu ey’obwesimbu bimala. Bw’oba oli mufumbo, mukikolere wamu.

Omutendera 1: Ebiyingira

Wandiika ensimbi zonna z’ofuna mu mwezi ogwa bulijjo, ng’omusolo gumaze okuggibwako. Teekamu omusaala, obuyambi bwonna bw’ofuna, pensoni, n’ensimbi endala zonna z’ofuna bulijjo. Ensimbi z’ofuna bwe zikyukakyuka, kozesa avareegi gy’obaze n’obwegendereza, oba teekateeka ng’osinziira ku mwezi gw’otera okufunamu ekitono ennyo.

Omutendera 2: Ekisooka okugenda eri Katonda

Salawo ebitundu ku kikumi eby’ensimbi z’ofuna by’onoogaba. Wandiika omuwendo ogwo. Zino zisooka, nga tonnaba kukola kirala kyonna.

Omutendera 3: By’weetaaga okubeera mu bulamu

Wandiika ebisale byo ebikulu eby’omwezi:

  • Ennyumba (ppangisa oba looni y’ennyumba)
  • Ebisale by’awaka (amasannyalaze, amazzi, essimu, yintaneeti)
  • Emmere n’ebyetaago by’awaka
  • Entambula
  • Yinsuwa
  • Ensimbi entono ez’okusasula amabanja
  • Ebisale by’obulamu, eby’okulabirira abaana n’eby’okusoma
  • Ebyetaago ebirala ebikulu

Omutendera 4: Okutereka

Salawo ssente mmeka z’onooterekanga buli mwezi. Ekiruubirirwa ekisooka ekirungi ye nsawo entono ey’ebigwa bitalaze. Oluvannyuma weeyongere okutuusa ng’olina ebisale byo ebikulu eby’emyezi esatu okutuuka ku mukaaga, olwo otereke olw’ebyetaago eby’omu maaso, gamba ng’ennyumba, obukadde, oba ebyetaago by’abaana bo.

Omutendera 5: Okuva mu mabanja

Bw’oba n’amabanja amalala ng’oggyeeko looni y’ennyumba, gawandiike wano, okuva ku litono okutuuka ku linene, n’amagoba ga buli limu. Salawo ssente mmeka ez’okwongerako z’onoosasulanga buli mwezi, n’ebbanja ki ly’onoosooka okumalayo.

Omutendera 6: Ebirala byonna

Ekisigaddewo kyonna kiyinza okukozesebwa ku bintu ebirala: engoye, ebirabo, okulya ebweru, by’onyumirwa okukola, n’okuwummula. Salawo omuwendo gwa buli kimu nga bukyali.

Omutendera 7: Kebera oba bitereevu

Gatta Emitendera 2 okutuuka ku 6. Omugatte gwennyini gulina kwenkanankana n’Omutendera 1. Bwe guba gusingako, osaasaanya okusinga by’ofuna: ddayo osalako okutuusa nga bitereevu. Bwe guba gukendeddeko, salawo ensimbi ezisigaddewo gye zinaagenda, oboolyawo mu kugaba, mu kutereka oba mu kusasula amabanja amangu.

Omutendera 8: Kyetegereze

Ku nkomerero y’omwezi, geraageranya bye wateekateeka n’ebyabaddewo ddala. Kyusa enteekateeka y’omwezi oguddako. Kitera okutwala emyezi esatu oba ena okufuna enteekateeka ekola. Togwamu maanyi.

Essaala olw’enteekateeka yo

Mukama, bino byonna bibyo. Nkwebaza olw’ebyo by’ompadde. Nnyamba okusooka okugaba, okubeera n’amagezi mu bulamu, okusigala nga ndi wa ddembe, okulabirira abo be njagala, n’okugaba kyonna kye nsobola. Mpa okuba omwesigwa mu bintu ebitono, ku lwa Yesu. Amiina.

study_questions.question: Enteekateeka y’ensimbi ku lupapula lumu erina mitendera ki?
study_questions.answer: Gili munaana: wandiika ebiyingira ng’omusolo gumaze okuggibwako; salawo ekisooka okugenda eri Katonda; wandiika by’weetaaga okubeera mu bulamu; salawo by’onootereka; teekateeka okuva mu mabanja; salawo omuwendo ku birala byonna; kebera oba bitereevu; era weetegereze ku nkomerero y’omwezi. Olupapula lumu, kalaamu y’essasi n’essaawa emu ey’obwesimbu bimala, era bw’oba oli mufumbo mukikolere wamu.

study_questions.question: Okebera otya oba enteekateeka y’ensimbi ey’omwezi etereevu?
study_questions.answer: Gatta Emitendera 2 okutuuka ku 6: okugaba, ebyetaago ebikulu, okutereka, amabanja n’ebirala byonna. Omugatte gulina kwenkanankana n’ensimbi z’ofuna mu Mutendera 1. Bwe guba gusingako, osaasaanya okusinga by’ofuna, kale ddayo osalako okutuusa nga bitereevu; bwe guba gukendeddeko, salawo ensimbi ezisigaddewo gye zinaagenda, oboolyawo mu kugaba, mu kutereka oba mu kusasula amabanja amangu.

study_questions.question: Okutereka n’amabanja bikwatibwa bitya mu nteekateeka y’ensimbi ku lupapula lumu?
study_questions.answer: Tandika n’ensawo entono ey’ebigwa bitalaze, oluvannyuma weeyongere okutuusa ng’olina ebisale ebikulu eby’emyezi esatu okutuuka ku mukaaga, olwo otereke olw’ebyetaago gamba ng’ennyumba, obukadde oba abaana bo. Wandiika amabanja amalala ng’oggyeeko looni y’ennyumba, okuva ku litono okutuuka ku linene, n’amagoba gaago, era osalewo ssente mmeka ez’okwongerako z’onoosasula n’ebbanja ly’onoosooka okumalayo. Suubira nti kinaatwala emyezi esatu oba ena okufuna enteekateeka ekola.

fields.title: Ebyongerezeddwako 3: Obulagirizi bw’Ebibinja obwa Wiiki Kkumi
fields.body_html:
Ekitabo kino kyawandiikibwa okusomebwa n’abalala. Okwogera ku nsimbi kyangu okusinga abantu abasinga bwe balowooza, omuntu omu bw’amala okusooka. Wano waliwo enteekateeka ennyangu ey’ekibinja ekisisinkana omulundi gumu buli wiiki okumala wiiki kkumi.

Nga temunnatandika

Mukuume emirembe gy’abantu. Mukkiriziganye nti ebyogerwa mu kibinja bisigala mu kibinja. Tewali muntu n’omu alina kukakibwa kwogera miwendo gya nsimbi, gamba ng’ensimbi z’afuna oba z’agaba. Mwogere ku ndowooza n’ebyo bye musalawo, so si ku miwendo, okuggyako ng’abantu bo bennyini balonze okubyogera.

Mubeere beesimbu. Abakulembeze balina okuba abeetegefu okusooka okwogera ku bizibu byabwe bennyini. Omukulembeze bw’anaayefuula ng’atalina buzibu bwonna ku nsimbi, tewali n’omu mulala ajja kwogera mu bwesimbu.

Mubeere n’ekisa. Abamu mu kibinja bayinza okuba mu mabanja oba nga balina obuzibu bw’ensimbi obw’amazima. Abalala bayinza okuba abagagga ate nga mu kyama tebeewulira bulungi. Mukolere bombi ekifo. Ekigendererwa si kubaleetera kwewulira musango, wabula ekisa n’okukula.

Buli wiiki

Musabe buli muntu asome essuula ebbiri nga temunnasisinkana. Bwe musisinkana:

  • Muggulewo n’okusaba n’okubuuzaganya amangu: “Ky’okukola wiiki eno” eky’omu wiiki ewedde kyagenda kitya?
  • Musome mu ddoboozi eriwulikika olunyiriri olukulu olwa buli ssuula.
  • Mukubaganye ebirowoozo ku bibuuzo bya “Ku lw’ebibinja.” Temwetaaga kubimalayo byonna. Mulonde ebyo ebisinga okuleeta emboozi.
  • Mwesuubize “Ky’okukola wiiki eno” kimu ku lwa wiiki eddako, era musabire buli omu ng’omwogera erinnya.

Enteekateeka

  • Wiiki 1. Ennyanjula n’essuula 1: Byonna bya Katonda.
  • Wiiki 2. Essuula 2 ne 3: Twatondebwa Okukola, Twayitibwa Okukuuma; Abakulu Babiri.
  • Wiiki 3. Essuula 4 ne 5: Obugagga bwa Kristo; Omululu, Ekibi Abantu Kye Batanenya.
  • Wiiki 4. Essuula 6 ne 7: Ekyama Ekiyigibwa eky’Okumalibwa; Emmere ya Buli Lunaku, so si Kweraliikirira kwa Buli Lunaku.
  • Wiiki 5. Essuula 8 ne 9: Akabi k’Obugagga; Funa Kyonna ky’Osobola, mu Bwesimbu.
  • Wiiki 6. Essuula 10 ne 11: Balirira Omuwendo; Enjegere z’Oyo Eyeewola. (Wiiki eno muyinza okugabira abantu kkopi z’enteekateeka y’ensimbi eri mu Byongerezeddwako 2.)
  • Wiiki 7. Essuula 12 ne 13: Labirira Abantu Bo; Ebibala Ebibereberye.
  • Wiiki 8. Essuula 14 ne 15: Okugaba n’Essanyu, Bulijjo, era mu Kyama; Okuwola Mukama. (Mulowooze ku kukolera wamu omulimu ogw’okuyamba abantu abali mu bwetaavu.)
  • Wiiki 9. Essuula 16 ne 17: Gaba Kyonna ky’Osobola; Omwesigwa mu Bintu Ebitono.
  • Wiiki 10. Essuula 18, 19 ne 20, n’Okufundikira. Wiiki eno esembayo mugimalire mu kuwandiika buli omu enkola ye ey’obulamu ku nsimbi, n’okugisabira wamu.

Ku lw’abakulembeze

Teweetaaga kuba mukugu mu by’ensimbi okukulembera ekibinja kino. Weetaaga bwetaavu kuba mwesimbu, okwagala abantu b’omu kibinja kyo, n’okubalaga Yesu. Omuntu bw’ayogera ku buzibu bw’ensimbi obunene, gamba ng’amabanja amangi, muyambe okufuna amagezi amalungi, era weeyongere okumusabira ne bwe kiba nti ekibinja kiwedde.

Ekisinga byonna, mweyongere okudda ku kisa. Tetukwata bulungi nsimbi okufuna okwagala kwa Katonda. Tuzikwata bulungi kubanga dda tulina okwagala kwe, era kubanga byonna bye tulina bibye.

study_questions.question: Obulagirizi bw’ebibinja obwa wiiki kkumi butegekeddwa butya?
study_questions.answer: Ekibinja kisisinkana buli wiiki okumala wiiki kkumi, nga basoma essuula bbiri nga tebannasisinkana, ate wiiki esembayo n’ebaako essuula ezisembayo n’Okufundikira. Buli lukuŋŋaana luggulwawo n’okusaba n’okubuuzaganya ku ky’okukola eky’omu wiiki ewedde, ne basoma mu ddoboozi eriwulikika olunyiriri olukulu olwa buli ssuula, ne bakubaganya ebirowoozo ku bibuuzo bya “Ku lw’ebibinja” bye balonze, ne beesuubiza eky’okukola ekipya nga basabira buli omu ng’amwogera erinnya.

study_questions.question: Ekibinja ekitono kiyinza kitya okwogera ku nsimbi mu ngeri ey’emirembe?
study_questions.answer: Obulagirizi buno buteekawo amateeka asatu amakulu. Mukuume emirembe gy’abantu: ebyogerwa bisigala mu kibinja, era tewali akakibwa kwogera miwendo gya nsimbi gamba ng’ensimbi z’afuna oba z’agaba. Mubeere beesimbu: abakulembeze basooka okwogera ku bizibu byabwe. Mubeere n’ekisa: mukolere ekifo abo abali mu mabanja n’abo abagagga ate nga mu kyama tebeewulira bulungi, nga mugendereramu ekisa n’okukula, so si kwewulira musango.

study_questions.question: Weetaaga okuba omukugu mu by’ensimbi okukulembera okusoma kw’ekibinja ku nsimbi?
study_questions.answer: Nedda. Omukulembeze yeetaaga bwetaavu kuba mwesimbu, okwagala abantu b’omu kibinja, n’okubalaga Yesu. Omuntu bw’ayogera ku buzibu bw’ensimbi obunene gamba ng’amabanja amangi, muyambe okufuna amagezi amalungi era weeyongere okumusabira ne bwe kiba nti ekibinja kiwedde. Ekisinga byonna, mweyongere okudda ku kisa.
